tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi
bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab gter bdun cu'i snying bcud thugs sgrub che/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor chos mdzod kyi/ /sgo 'byed rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i smin byed khrigs/ /nor bu'i lde'u mig them byang 'di nas longs/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi them byang 'god pa la/ dang po/ ka)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong gi sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi sbrags ma 'bring po'i lugs dang*/ kha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gsol 'debs dngos grub snying po/ (ga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i bcud bsdus/ nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i las tshogs yid bzhin nor bu/ (ca) bsam lhun tshogs bsdus/ cha) thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa'i cha lag bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i sgrub thabs bcu gsum spyi khyab kyi sngon rjes sogs kyi mtshams sbyor/ ja) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ zhal gdams bsam lhun le tshan bcu gsum rgyas spros sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa chu babs su bkod pa lam bzang gsal sgron/ nya) shin du bsdus pa bum dbang ye shes drwa ba/

ta) gsang dbang bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed/ tha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ smin byed dbang gi bca' bsham gyi rim pa gsal byed bcas so/ slar smras pa/ ma hā gu rus rje 'bangs bu slob la/ /mchims phu'i brag dang bsam yas khra 'brug tu/ /bder 'dus dgongs 'dus bka' 'dus smin grol gyis/ /snga bar phyi ma'i gdul bya smin grol bkod/ /de dag kun gyi mtha' rten zhus len dang*/ /zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum rgyab chos bcas/ /tha ma gung thang la khar skyel len du/ /zhal chems tshul du phyi ma'i btsas su gnang*/ /de phyir gu ru'i bka' drin rjes dran dang*/ /bod 'bangs phyi rab skyobs pa'i snying byang du/ /nges phyir thugs sgrub brgya rtsa'i bcud phul ni/ /som nyi med par grub la ci zhig snyon/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /

ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // (ka) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong nar 'gros su bkod pa rin chen phra tshom bzhugs so/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /dbyer med rtsa gsum gling pa la btud nas/ /bka' 'dus smin byed in+d+ra nī la yi/ /mchod sdong mdzes rgyan rin chen phra tshom bsdeb/ /de la bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'di ni spros bcas dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong gi smin byed dbang chog spros bcas sta dngos sbrags ma nag po 'gro shes su dgod pa la/ shin tu spros bcas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dbang chen mo zhes pa ni/ sgrub chen dang sbrags pa ste/ sgrub khog ltar slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su sta gon byas la/ nyin grangs thems rjes bum gsang sogs dbang chen dkyus ltar bskur ba'i phyag srol te nyin bcu'i nang rdzogs par byed pa yin mod/ 'di 'dra'i lag len deng sang byed mkhan dkon pas lag len theb par dka' bas 'dir dbang rkyang gi khong du sgrub khog nang bshad pa'i sta gon dang*/ sgrub dbang rnams kyis 'thus par mdzad pa'i gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes bzhin 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la'ang*/ sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po dkyil 'khor gang la'ang bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus su tshom bu/ mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum gnyis nyer spyod lngas bskor/

dung phor du 'o ma rtsi sman sbyar ba/ bsang chu 'thor byed ku sha sogs 'du bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsam te las bum nas bzed/ yungs thun/ g.yab dar ḍā ru/ rdor dril gdab phur nang mchod rnams dgod/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar tshom bu dgod la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na moḥ rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: skyabs mchi gsol 'debs byin rlobs thugs dam bskul: phrin las 'gro 'dul dpal du yongs smin shog: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ khams gsum srid pa'i 'khor lo shing rta'i rgyun: yang yang duḥkha'i srid pa nyer len tshogs: yongs su gzhom pa'i bde gshegs smon pa'i mthus: bdag gis 'grub phyir byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ rgyun bshags rdo rje slob dpon? song nas/ hūm̐/ rang rig shes pa ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /dran rtog 'dzin med ngo bo gshis lugs hūm̐/ /yongs gyur bla ma rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ /'gag med gsal stong gzhon tshul zhi ma khro/ /za ber phod ka rin chen prog zhu dang*/ /rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ shes rab 'chang*/ /rgyal po rol stabs snang srid zil gnon ngang*/ /sku yi cha dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar lhags/ /sgyu ma'i gar ltar wal gyis gsal ba yi/ /thugs kar hūm̐ mthar snying po'i sngags phreng 'khor/ /'byung 'jug thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi ngang*/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas byin brlabs thugs rgyud bskul/ /yig 'bru gsum gyis dbang bzhi'i snying po thob/ /rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru rtag mngon te/ /'phro 'gyu tshogs drug ka dag dbyings su grol/ /snang stong gsal stong bde stong rig stong ngang*/ /gshis lugs lta ba bla ma'i don rtogs nas/ /de bzhin he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur te/

/rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'ang bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ brgya tsam bzla/ las bum mam/ dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas dgod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mthing nag rgya gram dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams shing*/ de'i steng gtor ma dang gser skyems bshams nas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bka' brgyad kyi dkar gtor ram spyi mthun ltar sa gzhi bslang ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ gyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kun/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/

/zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /gtor ma phul rjes tshom bu bsdus la phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas rang nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i lha dpal rdo rje he ru ka'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig? rtsa sngags phreng skor ram/ nyer gcig sogs sbrags pas sa bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bdud rtsi ma da na dang sbyar ba stegs bur 'thor la chag chag gdab bo/ /de nas sta gon dngos la gsum las/ dang po lha dang bum pa sta gon chab gcig tu bshad na/ mdun stegs khebs ldan steng*/ maṇ+ḍal dri'i thig le'i dbus dang*/ phyogs bzhi ste lnga tshom de'i phyir rol tshom bu lnga dang*/ de'i phyi rol bzhi ste bcu bzhi/ de'i phyi rol du sgo ba bcas bkod la/ de'i steng lcog na rnam 'phrul bcu gsum bka' 'khor sgo skyong dang bcas pa'i rang sngags bzlas bzhin nam/ min kyang bsnyen sgrub sngags kho nas mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes btags pa brjod bzhin du 'bru tshom gtso 'khor bye brag phyed par dgod/ de nas bum pa rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la yungs dkar gyis brab/ bdud rtsi chos sman dang dri bzang bum rdzas so lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu gtsang phyed ka khengs bar blugs/

rnam bum la mgul chings dmar po dang*/ las bum la mgul chings ljang gu sgron/ kha rgyan gzung thag dang bcas pa 'du bya la tshom bu'i steng rkang gsum thog dgod/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi rdzas dang dbang gi ca chas rnams kyang stegs thog tu dgram/ rgyab phyogs su sman raka gtor ma/ mtha' bskor du phyi nang gi nyer spyod g.yas su bskor bar bshams te/ mchod gtor byin rlob ni/ las byang rtsa ba gcig dril las/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs dang bcas: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin: bde gshegs rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: dam tshig? sogs nas bstod pa'i bar btang la bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa khyug tsam byas la spro na sgrub khog ltar bum sgrub rgyas pa bya/ ma nus na rnam bum dang las bum chos spyod nang ltar sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ de nas yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spos dang thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bde gshegs bka' 'dus dgongs su gsol/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtshor mchod pa dang*/ /'dus pa'i mched lcam khyed kyi rjes zhugs phyir/ /bdag cag bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yi/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bri bar bya/ khyed rnams kyis ni thugs rjes brtser dgongs la/ /byin rlabs rgya chen stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma phyi rol du bos la khrus nas dbyung ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus dang maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa

sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi bka'? dge 'dun? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug / steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ de nas slob dpon zhwa chos dang bcas te/ lo rgyus cung zad 'chad pa la/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa'i rtsol sgrub kyis yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la zhugs par bya'o/ de'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la bslab par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'ang gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ khyad par du gyur pa 'di ni/ gter gzhung las/ de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rim gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag:

de'ang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas: kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gong thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa'i: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs su/ bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams bstsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams le'u bdun ma bcas mang du bstsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' bstsal/ phyis su gu rus gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang rje 'bangs rnams la skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/ ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' bstsal pa bzhin mtsho rgyal gyis shog dril dam rdzas dang sku tshab gter lnga bcas khag bgos nas sbas pa las/ bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i char/ sngar gu rus rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus rnam gsum chos kyi smin grol mdzad pa'i gnas mchog bod yul sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po/ bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang de nyid du gu ru yab yum gyis skad cig gis mig 'phrul ltar mi snang bar rgya yis gdams pa mdzad pa'i sku tshab mthong grol chen mo/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/

thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag zhal gdams bcu gsum las phran dang bcas pa/ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ bod rab byung 12sa khyi lo'i zla tshes la phyi nang gi 'byin pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes shing zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje sogs la gnang*/ snga ma las o rgyan dri med gling pa dang*/ rtsa nang gter chen/ lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa sogs nas rim par 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i khu rlangs thul le ba 'di lta bu'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la'ang bder 'dus rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong dang*/ yan lag sgrub thabs bcu gsum so so'i dbang sogs ji snyed bzhugs pa las/ da lam bder 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin pas/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/ de ring gi skabs lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin/ de la'ang bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i thog mar lhag gnas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/

mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ thugs rje'i dbang phyug bla ma rje: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dam pas rjes bzung gnang ba stsol: zhes pa'i lan 'di gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: yang dag nges par 'jug nas su: dkyil 'khor gnyan la mi 'da' na: dam longs rdo rje'i dam tshig sbyin: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka'i gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad pa la/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan chos kyi rje: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus la: bdag yid rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rnam dag sku lnga'i mchog: ci bzhin rtogs pa'i byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi: 'od zer nar ma 'gro la rab spros nas: yang dag sangs rgyas lam 'god sems bskyed do: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos lhan cig tu mdzod/

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: dkyil 'khor 'di ru 'jug spro bas: bla mas ci gsung g.yar dam rnams: bka' las 'das na mgo bo khos:

zhes khas blang du gzhug /de nas dam tshig rdo rje'i mna' chu blud la/ hūm̐: 'di ni byang chub snying rje'i chu: gsang sngags mos par ye shes 'gyur: sngags la mi mos log lta can: dam tshig nyams pa'i dug chur 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: log lta can la shin tu gsang : khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bro bor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra na ra ka a su tri pre du nṛ sa ma ya i dan+te badz+ra hū?m̐ hūm̐: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar 'gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig / dam chu sbyin zhing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sbyin pa ni: sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka yak+sha kā la badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdud pa'i sngags ni: raṃ triṃ ṭaṃ tsakra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la pho'i dpung pa g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du bcing la/ phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gcod/ srung skud ye shes rigs lngar mtshon pas kha dog lnga ldan dang sku gsung thugs kyis rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba 'di nyid bcings pas/ phyi ltar rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing nang ltar ma dag nyon mongs pa thams cad dag pa dang*/ gsang ba dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yis legs mtshon pa: dam tshig sems dpar gnas pa dang : ye shes phebs nas brtan pa'i phyir: de ring rdo rje'i rgya chings gdab:

oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsakra tsakra badz+ra tsakra swā hā: pho'i g.yas dang mo'i g.yon du btags pas lus rdo rje'i go khrab tu gyur nas bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las srung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur: dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sngon du chu bo nai rañja na'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad cing rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba'i rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas pa'i steng du seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid cing mgo dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su gtad la rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ hūm̐: sngon byon rig 'dzin grub thob kyis: 'jag spyil phub nas ku sha yis: gdan byas rnams snang chos bdun gnas: de yi rten 'brel rtswa 'di zungs: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dha ra gar+bha sid+dhi hoḥ chun po chung ba sngas dang chen po gdan du byas la rmi lam bzang ngan gyi mtshan ma brtag par byos shig om̐: dang po skye med stong pa āḥ bar du 'gags med gsal snang āḥ tha ma bde stong 'dzin med āḥ rang sems dri med āḥdakar sgoms: oṃ a a āḥ snying khar pad+ma chu shel gyi me tog kha bye ba lta bu'i dbus su/

āḥdakar sems nyid skye med kyi ngo bor mos la/ de dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar phog pas yi dam lha'i go 'phang 'thob par shog snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de nas 'bru tshom mam maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dkyil 'khor so shing tsan dan la bzos pa sor bcu drug gi tshad bya: mgo bo me tog rtsa ba rgya mdud yin: so shing gi rtse mor pad+ma dgos pa yin: snying kha'i pad+ma chu shel gyi me tog ltar kha bye ba'i dbus su sngar gyi lung 'bog pa'i āḥde sems nyid skye ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka ru 'phros pas yi dam lha'i go 'phang thob par bsgoms la smon lam kyang de bzhin dmod nas btab: dmod dor zhing so shing bzung la/ de'ang slob dpon gyis so shing sbyin pa'i dus thal sbyar bar du blangs: rjes zlos kyi tshe mkha' dbyings phyag rgya zhes mthe bong lto sbyar ba'i bar so shing gi rtsa bar bzung nas sos 'cha' ba'i tshul dang : sor mo rnams thad kar brkyangs pa'i gung mos so shing gi rtse mo me tog dang ldan par bzung : de lta bu'i phyag rgyas so shing cung zad sos 'cha' ba dang lhan cig dmigs pa so shing las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis: khong pa'i nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin nag 'dur gyis phyir 'then te dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim byung snyam pa dang : sngags lung 'bog pa'i āḥde sems nyid dbye ba med pa: de nyid kyi rtse mo me tog 'dor yul gyi maṇ+ḍa lar gtad de dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gsal por ston cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ drug ldan rdo rje lus kyi dbu ma ru: skye med dbang po'i me tog āḥdakar brgyan: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na: tshe rabs 'di phyi'i rten 'brel gang 'grub ston: oṃ dharma mu le puṣ+pe ku mu ṭa gar+bha āḥ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor ro/

phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi mtshams bzhir phran tsheg /steng du mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub/ 'og tu lhung na bar chad kyi rtags/ g.yas g.yon sogs rim bzhin zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug gi rtags yin pas/ tshe thar sbyin pa mchod me brgya rtsa skong bshags sogs bya dgos so/ de nas cod pan spyi bor brgyan la sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sgor zhugs nas: yi dam spang blang mi bya zhing : dkyil 'khor 'di la gtso bor gyis: oṃ badz+ra mu tra sarba kā ya badz+ra dha ra hūm̐: 'di'i don lnga ni: dam chu kha ru sbyin pas dam tshig mi nyams pa'i khas len mna' tho rang chad kyi rnam dbye: cod pan spyi bor brgyan pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags mi nor ba'i mi lta bu: dpung skud legs par 'dogs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgya chings: āḥsnying khar sgom pa mi 'khrul ba'i dam mdzer: rtswa gdan 'og tu 'ding bas sgrub pa mthar ma phyin par mi 'gul ba'i dam bca' ste sngon du 'gro ba'i gzer bu lnga'o: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni: thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor sbyar la: hoḥ bdag lus spyi gtsug dung khang pho brang ste: rdo rje sems dpa' dri med shel gyi mdangs: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes phyag rgya can: snyems ma dkar sngon rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: yab yum zung 'jug 'khril thabs skyil krung bzhugs: lha rdzas rin chen rgyan mdzes thugs ka ru: hūm̐ yig mtha' ru yi ge brgya pa ni: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas bag chags sdig sgrib dag: chu zla'i snang bzhin dri med rjen par shar: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: yi ge brgya pa bgrang : de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom bzung ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems bdag la dgongs:

bdag gis 'di bzung byang chub bar: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas: tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa bsrung : bzod pa dka' thub brtson 'grus brtsam: bsam gtan bsgoms nas shes rab 'chang : sbyin gtong smon lam thabs stobs 'byin: bud+dha rdo rje rat+na dang : pad+ma karma bhi shwa yis: dug lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga: phung po lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dam tshig bzung : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: de dag gi sngon 'gro gzer lnga zhes/ slob ma lhag gnas bya ba smin byed dbang bskur gyi snod du rung ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ dngos grub myur bar byed pa/ sta gon gyi rim pa grub pa yin pas dge rtsa sems can ched bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs mdzad par 'tshal/ bsod nams 'di? dngos gzhi sang nyin 'byung ba lags so/ de nas slob dpon gyis sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod mdor bsdus sam/ yang na bdag mdun chab gcig tu dmigs te/ sngar ma song na tshogs skong srung ma'i gtor 'bul rjes chog bcas 'grub par bya/ gshegs bsdus kyi skabs sta gon gyi lha ye shes pa mdun mkhar 'od kyi drwa ba'i nang du bzhugs par gyur/ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur/ ces bsdus/ mthar bkra shis smon lam bcas mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ sta gon gyi skabs so// // gnyis pa thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dbang don sgrub mchod dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'o/ dang po/ las byang rgyas pa bsam lhun ye shes sprin phung ltar sngon du 'gro dgos pas dang po ni/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ rnam thar gsol 'debs dang brgyud 'debs bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ las byang gi skyabs sems tshogs bsags bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba bka' bsgo ba nas brtsam ste mthar chags su bya/ spyan 'dren skabs sta gon gyi lha rnams kyis gnyis med du bstims la phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar gzhung ltar bya/

skabs 'dir dzap khang dbye la bdag mdun cig car du gsal btab cing bzlas pa bya/ gsang 'dus las/ bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor sgom/ /gsol 'debs tshul du dzap 'di bzlas/ /zhes pa bzhin/ kyai kyai bla ma sogs kyis gsal btab la 'bru bcu gnyis pa bzla/ sgrub dus bla ma rang gsal gdab ces pa bzhin mchod bstod tshul du dzap 'di bzla thod phreng rtsal/ las sbyor dus su rang gsal gdab/ phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul du bzla/ hri ma ha ri ni s bum sgrub rtsa ba gcig dril ltar ram/ spyi ltar bya la rnam bum las bum sgrub rjes dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod rjes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon bum par phul la 'od zhu bya/ dam can sde lnga'i bskang gsol sogs rang lugs gsol mchod rgyas bsdus gang rung gi mthar ye shes sku mchog ma'i bshags pa dang*/ sman raka gtor ma'i skong ba tsam gyi rjes su gtor bsngo rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan 'dren bar gtong*/ tshogs spyan 'dren nas bskang ba'i mgo bar song rjes phyi snod srid gsum sogs gsol skong nas tshogs drang bar btang nas bsam lhun dang bar chad lam sel bcas grub nas grol/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib bo/ rig me dor ba sngar ma song tshe 'dir bya la gnang ba zhu ba bsngo smon bcas grub bo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ sta gon sngon du song ba'i slob ma rnams phyi rol du 'khod par las rdor gyis chab bkye la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ slob dpon shar phyogs kyi sgo drung nang du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ shar phyogs ging chen rnam par rgyal ba yis: byams pa tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson la: nyon mongs zhe sdang zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: me long ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas:

mngon dga'i zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: ces zhus pa'i lan du/ sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams rdo rje rigs kyi ging : lha bu'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: shar sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: de nas slob ma rnams kyi dam tshig khas blang ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te: me long ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : zhes pa'i lan du nang nas rdo rje'i ging chen gyis zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ho/ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags na/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yi ni rim pa bzhin/ /so sor dam longs dbang mchog sbyin/ zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /slob dpon lho phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor lho phyogs kyi sgo drung nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ lho phyogs ging chen gshin rje gshed po yis: snying rje tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs nga rgyal zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: dpal ldan zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: rat+na dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: ces zhus pa'i lan du/ sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams rin chen rigs kyi ging : phung po'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: lho sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: de nas slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig khas blang ba mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te: mnyam nyid ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : zhes pa'i lan du nang nas rin chen ging gis zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ho/ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags na/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yi ni rim pa bzhin/ /so sor dam longs dbang mchog sbyin/ /zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon nub phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor nub phyogs kyi sgo drung nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ nub phyogs ging chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: dga' ba tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs 'dod chags zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: pad+ma dbyings kyi lha dang ngo sprod cig: ces zhus pa'i lan du/ sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams pad+ma rigs kyi ging : nyon mongs bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: nub sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: de nas slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig khas blang ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te: sor rtogs ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : zhes pa'i lan du nang nas pad+ma ging chen gyis zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ho/ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags na/ /pad+ma rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yi ni rim pa bzhin/ /so sor dam longs dbang mchog sbyin/ /zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

/slob dpon byang phyogs kyi sgo drung du bzhengs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor byang phyogs kyi sgo drung nas sgo srung rnams la gnang ba zhu bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ byang phyogs ging chen dbyug pa sngon po yis: btang snyoms tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs phrag dog zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: las rabs zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: karma dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: ces zhus pa'i lan du/ sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams karma rigs kyi ging : 'chi bdag bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: byang sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: de nas slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig khas blang ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te: bya grub ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : zhes pa'i lan du nang nas karma ging chen gyis zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ho/ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags na/ /karma rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yi ni rim pa bzhin/ /so sor dam longs dbang mchog sbyin/ /zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis ston pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub cing rigs kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ phyogs kyi ging chen rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi shag gis phyes par mos la nang du spro ba dang bcas 'jug pa la/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs rdo rje'i ging chen rnams kyis bskrad pa'i las mdzad par mos mdzod/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi bka'? dge 'dun? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / gzhung gi bgegs bskrad la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed ba'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyugs: 'khor yug mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ phaṭḥ.a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya: gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug skabs 'dir ging dkar nag gi chas byas pa'i me thun chu thun brdeg cing bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: khyed rnams yang dag snod ldan na: dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug pa'i tshe: bsgrub la mi dbang gdon dang bgegs: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho nya ni: 'bar ba'i ging chen glog ltar rgyu: gnod byed 'brang ba'i go skabs med: lan chags gtor ma 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: dmar nag me phreng thugs khros nas: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas gzhan du phyir dengs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥhūm̐: gul yungs kyis bdug /rol mo dkrol cing rdo thun gyis brab la gzhung gi mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub drag rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrungs mtshams med pa dum bu gcig pa ni: e yi mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e khaṃ raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ de nas me tog bkye bsdu dang bcas lo rgyus brjod/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/

rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ de'ang thun mong gi theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa'i rtsol sgrub kyis yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la zhugs par bya'o/ de'ang smin byed kyi dbang zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rung ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi brlab/ ces gsungs pa thugs nges dang*/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/ chos nyams su len pa ni/ sman bsten na nad nye bar sel ba'i 'du shes te yang dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos su mos gus dad pa dang ldan pas sgo gsum legs par bsdams te gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/

de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed du zin kyang*/ rnyed pa de kho nas mi chog ste phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho ba'i rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med dang 'chi rkyen nges med yin pas ma tshad/ tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa ni med/ 'chi ba'i tshe'ang gnyen nye 'brel grogs mdza' bshes thob go sa nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang ste/ las dkar nag 'ba' zhig rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma bsgrubs pas khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing*/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar pa'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos/ de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang mthun pa'i/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa dman pa dang theg pa chen po gnyis su 'du la/ de'ang nyan rang theg pas dngos su lam dang 'bras bu thar pa'i cha shas tsam las rnam grol gyi lam rdzogs par ma bstan cing*/ rang 'bras mthar phyin thab nas kyang*/

gzod theg chen la 'jug dgos pas lam dman la theg chen ni theg dman las khyad par chen po bdun gyis 'phags tshul/ mgon po byams pas/ dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub gnyis dag pa dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dag dang ldan phyir/ /'di ni theg chen zhes byar brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ dmigs pa chen pos chos nyid nam mkha' 'dra ba la dmigs pa/ sgrub pa chen pos rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don sgrub pa/ ye shes chen pos bdag 'dzin gnyis kas stong pa'i chos nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes brnyes pa/ brtson 'grus chen pos bskal pa grangs med par sems can don la brtson pa/ thabs mkhas chen pos srid zhi'i mtha' gang la mi gnas pa/ grub pa chen po stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan tshad med pa thob pa/ phrin las chen pos 'khor ba ji srid bar du gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung ba bcas thabs bdun gyis khyad par 'phags pa'i theg chen ni lam gyi mchog yin no/ /de la'ang gnyis te/ gal po las/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas rgyu ru shes/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas nyid du shes/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gang yin pa/ /phyogs kyis rab tu shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis kyis/ spyir bsgrub bya byang chub 'thob par 'dod pa don gcig kyang*/ sgrub byed thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par che ste/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi/ /dbang po rnon pos rkyen byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes 'jug sgo dbang sogs kyi thabs la ma rmongs pa dang*/

rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med du sgrub par byed pa'i thabs mang po/ dka' ba mang po spyad mi dgos par 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs sla ba/ dbang po rnon pos dbang du byas te gsungs pa'i snga ma las khyad 'phags kyi chos du ma dang ldan pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgya gar 'phags yul du de lta'i dbye ba med mod/ gangs can gyi yul 'dir lo tsā ba'i 'gyur snga phyi la brten nas sngags gsar rnying gnyis su btags pa las/ 'di ni phyi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa gsar ma las spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag /phyag bzhes gtsug lag khang*/ zhu chen gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ sgyur byed lo tsā ba/ zhu rten me tog /brjod bya'i chos kyi khyad par te/ khyad chos drug ldan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi chos sde gsum yod pa las/ da lam 'dir bka' ma las bka' bab lung bstan/ smon lam dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ste/ khyad par gyi brgyud pa gsum dang*/ gtso bo brgyud thag nye zhing*/ gter yig gi dpe dpang mnga' bas khungs btsun pa/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang mtshon pa mngon par snang ba'i zab lam nub pa med pas khyad par du 'phags pa zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin la/ de'i zab khyad kyang*/ o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gis bka' yi thang yig tu/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams: spyir ni bod khams gsar dad che ba dang : snyigs ma'i 'gro la phal cher snying brtse bas: dbus mtha' thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab: ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan: sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang ris dregs can: rang che 'byin zhing gter la rtsod na yang : snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cher gter gyis 'dren: zab la kha tshang ma 'grib mtha' rgyas shing : gdams pa sna res gang zag grol bar nges:

de bas las sad skal ldan sbyang pa can: 'chi ba dran rnams gter chos nyams su longs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob bo rje 'bangs grogs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dus bab zab gter la rag las pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i zab gter rnams gu ru yab yum gyis phyi ma'i bstan 'gro'i btsas su dgongs nas gangs can gyi ri brag mtsho gsum nam mkha' bar snang thams cad du ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i rgya yis btab ste/ ye shes dang las las grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung rnams la gnyer kha gtad cing*/ dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la sprod ces smon lam dang bcas sbas par mdzad la/ de nyid spyan 'dren po'ang sngon gyi chos rgyal lo paṇa sogs sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i 'phags chen rnams gang 'dul sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa sogs kyi rnam rol du byon par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gu ru'i thugs sras snying gi bu dgu zhes 'phags yul gyi grub chen rig 'dzin brgyad dang tha mi dad pa/ sgrub sde bka' brgyad kyis bka' bab bu dgu'i nang tshan/ 'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab dang*/ khyad par du mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i shing rta chen po/ gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal zhing*/ grub gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa/ grub pa'i rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur zhing nyi zla gdan du bting ba/ brag la phur pa 'debs pa/ sdigs mdzub gtad pa tsam gyis sra mkhregs brag gi ri bo'ang rdul phran du bshig nus pa sogs/ mdor na bdud rje glang dar ma'ang rje 'di'i nus mthus zil gyis mnan pas mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa gos dkar lcang lo'i sde dang bcas par glags blta bar ma nus pas mtshon/ bstan pa 'dzin srung spel ba'i bka' drin che zhing*/

sku tshe'ang mnga' bdag khri srung nas rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar mi lo sum brgya ma zin tsam bzhugs pas mtshon/ nus pa'i mthu/ rnam bzhi'i las/ 'chi med tshe sogs thun mong gi grub pa dang*/ thun min sku tshe de ny-id la theg mchog snying po'i lam mthar son cing*/ mthar sku mi snang bar 'od lus su gshegs pa de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu nas zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ khyad par du gyur pa 'di ni/ lha sras rje 'bangs la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs: bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jigs me btsas bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyir bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje la zhus pa'i bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rim gsum dag la ni:

ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: de yang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas: kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gong thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa'i: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs su bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams bstsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams bcas mang du bstsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' bstsal/ 'on kyang da lta spel ba'i dus min par bstan pa'ang de nyid las/ da lta spel ba'i dus min yig ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul gdul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul gung thang la kha bya ba ru: bal bod mtshams der slebs dus khyod la gtad: gdams pa shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor zungs:

da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ri'i gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan thig le gnyer du bskos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyis su gu rus gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang rje 'bangs rnams la skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/ ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' bstsal pa bzhin/ gter kha khag tu bkram nas sbas pa'i dus rtags lung bstan dang mthun par sprul pa'i gter chen rnams kyis rim bzhin 'byin par gsungs pa las/ 'di nyid 'byin pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni/ sum cu kha dar nyi shu'i dus dang mtshungs: khyad par 'di nas gdung rab mi ring bar: rnam smin bskyed rgyal phyogs dang phyogs nas 'byung : lo skor dus dang zla zhag so so ru: gdams pa 'di nyid nye bar mkho ba 'byung : de dus lha sras skye ba rim brgyud dang : da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lngas rim par 'byin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa sogs sprul pa'i gter chen du mar bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i skor bka' babs pas mtshon 'ga' zhig gnas dus rten 'brel skal bas phongs nas phyis su yang gter dang dgongs gter sogs su 'phos pa'ang byung ngo*/ de dag las khyad par du gyur pa 'di nyid ni zhal gdams las/ dam chos don chen yang snying 'dus pa yi: bka' yi them byang 'gag tu 'dril ba 'di: 'byin pa'i sa rtags dbus yul bdud kyis 'dzin: sa steng g.yo ba'i mtha' dmag dbus su 'khrigs: bsam yas rta mgrin mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs: jo shāka mdun du khrag gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: gtsug lag sgrub gnas bshig nas sil bur 'thor: byang sems skyes bu mang po gri ru 'chi: bdud sprul sde dpon mang po'i snying khrag 'pho: chos spyod sde pa mang po dmangs su 'bebs: dmag 'khrug nad yams mi lo bco brgyad 'byung : bdud kyis ma bslus chos byed nyin skar tsam:

me chu rlung gsum 'khrugs pa'i na bun bzhin: phyi dang nang med dbyar sos rlan ltar 'brub: de dus nga nyid sku yi sprul pa'i cha: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes khyod la gdams: gsung sprul bai ro tsa na khyod la gdams: thugs sprul lha sras rje bo khyod la gdams: yon tan rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod la gdams: phrin las dbang gi mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: shog dril sgrub khog lnga ru bgyid nas su: sku tshab gter lnga dbang ba'i bu la bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan grogs lngar snga phyi ru: rten 'brel dus las mi 'da' 'phrad par shog: khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags rgya can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin par 'gyur: zhes gsungs pa bzhin shog dril dam rdzas dang sku tshab gter lnga bcas khag bgos nas sbas pa las/ zhal gdams bsam lhun gsol 'debs rtsa ba gram pa rgyang nas gter ston bzang po grags pas bzhes shing rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam 'phrul dngos sgrub rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i mtshon sngar byung gi lo rgyus dang*/ phyi ma 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i char/ sngar gu rus rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus rnam gsum chos kyis smin grol du mdzad pa'i gnas mchog bod yul sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po/ bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang de nyid du gu ru yab yum gyis skad cig gis mig 'phrul ltar mi snang bar rgya yis gdams par mdzad pa'i sku tshab mthong grol chen mo/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/ thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus rtsa ba dang yan lag bcas zhal gdams bcu gsum las phran dang bcas pa/

bod rab byung 12 sa khyi lo'i zla tshes la phyi nang gi 'byin pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes shing zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ rwa ston stobs rdo rje sogs la gnang*/ snga ma las o rgyan dri med gling pa dang*/ rtsa nang gter chen/ lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa sogs nas rim par 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i khu rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid yin ste/ lung snga ma'i 'phros su/ sa steng thon pa tsam gyis sgom sgrub dang : spel sbyong 'dzin 'chang klog la nan tan gyis: thugs rjes skyob nges the tshom bor la sgrubs: pad 'byung nga ni sems can don las med: 'di phyi don yod nga phyir 'jug rlom na: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: dad ldan mdun du nga nyid sprul pa re: mos gus can la sgo nyal lta bu yod: khyad par tshes bcu'i dus su mngon sum mjal: gsol 'debs rab gnas thebs rnams dag zhing bgrod: rnga yab gling du bdag mjal the tshom med: lhag par sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag tshe: blo yi gzu dpang nga nyid gzu bor zhog: 'di yi go rim yi ge 'phrin pa bcas: skal ldan kun gyi rna bar sim par gyis: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phan yon de dang ldan pa'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la'ang bder 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong dang*/ yan lag gi sgrub thabs bcu gsum sogs ji snyed bzhugs pa las/ da lam bder 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin pas/ de la'ang slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su yod pa las/

sta gon gyi chos rnams grub ste dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ bdag nyid slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod nas/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams chad lhag med par legs par grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i chos dang zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar 'jug pa'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i dad pas gdung shugs drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ thugs rje'i dbang phyug bla ma rje: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dam pas rjes bzung gnang ba stsol: zhes pa'i lan 'di gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: yang dag nges par 'jug nas su: dkyil 'khor gnyan las mi 'da' na: dam longs rdo rje'i dam tshig sbyin: zhes dris pas lan gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: dkyil 'khor 'di ru 'jug spro bas: bla mas ci gsung g.yar dam rnams: bka' las 'das na mgo bo khos:

zhes khas blang du gzhug /de nas dam tshig rdo rje'i mna' chu blud la/ hūm̐: 'di ni byang chub snying rje'i chu: gsang sngags mos par ye shes 'gyur: sngags la mi mos log lta can: dam tshig nyams pa'i dug chur 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: log lta can la shin tu gsang : khyed rnams kyis kyang don de las mi 'da' bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bro bor ba dang bcas/ 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra na ra ka a su tri pre du nṛ sa ma ya i dan+te badz+ra hū?m̐ hūm̐: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad pa nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje'i lde'u mig gis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phyes la/ ye shes lnga'i lam la khrid par mos pa la mda' dar lag tu gtad nas g.yas bskor gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pas rdo rje thogs te: hūm̐: rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse mchog: rdo rje gseng lam chos sku'i dbyings: rdo rje'i lde'u mig sna tshogs thabs: rdo rje sku gsum sgo phye ltos: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ slar yang slob dpon gyi gsung gis bskul nas/ hūm̐: nga ni bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: skal ba ldan pa'i las can khyod: ma rig gti mug bsal ba'i phyir: rang byung dar thag sngon po zungs: chos dbyings ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba bud+dha puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: skal ba ldan pa'i las can khyod: zhe sdang khengs sems bsal ba'i phyir: zhi ba'i dar thag dkar po zungs: me long ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba badz+ra puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rat+na thod phreng rtsal:

skal ba ldan pa'i las can khyod: nga rgyal khong khro bsal ba'i phyir: rgyas pa'i dar thag ser po zungs: mnyam nyid ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba rat+na puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: skal ba ldan pa'i las can khyod: 'dod chags sred pa bsal ba'i phyir: dbang gi dar thag dmar po zungs: sor rtogs ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba pad+ma pu+uṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni karma thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: phrag dog gdug pa bsal ba'i phyir: drag po'i dar thag ljang khu zungs: bya grub ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba karma puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rje btsun pad+ma 'byung : gling 'di rnga yab dag pa'i zhing : lha 'di bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor ma 'dres 'ja' ltar lhags: skal ldan rnams kyi smon lam 'grub: skal med srid na dung bas gdungs: nges par snying nas gsol ba thob: oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mu ḍa hoḥ slob ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: in+d+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po bstan pa'i chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: man+da ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: rgya gar yul kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po cher: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar: bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du gzugs: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya chen bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: man+da ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyis zhal mjal lung bstan gnang : gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur pas: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de nas rgyud 'dag pa'i slad du theg pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa rnams byed dgos pas/ thog mar mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi bdag nyid chen po la/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: gdod nas rnam dag sangs rgyas chos kyi sku: brgyad khri bzhi stong dam chos longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul der ston dge 'dun sprul pa'i sku: dkon mchog sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa bla ma'i sku: che mchog yi dam 'dus pa bla ma'i gsung : mkha' 'gro bde chen 'dus pa bla ma'i thugs: nor lha 'dus pa bla ma'i yon tan gter: chos skyong 'dus pa bla ma'i phrin las rtsal: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rin po che:

gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthong grol sku yi gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad sprin ltar gtibs: thos grol gsung gi sgra dbyangs theg chen mdzod: sna tshogs 'gro 'dul chos sgra 'brug stong ldir: tshor grol thugs kyi dgongs pa ris med gsal: rtsol med rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston: dran pa tsam gyis mthu dpung byin rlabs bskyed: tshad med thugs rje mnga' ba'i gu ru rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug sems can kun: 'di phyi'i re ltos skyid sdug khyed shes pas: brtse chen thugs rjes nam yang mi gtong zhing : smin grol dbang dang dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: rig grol sku las ye shes 'od dpung 'bar: las nyon rtog sgrib gzhob dud thu lu lu: myong grol thugs rje'i byin rlabs char rgyun gyis: dbang bzhi'i don rgyud nyams rtogs ya la la: btags grol zab don tshig brgyud man ngag rnams: chos dang rang rgyud 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: tshe 'dir rang rig chos sku mngon gyur nas: longs spyod sprul sku'i 'gro don mthar phyin shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skyabs yul de dag gi mdun du ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs ma hā gu ru dgongs su gsol: bdag gis pha khyed snying nas sgrub lags na: sku yi phyag rgya lus la rdzogs pa dang : gsung gi nus rtsal ngag la smin nas su: thugs kyi ye shes dgaungs pa mngon gyur nas: mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhis:

byang chub mchog tu 'god par sems bskyed na: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs rje yis: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du skyabs yul de dag tshogs kyi zhing du byas te/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol ba dang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing sdig pa bshags la rjes su yi rang ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar chos 'khor bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa/ dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa ste yan lag bcu pa'i don gsal thob la tshig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: ma hā gu ru bde chen chos kyi rje: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med ci bgyis pa: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho rnams: o rgyan gu ru 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan 'gro drug lus ngag yid gsum gyis: tshe rabs thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i spyan sngar bshags: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: dpag med dge ba'i tshogs gnyis gter chen 'di'i: yon tan dpag yas lhun 'byams yongs mnga' bar: bdag cag gus pas rjes su yi rang ngo : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru'i byin rlabs thugs rje'i rgya mtsho yis: 'gro drug mang po so so'i sgra skad du:

dri med gsung gi bdud rtsi bla med kyis: chos kyi 'khor lo rtag par bskor du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru 'chi med rdo rje'i skus: ma gyur 'gro ba thugs rjes skyong ba'i phyir: ji srid 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs bar: thugs rje mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod sogs dge tshogs ci mchis pa: 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: dmigs med mtha' bral chos dbyings chen por bsngo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa dang dam tshig ma lus pa bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems bdag la dgongs: bdag gis 'di bzung byang chub bar: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas: tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa bsrung : bzod pa dka' thub brtson 'grus brtsam: bsam gtan bsgom nas shes rab 'chang : sbyin gtong smon lam thabs stobs 'byin: bud+dha rdo rje rat+na dang : pad+ma karma bhi shwa yis: dug lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga: phung po lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dam tshig bzung : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: sdom pa bzung*/ sngon chad gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar dar yug dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i mig dar re bcing ba'i mos pa mdzod/ mig dar gtad/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten me tog u dum+ba ra'i chun po re thogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a kham wi ra hūm̐/ me tog gtad/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa la ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas lus gnad drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad srog rtsol kha sbyor du 'ching*/ sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs pa'i dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig

/oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang la/ slob ma rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bde chen pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas khang du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis pho thams cad dpa' bo rta mgrin/ mo thams cad rdo rje phag mos gar byed pa zhig krong gis gsal thob/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu: paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan du hūm̐ mthing nag las rje btsun ma hā gu ru rin po che dus gsum sangs rgyas de nyid sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum gyi nyams can thugs rje'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur 'khyil zhing gzigs pa: phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pas ka pā la mnyam bzhag gi nang du 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing : sku la phod ka lhab lhub dang chos gos dmar po gser gyi pa tra ris gsol zhing za 'og gi ber chen dmar smug bklubs pa: dbu la shwa ba'i snyan zhu la rgod sgro dar sna lnga'i cod pan dang me long nyi zla nor bu khyung gshog la rin po ches tshom bur bkod pa gsol ba: gru mor yum mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang de la g.yer kha sogs rgyan du mas spras pa: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol nas snang srid zil gyis gnon par rol stabs su bzhugs pa: de'i spyi bor bla ma chos sku rdo rje 'chang la yum rnal 'byor dmar mos 'khril ba: gu ru'i gnas lngar thod phreng sde lnga: de'i phyi rol tu rta mgrin 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje'o: de'i phyi rol tu gu ru mtshan brgyad dpa' bo ging bzhi gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug laṅka gnas nyul sprul pa nyid sprul dang bcas pa: gzhan yang rje 'bangs nyer lnga grub thob brgya rtsa rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: snang la rang bzhin dang bral bar nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang zhing rnga yab dag pa'i zhing mchog nas:

'ja' 'od gur khang 'khrigs se skad cig gis byon nas bdag dang mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin phung thib thib/ 'ja' 'od kyi thig le thig phran dang rig pa lug rgyud sbrang char ltar nyi li li babs nas/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga dang dbang po'i sgo rnams nas zhugs te snying dbus su thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar sgoms shig /

de nas spyan 'dren pa'i rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas? hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : sprul bsgyur gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: rtse gcig phur tshugs dad pas gsol ba 'debs: thugs rjes dbyings nas bzhengs te skur bskyod 'tshal: byin rlabs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: g.yel ba med par dus 'dir stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i stobs kyis mdzad pa'i phrin las shugs: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mthu stobs rtsal 'bar zhing : 'gyur med sku ni lta bas chog mi shes: gar gyi stangs stabs brda 'gros lam se lam: 'gag med gsung gi sgra dbyangs nus pa ldan: hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'khrul med thugs kyi dgongs pas yongs su khyab: brtse chen thugs kyi byin rlabs thibs se thib: rnam 'gyur yon tan du ma brjod las 'das: yid bzhin 'bad med dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: 'gro 'dul phrin las gar yang thogs pa med: zhi rgyas dbang drag cig car sha ra ra: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu rur 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston byed cing : nyi zla'i 'od 'phro gzi byin ya la la: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa chi li li: sgra dbyangs rol mo mang po ti ri ri: dpa' bos hūm̐ sgra bro rdung 'u ru ru: dpa' mos glu len gar stabs khrigs se khrig:

ging chen pho nyas bshugs pa kyu ru ru: zhi tshogs mdangs ldan gar sgyur shigs se shig: 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khang thibs se thib: khro tshogs rngam brjid 'cham stabs lams se lam: drag sngags gnam lcags thog ser sha ra ra: dam can chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: myur mgyogs me rlung glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nor lha gter bdag sgeg bzhad ya la la: dgos 'byung longs spyod bu yug chi li li: sde brgyad bshan pa'i tshogs ni rubs se rub: mda' mdung mtshon cha'i rno dbal zengs se zeng : mtha' sdud pho nya'i tshogs ni nyi li li: dug rlangs nad kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru: kun kyang 'bar ba'i cha lugs rngam pa'i sku: bdud 'dul dpal gyi rta bro chems se chem: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen tshogs sangs se sangs: thugs rje'i stobs bskyed nus pa'i rtsal phyungs la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la byin chen phob: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bu la byin gyis rlobs: phyi nang gsang dbang ma lus bskur du gsol: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: pho brang chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthu chen khyed kyi mthu rtsal nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma ma lus bstan du gsol: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rang bzhin gnas nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dbang chen khyod kyis bdag la dbang mchog stsol: byin chen khyod kyis bdag la byin phob cig: bla ma'i sku las ye shes gzi brjid che: rnal 'byor lus la bde ba bskyed du gsol: yi dam gsung gi byin rlabs nus pa ldan: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dgongs pa klong du gyur: ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: bdag sogs byang chub snying po ma thob par:

bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tsakra badz+ra a be sha ya badz+ra hoḥ spos rol bcas ye shes pa dbab/ de ltar ye shes dbab pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun sgo gsum la gnas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ me tog mgor bzhag /dam tshig gi mna' chu sbyin la/ hoḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po yi: dam tshig srog ltar bsrung ba 'dis: snying la ye shes lha rnams gnas: dam nyams rnams la gshin rjer 'gyur: oṃ lo ha biṣatshas ha la i dan+te swā hā: slob dpon gyi gdams pa 'di la snyan gtad 'tshal/ hūm̐: skal ldan dam tshig gnas pa rnams: dkyil 'khor thugs sgrub rdo rje'i dbyings: khyod rnams 'jug cing smin pa'i phyir: dbang mchog bskur phyir legs par ltos: slob ma rnams kyi mig dbye bar gsol ba 'debs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag ni grangs med 'khor bar 'khyams: a 'thas bag med 'khrul 'khor gyis: nyon mongs ling thog gis bsgribs pas: dam pa'i thugs rjes phye bar stsol: slob dpon gyi thugs ka na ye shes kyi 'od zer gser gyi thur ma lta bu 'phros te ma rig pa'i ling thog mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: nga ni zag bcas 'khrul rgya zhig: 'khrul med shes rab spyan dang ldan: rtsal spros ye shes thur ma yis: khyod kyi a 'thas sgrib mun bsal: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnam gsum bsal nas dag pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par gyur cig: de nas thog med kyi sgrib pa ma rig pa thabs dang rten 'brel gyis bsal ba'i dri med ye shes kyi mig thob ste rang byung bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar mos shig

/hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso: lha khrid bskyed rim phyi la bkram: brda don gsum gyi ngo bo sprad: gnas lugs dkyil 'khor nang du bkod: 'gyu 'ong gsum gyi ngo bo sprod: bskyed rdzogs nyi zla kha sbyor tshul: zung 'jug gnyis med ngo bo sprod: skal ldan rnams kyis legs par nyon: oṃ dharma shū n+ya ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: phyag shing gis dkyil 'khor bstan la/ hoḥ de'ang skal ldan rnams legs par gsan 'tshal: deng 'dir bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zab mo zhal phyes nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la ngo sprod bgyis pa yin te: thog mar gzhi nam mkha' kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i klong du snod kyi snang ba dang snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam pas mkha' klong gi dkyil 'khor yum lnga'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs su chags pa ni kun gzhi 'gyur ba med pa'o: rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar bh+rūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan gyi dkyil 'khor du bkod pa ni chos sku'i rol rtsal ma 'gags pa'o: gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rin po che sna tshogs kyi tog bcas phyi nang gi rgyan spyod phun sum tshogs pa ni: longs sku sgyu ma mkhan gyi zhing khams kyi bkod pa'o: pad phreng rdo rwa dur khrod me ri sogs: de rnams bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni: longs sku'i rgyan 'phyang la rnam pa ma nges pa'i rol rtsed cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'i don no: de'i dbus su rin chen khri 'phang nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la: rje btsun rin po che gu ru dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas nyid: rgyal po'i cha lugs za ber pad zhwa dang chos gos rnam gsum rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ dkur brten nas rgya lham gsol ba ste: rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa ni ye nas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bgres rgud dang bral ba rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa bzhin/
