rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhis rgyal srid bskyangs te mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas rig pa'i gnas lnga'i bye brag so sor ma smos pa'i ded dpon rig 'dzin chen po mchog ni sangs rgyas kun gyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba'o: thod phreng sde lnga sku'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni: ye shes lnga'i thugs rje zad pa med pas gang 'dul der ston gyi 'gro don bgyis pa'o: spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum bzhugs pa ni: kun tu bzang po'i cho rol nyid la rdzogs pa'i brda'o: phyogs bzhir rta mgrin 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor bzhugs pa ni: yi dam rigs 'dus dgongs pa nyid kyi sku la rdzogs pa'i brda'o: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du gu ru mtshan brgyad bzhugs pa ni: dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi gtso bo yin zhing gang 'dul der ston thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: rdo rje dpa' bo ging gis bskor ba ni: dkyil 'khor skyong zhing phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brda: bar khyams gsang ba'i lha mo sna tshogs bzhugs pa ni: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso bo yin pa'i brda: dbang phyug zhing skyong gnas nyul la sogs pa bzhugs pa ni: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du log lta can mi btang zhing tshar bcad de sgo bzhir skyong ba'i brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug kun tu rje 'bangs nyer lngas byin 'bebs mdzad cing gsang ba mkha' 'gros tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni: thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pas 'gro ba sgrol zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu drwa ba sham bu me long me tog phreng ba nyi zla mda' dar ral gri stag sham thod phreng rus rgyan phur pa mda' gzhu cod pan gnam rgyan yol ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi ca lag thams cad sogs tshang zhing tshogs pa ni: rten 'brel dge mtshan du ma dang ldan te: bar chad bdud kyis glags mi rnyed pa'i brda:

rdo rje slob dpon la che ba'i rgyan chas kyis spras nas khri gdan phun sum tshogs pa'i khar bzhugs te nyer mkho'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang : khyad par du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal tshogs pa ni: skal ldan dam pas chos la spyod pa'i tshe 'dod rgu dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i brda: slob ma dad ldan pho mo thams cad rgyan gos mdzes pa'i chas dang ldan nas gral du 'khod pa ni: phyis 'byung rgyan dar phun sum tshogs te rten 'brel 'phro bzang mthud nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du sleb par 'gyur ro: de ltar dkyil 'khor zab mo 'di 'dra'i sgor zhugs pa ni: smon lam dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar brda don rtags gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor/ nang rdo rje'i phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ gzhan gdod nas bzhugs pa'i gnas yul gyi dkyil 'khor gsum ni/ rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang rol pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du skad cig 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i rang zhal rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes de nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas me tog mtheb srin gyi bar du bzung nas tshe rabs nas 'brel ba'i lha la phog par shog snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas dkyil 'khor la 'dor bar zhu/ kyaiḥ bdag ni grangs med lus blangs kyang : 'di dang phyi ma nyer len du: bsgrubs dang sgrub par byed pa yi: lhag pa'i lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā yu ṣe swā hā: me tog gang du phog pa'i rigs kyi gsang mtshan yang btags la/ dbang rtags kyi cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags ni: rigs lnga'i cod pan sa bon brgyan: deng 'dir lha dang skal par mnyam: rtag tu chos 'di spyod par shog:

om̐ maṅga laṃ mu ku ṭa sarba pañca su pra tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: cod pan mgor bzhag la rtag tu 'chang ba'am ci rigs bya'o: khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas pa'i ming ni rig 'dzin gzhon nu 'od zer dpa' bo rnam par rol pa zhes dang*/ mo rnams la/ dbyings phyug ḍāk+ki'i gtso mo bde ba gsal mdzad ma zhes bya bar sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ de nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag phur pa lag tu gtad: hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: bla med dkyil 'khor srog ltar srungs: dam tshig rdo rje'i rgyas gdab nas: bar chod srung ba'i phur bu chongs: oṃ badz+ra tsakra oṃ badz+ra kī la ya dha ra hūm̐: zhes gong ba la 'dogs: de rnams kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ da dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i ched du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma nyid: rdo rje slob dpon rigs kyi bdag: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag 'jug bka' bstsal zhu ba'i rten: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang : zhing khang yul zhing chung ma bcas: 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya dang : grangs med 'jig rten dang bcas te: 'dzam gling 'di ru bkod nas kyang : maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bkram pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na: dbang bskur rjes su gnang ba stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhū mi i pa maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: skyabs mchis 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: dbang bskur dam pas rjes bzung nas: sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas dngos gzhi dbang la'ang*/ dang po bum dbang la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum pa'i dbang*/

nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba skal ba ster bar byed pa rdzas kyi dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi lha tshogs yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar nas/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa rang byung bla med gzhal yas khang : bum chu rigs 'dus rje btsun ngo bo nyid: bde gshegs sgrub pa sku yi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/

byas la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog dor zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa la sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed la/ slob dpon yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ 'og min gyi zhing khams rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo yab yum las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha so so'i sku dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs song snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ rigs bdag rdor 'chang thogs la: deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang bskur bas rigs rnams kun gyi gtso bor dbang bar sgoms: hūm̐: drug pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang : yum mchog snyems ma zung 'jug 'khril: thabs shes dbyer med dbang bskur bas: rgyud sde'i gtso bo bdag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dha ra pradz+nyā swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sku'i gnas lnga'i thod phreng sde lnga thogs la: khyed rang rnams la gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i dbang bskur bas dug lnga gnas su dag sku lngas 'gro don mdzad de ye shes lnga mngon du gyur par sgoms: hūm̐: bud+dha badz+ra rat+na trām̐: pad+ma karma la sogs pa: bla ma thod phreng sde lnga yis: dbang bskur ye shes don ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya pañca dz+nyā na shrī swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rta mgrin dang 'jam dpal rigs gsum bcas thogs la:

hoḥ khyed rang rnams la dbang chen rta mgrin dang : 'jam dpal dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje rnam bzhi'i dbang bskur bas rta mgrin ye shes rol pa yi dam kun 'dus 'grub: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis shes rab mtha' dag dang rig pa gnas lnga'i rtsa kha 'byed: spyan ras gzigs kyis snying po bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob: phyag na rdo rjes bdud dang dam sri 'byung po 'dre rgod ma rungs pa tshar bcad pa'i nus pa dang ldan par sgoms: hūm̐: rta mchog khro rgyal 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sku: spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang bdag gtum po sogs: go cha 'jig rten gsum mgon dbang bskur bas: lta ba shes rab snying po'i mthu ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā ma hā bha lo ka ru ṇa swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gu ru mtshan brgyad thogs la: gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas shes brgyad gnas su dag ste lam brgyad mtha' ru phyin: mngon shes drug dang bden gnyis mngon du gyur: rjes dran drug dang thabs shes gnyis kyi bden pa thob: dur khrod brgyad dang gnas brgyad kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rtag tu bskyang : he ru ka brgyad kyi dbang rtags thon par sgoms shig: hūm̐: pad+ma 'byung gnas pad+ma sam+bha wa: blo ldan mchog sred pad+ma rgyal po sogs: lhun grub rig 'dzin bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: lam bzhi grol nas rgyud bzhi smin par shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa tsa tur hūm̐ swā hā: oṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: nyi ma 'od zer shākya seṅge dang : seṅge sgra sgrogs rdo rje gro bo lod: mu stegs tshar gcod bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: phrin nas rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul bar shog: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sarba hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang chen ltar bsam lhun gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum so sor kha phral nas bskur ba zur du gsal/ 'bring po'i lugs su bskur na skabs 'dir rtsa ba gcig dril ltar thog mar bde chen zhing gi lha dbang nas bzung mthar chags su bskur ba yin te/

de ltar na thog mar o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces 'og ma kun la rigs 'gres/ ༈ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo 'od dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lus can sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: mnyam bzhag skyil krung bde stong lham mer bzhugs: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyan ras gzigs thogs la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: dbyings phyug dkar mo bde stong zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje sems dpa' thogs la: hrīḥ zhe sdang rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dung mdog snang stong spyan ma sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen 'byung ldan thogs la: hrīḥ nga rgyal rnam dag bcom ldan rin chen 'byung : gser mdog bde stong mā kī sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ rat+na sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: snang ba mtha' yas thogs la: hrīḥ 'dod chags rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: zangs mdog grags stong gos dkar pang du 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ don yod grub pa thogs la:

hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag bcom ldan don yod grub: mthing mdog tshor stong dam tshig sgrol ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ karma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas shar phyogs bde chen rgyal po'i tshom bu la: ༈ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p bde chen rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dmar smug mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ ma hā su ṣa rā dza hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: zung 'jug gsang ba'i ye shes sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho bi shwa dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sar gnas rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin sku: dkar gsal chags med nyi zla'i dngos grub 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon dga'i rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra badz+ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phyag rgya rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: lho ru phyag rgya rig 'dzin chen po'i sku: ser gsal skyon bral mthing 'od 'bar ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dpal ldan rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra rat+na hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: nub tu tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku: dmar gsal bde stong rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril:

de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: pad brtsegs rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra pad+ma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lhun grub rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku: ljang gsal skye med las kyi mkha' 'gro 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra karma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas lho phyogs su o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i tshom bu ni: ༈ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ bud+dha a bhi dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dkar po rdo rje'i rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: byams pa tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rat+na thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser mo rig 'dzin rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: snying rje tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ rat+na ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma'i rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ pad+ma ma li ta hrīḥ

a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: karma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ljang gu las kyi rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ karma ma li ta hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas nub phyogs o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi tshom bu ni: ༈ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: mtsho skyes rdo rje skye 'chi gdod nas dag: rgya gar rig 'dzin pan chen cha lugs 'chang : deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sangs rgyas spyan ma thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lha mo yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sa yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ badz+ra ra ti mum̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mā ma kī thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lha mo yum chen mā ma kī: sku mdog ser mo rin chen rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ra ti lām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gos dkar mo thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lha mo yum chen gos dkar mo: sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ rā ga ra ti pām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dam tshig sgrol ma thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lha mo yum chen dam tshig sgrol: sku mdog ljang mo karma rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog:

om̐ pradz+nyā ra ti tām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas byang phyogs su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshom ni: ༈ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p rdo rje phag mo thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed pa'i yum: dbu ma 'khor lo'i sgo 'byed rigs bdag brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'pho ba 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra yo gi ni ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' spyod rdo rje'i rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dkar mo zhi ba'i 'od zer ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ha badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: sa spyod rig 'dzin rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ser mo rgyas pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ri rat+na ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ka dag 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ni pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: tshogs spyod karma las kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ljang mo dgyes pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: myur lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su+u gsol: sa karma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas dngos gzhi rtsa ba'i smad las drag po'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni:

phyi mchod rjes su gnang ba'i mgo ru btsud par lha tshom gyi rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong de bsdus na dug lnga dang dug gsum ste: de dag zhi bar byed pa la phrin las lha gzhung gi dbang ste: thog mar dbus kyi tshom bu las: ༈ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p pad+ma rgyal po yab yum thogs te: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang sdud 'dod rgu'i dpal yon can: sku mdog dmar snum dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: tshe la dbang zhing mchog gi rig 'dzin gter: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi rjes chags can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i 'ja' lus stsal du gsol: om̐ ā yur ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rigs las rdo rje'i brda skad sgrog: zhi 'dzum mdzes pas skye 'gro'i snang ba 'gugs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dod yon longs spyod gter la dbang sgyur shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī su khaṃ dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: shar phyogs la sogs lha yi dpal 'byor sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der stsol cig: om̐ badz+ra ku le a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: lho phyogs la sogs mi yi mnga' thang sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid 'thob par shog: om̐ ku le shaṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: nub phyogs la sogs klu yi longs spyod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bang mdzod 'dod rgur 'du ba'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ku le hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byang phyogs karma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: byang phyogs la sogs gnod sbyin tshe bsod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dang dpal 'byor stsol: om̐ ku po ti a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas shar phyogs kyi o rgyan sman lha'i tshom bu ni: ༈ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p seṅge sgra sgrogs thogs la: hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod bcom ldan seṅge'i sgra: nyon mongs pham mdzad rdo rje phag mo 'khril:

deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'byung bzhi'i nad kyi bar chad zhi bar shog: om̐ singha ghaṇ+ḍe ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rigs bdag sman bla thogs la: hūm̐: baiḍūr mdangs ldan 'chi med bcud 'dzin lha: tshe 'phrang bar gcod rgol ba zhi mdzad phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skyob par shog: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar gyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dkar mo nyi zla dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lho yi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: mi yi yul las bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ser mo ri rab dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkhris pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: nub kyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: klu yi yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dmar mo lang tsho'i dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bad kan nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byang gi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ljang mo srid gsum dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dus pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas lho phyogs dkyil 'khor tshom bu o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi dbang bskur ba la: ༈ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo gsang bdag thogs la:

hūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: gnam lcags shugs 'chang spyi bor khyung gis brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rnam rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: brtan pa rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra bī dza ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mi g.yo ba thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ kro ta a tsa le a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: stobs po che thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbang phyug stobs chen gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi chod rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ ma hā bha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbyug sngon thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas nub phyogs kyi tshom bu o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p dregs pa zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag srid gsum stobs 'dus sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dbang bskur ro:

om̐ artsig nirtsig a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ sum+bha rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gshin rje gshed thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: oṃ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rta mgrin thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbyug pa sngon po thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ daṇ+ḍa dh+wika a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas byang phyogs su dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu las o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo stobs ldan he ru ka thogs la: hūm̐: khrag 'thung nag po stobs ldan he ru kaḥ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad spyi bor bya khyung brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan lha srin gtso bo'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e dza bh+yoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

de nas shar phyogs lha'i sde dpon thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ a rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gshin rje thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ya rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ma mo thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: ma mo'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ma rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bdud thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ du rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: shar lho sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar lho'i dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ru rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: btsan thogs la: hūm̐: lho nub sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: lho nub dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ tsa rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnod sbyin thogs la: hūm̐: nub byang sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub byang dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ sha rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: klu thogs la: hūm̐: byang shar sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni:

klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang shar dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ nā rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gza' thogs la: hūm̐: steng phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gza' yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ rā hu rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dam can thogs la: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: dam can dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ sā dhu rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: 'di nyid dregs pa'i srog dbang du kha sgyur bya na: lha yi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: a sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes kha bsgyur zhing dam chu sbyin no: sa ma ya: de ltar drag po'i phrin las gzhung gi las tshogs sgrub pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs te: 'di ni gzhung gi rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas phrin las so so'i cha lag gam: sbas yul dang gnas chen bgrod pa'i tshe las tshogs yan lag gi dbang ni: sgrub pa gsum pa'i lha tshom las: thog mar gnas chen gang du bgrod kyang lha 'drer dam bsgrag: bar du sgo dbye rten 'brel rnam bzhi: de'i bar chad bsgral ba drag po gro lod bcas: de dag gi mthun rkyen chos skyong dgos te: chos skyong ni so so'i bka' gtad spyi gzhung du 'jug pa'o: sa ma ya: thog mar nyi ma 'od zer gyi lha tshom ni: ༈ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyegs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p nyi ma 'od zer yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: dmar gsal tsha zer zhags pa'i 'od 'byin pa: khro gnyer gtum mo zung 'jug sku la 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la:

o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer dbang bskur ro: om̐ sūr+ya rasmis a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags kyus gnam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long zhags pas gnam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags sgrog gnam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long dril bus nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas rin chen gter rgya bkrol ba o rgyan yi dam lha'i tshom bu gro lod kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yi dam gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: dmar nag stag zhon spyi bor thod phreng brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan yi dam lha yi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kro ta lo ka sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje rig ma thogs la:

hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags kyu'i lde mig zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen rig ma thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen rin chen rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zhags pa'i lde mig rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen pad+ma'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags sgrog lde mig dbang gi las mdzod cig: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen las kyi rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dril bu'i lde mig drag po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

sa ma ya: de nas spyir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su skal ldan las can gang la la'i rigs rnams sbas yul nags rong dben par snyegs pa'i tshe: o rgyan gzhi bdag srung ma dang : gar ging rig ma bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan ldan pa'i grogs bgyid par byed pa'i lha'i tshom bu ste: ༈ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thog mar o rgyan snang srid zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: skye 'chi gnyis spangs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje'i lus la gzhom zhig bral ba'i sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo ging gi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu ru om̐ ṭa ya na ra ka ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: mā ra ti kar tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: 'ja' lus nam mkha'i dbang phyug dbang mo yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog tu brnyes par shog: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ye shes mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: zab gsang 'khor lo'i dbang mo yid bzhin gter: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rtag tu gsang sngags rgyun gyis phyug par shog: om̐ dz+nyā na dzi wan mu ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dpa' bo thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bor rnam par sprul: bde chen rig 'dzin dbang bsgyur mkha' la shar: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpa' bo rgya mtsho mchog gi ded dpon shog: om̐ tshan+dha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen cha shas mdzes byed yid 'phrog rigs: brda 'gros mkha' la 'gyu ba'i gar stabs can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zab lam bde ba'i rtse dgar rol bar shog:

om̐ ma hā mu tra la hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gar ma'i dbang ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mdzes ma'i cha shas rdzogs: bde ba'i rol rtsed dga' ba'i dpal yon can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der thob shog: om̐ ḍāk+ki pad+ma mu ṭa hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ging thogs la: hūm̐: rgod pa'i nyams kyis dpa' ba'i mdangs chags g.yo: dga' ma'i bzhin 'dzin zil bus yid rab phyung : deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bcu drug khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dga' ston shog: om̐ dha sha ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dbang zur du bskur skabs gong gi mtshan brgyad nas 'dir 'jug pas chog /dpa' bo yab yum dang ging yab yum thogs la: dpa' bo yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas yul brgyad kyi rtog pa bcom: dur khrod brgyad kyi dpa' bo rig 'dzin thams cad dbang du bsdus te he ru ka yab yum brgyad kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur par mos: ging chen yab yum brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: rngam pa'i brjid dang rol pa'i gar sgyur ba: gtum pa'i gyad dang gshe ba'i shugs la sogs: rtsal bcu dang nus pa brgyad la sogs pa dbang bar sgoms shig: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: dpa' bo dpa' mo ging chen yab yum bcas: he ru ka yis gnas bcu byin brlabs pa'i: dbang bskur yon tan bcu drug la gnas shog: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha ghṛ wa ghṛ wa hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lha mo bcu drug thogs la: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gi dbang bskur bas phyi'i snang ba dbang du 'dus shing dbang bsgyur: nang gi stong nyid bcu drug gnad du phyin: gsang ba'i thig le bcu drug brtan par chags shing rtsa rlung pho nya bcu drug gi ljon shing bskyed de 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang lam la dbang bar bsgom mo: hūm̐: bzhi gnyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad bcu drug khams:

g.yo ba rtsa gnyis yang g.yo drug cu bzhi: mchod 'dzin lha mo rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: gsung dbyangs drug cus 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki sarba ud ta rā ga he hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang phyug zhing skyong laṅka thogs la: hoḥ dbang phyug zhing skyong laṅka gnas nyul rnams kyi dbang bskur bas dbang phyug yan lag bdun ldan 'phags pa'i nor dang bcas shing : rdzu 'phrul la mnga' ba'i dbang mo bran du bgyis te zhing khams skyong zhing dbang bskur bas phyogs bcu'i bstan pa skyong : laṅka'i dbang bskur bas gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul bar he ru ka la nges: gnas nyul lam sgo skyong ngam mu ran skyong ba'i dbang thob pas phyi nang sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal zhing : phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong nang gi dngos grub phyi la mi skyel bar: sgom dang rtogs pa che chung gi ru shan phye ba'i dus nyul ma'i rnal 'byor gyi drod tshad nyul ba ste: lta ba'i grogs byed rtogs pa'i bogs 'don sgrub pa'i gegs sel bar sgoms shig: hūm̐: dbang phyug ma mau zhing skyong laṅka gdong : gnas nyul tshogs khang 'grims shing drod tshad nyul: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i las byed dbang bskur bas: skal ldan sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi bar shog: oṃ badz+ra iṣ+ṭa dwa ra bha la hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas chas dbang sbyin pa ni: de nas chas dbang bskur ba la khyed rang rnams kyis gdan gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la: che rtags kyis mnga' gsol bas don gnyis lhun grub khams sum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang dam pa thob par mos shig /hoḥ khyod la pad zhwa'i dbang bskur bas snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon par sgoms: phod kha'i dbang bskur bgyis pas dregs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon par sgoms: chos gos kyi dbang bskur bas theg chen gyi mdzod la dbang bsgyur bar sgoms:

ber chen gyi dbang bskur bas srid gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus nas rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mchog tu gyur par sgoms: rin chen rgyan cha'i dbang bskur bas 'dod yon lnga'i gter la spyod par sgoms: sku reg gi dbang bskur bas thabs shes zung 'jug mkha' 'gro'i rtags su sgoms: rgya lham gyi dbang bskur bas bdud dang dam sri kun gyi mgo bo non par sgoms: hūm̐: pad zhwa phod kha chos gos ber chen dang : rin chen rgyan mdzes sku reg rgya lham sogs: sku yi chas gos du ma'i dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su mnga' sgyur cig: oṃ sarba bhi shwa bha tra swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phyag mtshan rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas sku lnga ye shes kyi don dang ldan par sgoms: bhan+dha tshe bum gyi dbang bskur bas chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shing 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob par sgoms shig: kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi dbang bskur bas dug lnga rtsad nas bcad cing dug gsum nyid sku gsum gyi 'bras bur mngon du gyur par sgoms: hūm̐: rdo rje rtse lnga bhan+dha tshe bum dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yer kha thod pa gsum gyis mtshan: sku yi rgya rtags las kyi phyag mtshan gyi: dbang bskur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dharma ko3 haṃ dz+nyā na swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas zhi ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyan spyod thogs la: deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la chas dbang lus la brgyan pa yin te: rigs lnga'i dbang gis sku lnga lhun gyis grub: cod pan gyi dbang gis ye shes pa'i rgya rtags 'dzin: stod g.yogs kyi dbang gis sa bcu'i go 'phang thob: ang rag gi dbang gis sa lam thogs med du bgrod: ga shal gyi dbang gis gsang sngags nye lam ldan: rin chen phreng ba dang rgyan gyis 'dod rgu'i gter la longs spyod: pad+ma'i phreng bas skyon gyis ma gos pa'i yon tan ldan pa ste: de ltar zhi ba'i lha rdzas yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur bas:

thugs rje'i rang rtsal gyi dbang thob par sgoms shig: hūm̐: rigs lnga dar dpyangs stod g.yogs ga shal dang : ang rag rin chen rgyan cha pad+ma'i phreng : zhi ba'i lha rdzas yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: zhing khams lta bur mkho dgu longs spyod shog: oṃ sarba mu ṭa ku su me ku su ma ṇi hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas drag po'i chas thogs te/ de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog thod phreng drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/ dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du brgyan pas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rje bor bskur/ dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: thod skam dbu rgyan glang ko zhing lpags dang : rdo rje'i go khrab rus rgyan stag lpags dang : mgo phreng sbrul chun khrag zhag thal chen tshom: me dpung dang ni srung 'khor bcas pa gtad: bdud 'dul dpal gyi cha lugs yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ kro ta kro ta kro ti tsaṇ+ḍa sha ma sha na kan thi ka sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas khyed rang rnams la las bzhi'i phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'i ched du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phyag mtshan lag tu gtad pa la brten nas phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i 'gro don thogs pa med par spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas las bzhi'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhi: dkyil 'khor rang rang sa bon phyag mtshan bcas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rgyan dang sa bon phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ sarba hri hri hūm̐ kin+tha ka badz+ra tig+na bhan+dha ye sarba hoḥ de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/

dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa la bhan+dha 'di nyid phyi ltar na snod dung khang gi gzhal yas khang : gsang ba ḍāk+ki 'bum gyi tshogs khang gis mtshon: nang ltar na bcud 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma ste ngo bo rlung lnga'i rang bzhin 'byin 'jug gi byed las thugs rje'i thabs kyis bskul ba'i rang mdangs la: shes rab rol pa'i snang ngor sgyu ma mkhan gyis gar bsgyur ba ltar spro bsdu'i rnam par mtshon pa: bskur bya'i dbang du byas na gsung bhan+dha'i dbang bskur: grol bya'i dbang du gyur na mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol: 'thob bya'i dbang du byas na 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'grub pa de ltar du mos pa gyis shig: hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen snang srid 'byung ba'i snod: snod bcud gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki mchog: bde gshegs kun 'dus longs sku'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des bhan+dha chos dbyings yangs par: sngags dang bzlas brjod thams cad gsung dbyangs ā li kā li drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rang sgras gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i snyan brgyud thams cad dgongs pa chig rdzogs kyis sa lam mngon par rdzogs pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar/ sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor bas 'od zer 'ja' 'od thig le'i rang bzhin rang sgra dang bcas 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis bzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:

badz+ra gu ru? thod phreng rtsal? hri ma ha ri? de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing*/ brjod med grags stong gsung gi rdo rje mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang bsgyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du phreng ba thogs la: hoḥ phreng ba 'di nyid skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i pad+ma'i phreng ba ste: sngags phreng ba'i rnam pa: 'od zer phreng thag gi rnam pa: bzlas pa bgyis pa'i tshe bung ba rtsi'i bcud la ro myong ba lta bur rang sngags rang sgra sgrog cing spro bsdu phrin las bzhi lhun grub kyi ngo bor nges shes gyis la mnyam par zhog mdzod: hūm̐: bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: snying po'i 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs pa'i phyir: bzlas pa rdo rje'i phreng ba gtad: dri med pad+ma lug gur rgyud: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta sarba swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po la longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par gyur/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang snying khar bskur ba ni: gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bor me long dang g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin/ dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: snang zhing gsal la stong zhing 'gag pa med:

gsal la nam mkha'i rang bzhin khor yug ltar: chos sku rdzogs chen thugs rje'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag /de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas yon tan gtor ma'i dbang lte bar bskur ba la: gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba ni thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje'i thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: rmad byung gtor ma bla med mchog gi rdzas: ngo bo 'dod yon mtshan nyid lha rnams kyi: dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma'i yon tan gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med par mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/

zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas rdo rje dril bu gtad de: bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin/ phrin las sna tshogs kyi 'byung gnas thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i rgyu las byung ba yin te/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ngo sprod ma 'gags dril bu shes rab kyi sgra ste/ de la phrin las rnam bzhi'i las mtha' 'dzin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag rgya gtad pa la brten nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyal ba'i phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rdo rje rgyal po thabs kyi mgon mchog nyid: shes rab drug ldan yan lag bcu gnyis sogs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig phrin las kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pas/ khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra/ tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje'i rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me long dang lha sku thogs la/ hūm̐: snang ba bden med nam mkha' bzhin: sna tshogs cho 'phrul rang sar dang : nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'ja' tshon bzhin: sprul pa sgyu ma ltar bstan no: oṃ swa bhā ko'u ta paṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin par ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pas dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim par bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rtsa gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ rtsa ba gnyis pa gzhung las/ ye shes la rlung gi dbang : bde chen la thig le'i dbang : mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhes dbang gong ma gsum gyi dang po gsang dbang ni/ gzhung las/ dbu ma rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug gi dbang : bde chen thig le srog 'dzin bcu drug dbang : rlung lnga brgyad pa 'phro 'du phrin las dbang : ye shes lnga ni kun byed rgyal po'i dbang : phyag rgya drug ni bca' ba 'khrul 'khor dbang : a haṃ 'bar 'dzag gtum mo me yi dbang : zung 'jug lnga ldan thabs lam pho nya'i dbang : sbyor ba bzhi ldan man ngag btsan thabs dbang : bdun 'khor gsum pa man ngag rgya mtsho'i dbang : bcu po 'di ni gsang dbang chen mo'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang dbang bka' rgya ma zhes bya ba yin la/ sngar bdag cag gi bka' drin mtshungs med 'khor lo'i mgon po gu ru sūr+ya rasmi nas bka' drin thob pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong yang*/ da char dpe rgyun yang ma rnyed cing*/ slad rnyed par gyur na 'dir bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/

'dir gsang sher dbang bde chen 'khor lo zab lam ye shes drwa ba ltar/ gzungs ma lha bskyed nas bzung dbang bzhi zur gsal ltar skabs 'dir sbyar bas chog /spyi tsam du/ 'dir gsang dbang spyi tsam bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi shes rab ma dang*/ yang mo rgyud lta bur gtso mo rang 'od kyi thabs dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang bde ba'i 'od zer gyis rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snyoms par zhugs/ bde ba chen po'i rgyun gtso bo yab yum gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang 'dres pa mkha' gsang nas babs te/ pad+ma bhañja'i snod du bskyil ba/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin par myong bas lus thams cad bde bas khyab/ snang gsum 'od gsal du thim/ rtsa thig rlung gsum ye shes su smin par mos mdzod/ ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: spros bral rang byung bhan+dha ru: dam tshig bla med rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma yab yum ngo bo nyid: dbang bskur longs sku'i rtsal ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍāk+ki muṃ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca muṃ: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ bdud rtsi myong bas rtsa thams cad byang sems yi ge'i sprin ā li kā li'i rnam pas khengs te/ 'ching byed kyi mdud pa bkrol/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs 'gags/ thig rlung 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ ngag rlung tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog dang ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ rdzogs rim a nu la brten pa'i steng sgo rnam grol gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi rigs su skyes/ sgra skad 'byin 'jug sngags su dag la 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/

/gnyis pa sher dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las rnam par 'phrul pa'i shes rab kyi rig ma dang*/ yang gtso mo'i yab las rnam par 'phrul pa'i thabs mchog dpa' bo/ gzugs dang lang tsho ldan zhing rigs kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa zhig byung ste slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon nam g.yas pas pho mo'i khyad par/ khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas sam g.yon du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dpang du bkod de gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren zungs: dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar yab yum 'du shes gsum gyis snyom par zhugs pas/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i 'phro 'du bde chen gyi dbyings su nub ste/ yas babs kyi dga' ba nyams su myong*/ slar dmar cha dang bcas pa'i rlung 'pho med gyen du drangs pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lhan skyes bde stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtog tshogs tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa sbyangs shing yid sgrib dag /rdzogs rim a nu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam nas lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu gnyis pa phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin gyi rigs su skyes/ bde sdug gang byung lhan skyes kyi ye shes su dag ste 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /de nas dbang thams cad kyi mthar thug bskur bya bskur byed las 'das pa tshig dbang rin po che/ brda dang byin gyis brlabs pas stobs kyis ngo sprod pa yin pas khyed rang tshos sgo gsum rang babs su lhod kyis klod la/

dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i da lta'i sems skad cig ma'i steng du/ rtsol sgrub bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i ngang du 'bol le shig ge zhog mdzod/ ces me shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de nas tshig dbang rin po che'i ngo sprod rnam gsum bstan pa ni: hoḥ snang zhing stong pa'i chos thams cad brtag dpyad 'dzin gzhig dang bral bar cir snang bdag med du bor te snang stong gi ngo bor ltos la mnyam par zhog cig: 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi: phyi nang snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun: snang yang bdag 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha yi sku: zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ de nas rol mo'i rigs bzhi thogs la: hoḥ de ltar sgra thams cad grags stong brag cha 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i rang skad ltar thos so cog gi tshig la rtog tshogs kyis 'dzin pa ma zhugs par: pi waṃ dang gling bu ltar shes par gyis la rang bzhin so ma mnyam par zhog cig: 'di ltar rna ba'i yul du grags pa yi: snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pa'i sgra rnams kun: grags stong bsam mno bral ba'i ngang la zhog: grags stong skye 'gag med pa rgyal ba'i gsung : zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ de nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag la sdigs mdzub gtad de: hoḥ dbyings kyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa: ngo bo ka nas dag pa: rnam pa shugs las dag pa ste: de ni mkha' la sgro ma btags par phyam gyis gnas pa ltar: bum pa chag pa'i nam mkha' dang nam mkhas khyab pa'i bum nang ltar ris su ma chad cing phyogs su ma lhung : a 'thas su ma 'byams: had po mdo med ma yin par: dmigs bya blo las 'das pa: dmigs med kyi rang rtsal las cir yang 'char ba:

shar mkhan gdod nas stong pa: stong pa rtsal chen gyi shugs 'chang ba: bzang pos ma bsgyur: ngan pas ma bslad par: gzhon nu kun byed rgyal po zhes rgyus ma bsdus rkyen gyis mi 'jig: gzugs med rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs la 'chang ba zhes bya ba: mi bden bzhin du 'gyu ba 'di ni rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i rig pa yin pas: dgag sgrub lhan pa dang bral ba'i so mar zhog cig: 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang : sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol: zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ des tshig dbang rin po che'i ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad a ti bla med theg pa'i yang rtse: bsgom bya'i yul dang sgom byed kyi gnyen por shar grol dus mnyam du rtogs pa blo 'das kyi ngo bo la dbang bar byas so: de ltar bzhag pa'i tshe rig pa gsal stong rjen par nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'dzin zhen med par khregs se gnas pa ni/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ma bcos rang byung gi lta ba yin no/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog dang yid shes kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la dbang*/ sa bcu drug pa lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi rigs su skyes shing rig pa grol gzhir thim te 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /de nas mtha' rten gyi dbang la/ nya stong dus bzhi'i mchod pa nar mar bgyid pa'i bka' gtad cing rjes su gnang ba 'di rnams bum dbang gi mtha' rten du byas kyang chog la/ 'dir dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi rjes su byas kyang 'thus pas ci bde bar bskur ro/ gang ltar yang*/ rtsa tho las/

phyi mchod lha mo bskyed rim gzugs kyi dbang*/ /glu ma gar ma grags stong sgra yi dbang*/ /thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen ka dag dbang*/ /sgrol dbang dug lnga rtsad gcod lam khyer dbang*/ /bdud rtsi sman raka gtor ma phrin las bzhi/ /bdud rtsi lnga ldan nad gdon zhi ba'i dbang*/ /sman mchog kun ldan 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dbang*/ /rak+ta bcud bzang khams gsum dbang sdud dbang*/ /bha ling zur gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phyi nang gsang gsum sman raka gtor ma dang bcas pa'i dbang rim gyis phul ba la brten nas snang grags rig pa rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su rang dbang 'byor/ las bzhi lhun gyi grub pa'i phrin las rab 'byams kyi gnyer kha gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rtag tu nya stong dus bzhi sogs mchod pa nar ma'i lung 'bog pa ni: de nas phyi mchod gtad la: hūm̐: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo dbyangs len sogs: dkyil 'khor phyi yi mchod pa 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra pū dza me gha s+pha rā sa ma ye swā hā: 'dod yon lnga gtad la: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri dang ni: ro mchog reg bya'i bye brag rnams: dgyes pa bcu drug lha mo'i gar: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ bhi shwa mi tra swā hā: de nas nang mchod las dang po sman thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar 'di: dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes sman: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud skye 'gro gtor mar bsgyur: 'bru bcud sna tshogs gtor ma'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bha ling+ta swā hā: de nas rak+ta thogs la: hūm̐: skye med rnam dag mkha' lam nas: ra sa me gha rak+ta mo: rgyud 'byung ngad ldan dmar chen 'di:

de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ āḥhūm̐ rak+ta pū dza hoḥ de nas gsang mchod las dang po sbyor mchod gtad la: hūm̐ lnga ldan thabs kyi rdo rje dang : shes rab yum gyi pad+mo'i mkhar: zag med bde bas dgyes pa nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma pañca ti ri hūm̐: de nas phyag rgya'i mchod pa gtad la: hūm̐: ang grol lus kyi phyag rgya'i gar: bā+ai ta chos kyi phyag rgyas brgyan: bhan+dha dam tshig phyag rgya 'chang : de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma hā mu tra rā ga he sha hūm̐: de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gtad la: hūm̐: he ru ka yi nyams 'gyur las: mnyam bzhag dgongs pa sa gnon can: bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gsal stong ngang : de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir tshogs mchod la sogs rjes su gnang ba yin pas/ dang po/ dkon mchog mchod pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dbang : gnyis pa bskang ba nyams chag sor chud dbang : gsum pa bshags pa lan chags mi 'khor dbang : bzhi pa bsgral ba nga bdag rtsad gcod dbang : lnga pa zhal bstab rtog med ro snyom dbang : drug pa lhag ma gnas nyul 'gyed pa'i dbang : drug po 'di ni tshogs bsags dbang zhes so: zhes gsungs pa bzhin dbang drug bskur ba la brten nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ nyams pa sor chud/ bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod/ mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i yon tan rgyud la skyes/ las dang 'jig rten sogs snang srid rang dbang bsgyur ba'i phrin las thogs pa med pa'i mthu grub par mos mdzod/

de nas tshogs mchod gtad la: hūm̐: bsod nams rgyu las legs byung ba: sna tshogs bzang ngan gtsang sme bral: mnyam pa nyid kyi mchod pa 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra sa ma ye swā hā: de nas dza gad gser skyems tshogs chang gtad la: hūm̐: bla med nang gi mchod pa'i tshogs: zag med bde ba'i dgyes pa 'di: dngos grub rtsa ba bla na med: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ de nas bskang rdzas spyan gzigs gtad la: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byed pa: phyi nang nyams chag bskang ba dang : nyes ltung bshags pa'i khrigs sdeb sogs: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su ra hūm̐: de nas bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: dug lnga dbyings su rab bsgral bas: dbang po rnam lnga dgyes pa'i phud: gnyis 'dzin ru tra'i bsgral mchod 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas mu ran skyong ba'i lhag ma ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i mtha' nas 'gyu: rnal 'byor stangs 'byed drod tshad nyul: de la lhag ma sbyin pa'i phyir: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma tri mu ṣa ye swā hā: rjes shes rjes 'debs las mtha' yongs rdzogs kyi dbang las/ chad tho lag tu gtad pas dam tshig 'brel ba'i mna' chad/ brtan ma lag tu gtad pas rnal 'byor lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs shing bka' las mi 'da' ba/ de rnams bstan skyong gi bka' gtad cing rjes su gnang ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig / de nas chad tho sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di: ci ltar bka' bzhin tha tshig skyong : gter srung mchod pa'i gtor ma 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ni dhi pā la swā hā: hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bstan skyong gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rten 'brel bcu gnyis dus bdag ma: bod khams skyong phyir brtan ma sman:

de dag dgyes par mchod pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma tri ma ma le le hūm̐ dzaḥ chos skyong kyi srog gtad zur du gsal lo/ de nas mtha' rten tshe yi dbang bskur ba ni/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la tshe bum gyi dbang bskur bas: deng phyin chad 'chi med bsgrub pa la dbang zhing tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par sgoms: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang mtha' dbang phyug rje btsun pad+ma 'byung : tshe 'dzin lha mo mgyogs ma sgo bzhis bskor: snang srid 'byung lnga nyi zla tshe bcud bcas: bsdus nas skal ldan slob ma'i lus la bstim: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas mtha' rgyas bkra shis par byed pa slob ma mnga' gsol gyi rim pa dang*/ thog mar chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po'i bka' gtad cing lung 'bogs/ bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad sna bdun sogs 'bul la mnga' gsol ba'o/ de nas dang po chos kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ po ti gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la po ti glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis wā rā ṇā si dang bya rgod phung ri sogs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan bzhin rgyal po dzā la gsang sngags kyi bka' bab pa ltar/ deng rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la chos 'chad spel gyis shig ces bka'i gnang ba thob par mos shig hūm̐: yang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams: lha dang mi dang lha ma yin: chos bstan de bzhin khyod la gtad: om̐ dharma mi kha te swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas snyan grags kyi dung dkar gtad la: hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar phul bas snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs bcur bsgrengs te/ rdo rje theg chen gyi chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa bzhin du khyed rang rnams la dung dkar phyag tu gtad pas bka'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs dam pa'i tshul dgus gzhan don dpag tu med pa mdzad par bskul ba'i gnang ba thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig

hūm̐: dga' ldan lha las babs pa'i theg chen sgra: dam pas srol gtod mdzad pa snyan pa'i dung : chos kyi rnga chen sgrog par bskul ba pos: de ring skal ldan khyod la bskor bar bskur: oṃ badz+ra dharma shaṃ kha la swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rin po che'i 'khor lo gtad la: hoḥ sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lha tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo phul ba'i rten 'brel la brten nas chos kyi 'khor lo brgyad khri bzhi stong bskor ba bzhin du/ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas 'gro ba gang 'dul la der ston gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed nus pa'i dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig oṃ: rin chen las grub gser gyi 'khor lo ni: rtsibs stong mu khyud khor yug bsgribs nas su: mdo sngags sgron me sbar ba'i ched du sbyin: dam pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ swa na tsakra sa le sbraṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas nor bu rin po che gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la nor bu'i dbang bskur bas sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la klu'i rgyal pos nor bu phul bas chos thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar/ gang gis mchod gnas bgyis kyang de la dngos grub de ltar 'byin pa bzhin du chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong byang sems thig le nyag gcig ltar dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: yid bzhin nor bu lhun grub 'od rab 'byin: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla med rdzogs pa che'i: zab lam snyan brgyud nges don sa kun rdzogs: rin chen lag bcang lta bu khyod la sbyin: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na trām̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen gzhong pa gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la rin po che'i gzhong pa'i dbang bskur bas sngon ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gnod sbyin gyi rgyal pos rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i gzhong pa/

bse ru spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan/ nor bu me shel me'i snying po/ chu shel chu'i snying po/ thabs rgyal po'i rna cha/ shes rab btsun mo'i rna cha/ zung 'jug blon po'i rna cha/ rgyal po'i bla rten glang chen mche ba/ btsun mo'i bla rten byi ru dbang gi rgyal mo/ blon po la mu tig sna lnga'i phreng ba bcas maṇ+ḍal phul bas chos thams cad 'dzam gling gi mdzod kha phye ba ltar/ gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pas spyod yul du gyur pa bzhin du/ de ring gling bzhi chos kyi rgyal srid gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rgyal po lta bur thabs kyi chos rnams ni: blon po lta bur phra zhib nyams su myong : shes rab btsun mo yon tan rgyan gyis phyug: phyi nang gsang gsum deng 'dir khyod la sbyin: oṃ sarba badz+ra prañja hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun lag tu sprad nas/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas rgyal srid ni/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal pos srid spel/ btsun mos kha lo bsgyur/ blon pos bu nor rgyas/ nor bus bsam don 'grub/ glang po che rtsal shugs che/ rta mchog bang mgyogs/ dmag dpon gyis sgo srung zhing phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ de bzhin du bkra shis pa'i rdzas dbu la bkra shis gser gdugs/ spyan la gser nya/ snyan la dung dkar/ ljags la pad+ma/ mgul la bum pa/ thugs la dpal be'u/ spyi bor mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan/ lag la chos kyi 'khor lo sogs bkra shis pa'i chas thams cad phul nas/ gsang sngags rlabs po che'i dbang khrid zhu bar byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi gnang ba gtad pas deng phyin chod maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa 'bul bar gyis shig hūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun dgos 'dod yid bzhin mdzod: bkra shis rtags brgyad mthar thug dge ba'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis:

rdo rje slob dpon rtag tu bsnyen bskur gyis: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal maṅga laṃ shrī ye swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de dag gis dbang bzhi'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin pas mkha' dbyings gang ba'i lha rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas/ bden tshig gi shes pa brjod cing me tog gi char chen po bsnyil bas dbang gi byin rlabs gong du 'phel zhing nyams med brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: stag zhon rdo rje gro bo lod: bkra shis khye'u 'dren mtshan ldan lcam: drag po yab yum bkra shis shog: mchims phur bde gshegs sgrub pa mdzad: grub thob rgyal po zil gnon zhabs: zung 'jug dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal ma: rig 'dzin yab yum bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i gnas mchog gter gyi sgrom: mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang : dregs sde srung mas bya ra mdzod: chos skyong gter srung bkra shis shog: de nas mtha' ma phan yon bstan pa la/ dbang bskur thob pa dang dam tshig mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung na phan yon che ba'i tshul yang*/ gter gzhung las/ lus gus pas byin rlabs 'jug: ngag gis gsol ba btab pas bden tshig 'grub: yid gdung ba skyes pas nyams rtogs 'bar: sgo gsum tha mal du ma song na thugs rje dang nus pa rab tu gnas: maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pas rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags: 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs smin: dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pas chos la dbang bsgyur ba'i ded dpon du 'byung : bkra shis dang smon lam thob pas skye ba dang tshe rabs su bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i mi lus kyang thob nas 'phro mtha' chos kyis bsu: lhag pa'i lha dang mjal: skye ba ngan pas bar mi gcod: lha dang drang srong sogs kyi rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro:

mu stegs dang bdud kyi dbang du nam yang mi 'gro bar 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pas don la nges pa rnyed nas dga' ba sgoms shig /de nas dam tshig gi khe nyan ngo sprod la srung bya 'bogs pa ni/ hoḥ de'ang khyed rang rnams la 'dir bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs kyi sgrub pa: 'di nyid la sgrub pa rnam pa gsum ste: tshe sgrub thugs sgrub drag po'i sgrub pa'o: rtsa ba gsum yin te: bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas: yi dam dbang chen rta mgrin: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes so: 'di rigs gsum yin te: sku 'jam dpal dbyangs: gsung spyan ras gzigs: thugs phyag na rdo rje ste mdo dang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor kun tshang ba yin: de'i brda don rgyud sde chen po'i rnam bshad rgyas pa thams cad na gsal lo: 'di la dam tshig ni mdo ltar lam pa'i skabs su: ma byin pa ni len mi bya: de bzhin 'phrog dang rku ba dang : thabs kyis bslus nas blang mi bya: mi tshangs pa ni mi spyod do: sku gsung thugs kyi dam mi nyams: dam nyams grogs la 'grogs mi bya: gnas khang nyams grib byi mo spang : nyams can zas gos 'bag mi bya: rdzun du smra bar mi bya zhing : dge 'dun mthun gnyis phye ba dang : sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sel byed dang : 'khrug sdeb gzhi bzhag la sogs pa: zog por 'gro ba'i rdzun mi bya: srog ni bcad par mi bya zhing : de bzhin pham par gyur pa ni: lto gos gtam du re ba yis: sgo nor pha ma'i srog mi gcod: sgyu lus g.yar khang gnyer ba yi: lus kyis pha ma'i srog mi gcod: tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba yi: rdo rje slob dpon srog mi gcod: gnas skabs grogs su bca' ba yi: bran 'khor chung ma'i srog mi gcod: don med rnams ni lta ci smos: de bzhin mtshon gyis btab pa dang : dug dang gzhan mthus bskul ba dang : bsam sbyor tshig gis bskul ba sogs: rang gzhan kun nas las de spang :

de bzhin sangs rgyas sku la ni: ngan sems khrag ni byug mi bya: sangs rgyas rnams ni smos ci bya: chos spang las ni yongs su spang : dge 'dun sde ni dkrugs mi bya: bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos: de bzhin bla ma rdo rje 'chang : gzugs sku bsod nams tshogs las grub: don dam dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings: de bzhin gsum ldan bla ma yi: sku yi grib ma 'gom mi bya: sku gsung thugs rten 'bum 'gyur gyi: gtsug lag gnyan po bcom pa dang : bla ma'i thugs sems dkrugs pa sogs: ltung ba phog pa'i las mi bya: de bzhin mi dge bcu po dang : mtshams med mnar ba'i las sogs spang : rtogs pa mngon du ma gyur pas: thog mar dkyil 'khor zhugs pa tsam: kha bsags rang rgyud ma dul ba'i: rtog ge ba yi nyan thos rnams: nam zla dpyid kha'i ljang bu 'dra: lam 'jug de yis 'dzems par 'gyur: rdzogs chen bla med lam zhugs nas: 'bras bu theg chen rtogs pa yi: spyod pa lam khyer rnal 'byor par: bzang ngan thog rdzis byed pa'i tshe: nyan thos pa yi lam zhugs spang : rang bcing nyon mongs zhags pa bcad: de'i lam khyer 'di lta ste: ma byin pa ni len par bya: dge ba bzang por thabs kyis bskul: shugs la byung ba dngos grub yin: blos thong gzhan gyi phul ba de: ma byin bar du yang yang bslang : de la bsngo bas rgyas 'debs bya: chu yis sa khyer lta bu ste: gtsang po'i bye ma ded pa bzhin: ma byin blangs kyang nyes pa med: kun rdzob rdzun ni gang yang smra: dper na dge ba'i bskul ma las: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: dmyal ba zhing khams bstan pa dang : blo yi dpag pa'i tshad bzung dang : kun rdzob chos tshul brgyad khri bzhir: sems can khrid pa'i lam du zad: drang don rdzun gyi phung po yin: nges don dbang por bstan du med: chu bur mig gis ga la mthong : brag dang rlung sgra 'thab pa bzhin: bden rdzun gnyis kyi ngo bos stong :

rdzun du smras kyang nyes pa med: mi tshangs pa ni spyod par byed: gnas ngan dur khrod phung shul nyul: bdud dang 'dre la dam tshig bsre: mdze dme yugs sa grogs su bsten: zas su ro za ro gos gyon: gtam du gang shar nges med smra: skyid sdug bral ba'i gcer bur 'gro: ngo tsha bral ba'i smyo spyod bya: gzhan gyi bud med spyod par bya: srod la dud 'gro'i rnam 'gyur ston: nam mkha'i chu sprin rlung g.yer bzhin: bzang ngan yul med rjes med la: mi tshangs spyod kyang nyes pa med: snying rjes bsad pa'i dam tshig las: sems can nyon mongs dug lngar gyur: gti mug phag dang 'dra ba de: bsgral nas rnam shes chos skur bsgyur: zhai sdang sbrul dang 'dra ba de: las ngan bshigs pas lus ngan bral: 'dod chags bya dang 'dra ba de: sor rtogs rim gnyis dag gis bsgral: chags pa bral nas chags med yin: gang zhig lan chags bsnyags pa yis: pha ma phru gu thams cad bsad: 'khor ba chod na cis mi dge: gang phyir bdud las sdig to can: sems can yongs la gnod pa yi: las ngan gzhir bzhag de nyid bsgral: de bzhin bsgral ba'i zhing bcu rnams: rlung gis shing bcag lta bu ste: srog bcad bya la nyes pa med: sangs rgyas sku la smad pa ste: kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i thugs: khu rlangs gtibs kyang sdug ma bsngal: nyi zla gsal kyang nyams mi dga': bzang dang ngan gnyis ngo bo mnyam: nam mkha'i stong pa had po la: tshogs drug snang ba med pa'i phyir: ro dud sprin ltar gtibs pa dang : spos dud dri bsung chags pa gnyis: yang dag don la ngo bo mnyam: dus gsum sangs rgyas mdun du ni: gser gyi phung po spungs pa dang : dug gi yon chab gtams pa gnyis: chags pa med pa'i ngo bor mnyam: rnam rtog 'dzin pa grol ba la: ro ras nag pos dkris pa dang : le brgan dar dkar g.yogs pa gnyis: nges pa'i don la ngo bo mnyam: gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung rten: bshigs dang brtsegs la dga' sdug med:

rang gis bsod nams bsags pa tsam: don la bden par ma grub pas: sangs rgyas bstod dang smad pa mnyam: tshogs drug sgo khyud 'dan na gsal: rnam rtog rtsigs pa bshig na brling : 'khrul ba'i pha ma bsad na dge: ngan goms chung ma bye na mthun: ser sna'i sgo nor zad na phyug: ngar 'dzin bu rabs chad na 'phen: spang blang zad na srung sdom dben: de phyir bsrung pa'i dam tshig lnga: bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig lnga: mdo dang sngags kyi dam tshig gam: bskyed dang rdzogs pa gnyis kyi don: bskyed pa mngon sum snang ba'i ngogs: rdzogs pa 'ja' tshon lag myong ltar: de bzhin dam pas 'di rnams kyang : gang zag rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni chos sku'i rang bzhin grol: 'bring ni dam chos rim 'jug grol: tha mas bzang ngan cir mi rtogs: nyan thos theg par 'jug pa rnams: rdza yi be'u bum chag pa bzhin: slar yang gso ba ma mchis pas: mtshams med rgyu bsags spang bar gyis: gsang sngags gser dngul snod zhum yang : slar yang rang sar bzo bas legs: bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig lnga: lam khyer gnas lugs gzhi la phob: de ltar 'bras bu phyi na lci: so sor nyams len sor gnas bzhin: nges par gdams pa e ma hoḥ zhes gsungs pa bzhin spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams legs par bsrung zhing*/ dkyil 'khor 'di nyid lhag pa'i lha ru bzung ste bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po byed snyam pas dam tshig khas pa len 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che: dam pas bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung : de ltar dbang bskur ba'i slob bus slob dpon gyi dgyes pa skong dgos te/ rig pa rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /bu dang chung ma nor dang mchog /sgo gsum zol zog med pa yis/ /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar bla ma mnyes pa'i yon tan yang*/

de nyid las/ brten pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya cher spyod la skyong du gsol: de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i phyir du dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad kyis byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor yang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor thugs dam bskul ba chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya/ zhes thugs sgrub dbang chen gyi le tshan no/ de dag gis bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa 'di'ang ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lhun grub phyag chen po'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas chen/ gnod sbyin btsan rgod ber ma chen pos nye bar bsrungs pa'i bal yul yang le shod rdo rje dgu brtsegs kyi ri bo'i shar 'dabs 'khor yug bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi yol ba bres shing*/ sman shing dang me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i skyed mos tshal chen po'i dbus/

a ti'i sgom grwa sna tshogs rang grol gling du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing mo bya yi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs dpa' bo dang ḍāk+ki 'du ba'i dus khyad par can/ mar gyi tshes bcu'i dus mchod dang bstun te sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul ming shrī nā gardzu na'i ming gis bgyis pas yi ge pa ni 'phan sprul au ḍīs byas la zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur ni 'brong smyon mkhyen rab zla shar gyis mdzad pa'i dge bas snying po'i ring lugs 'di nyid 'jig rten gsum gyi tha grur khyab cing yun du gnas par gyur cig/ // (kha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gsol 'debs dngos grub snying po bzhugs so/ e ma ho/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od ma'i 'gyur/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs rgyal sras snying rje'i gter/ /gang 'dul der ston sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byung lnga rnam dag o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /'khrul snang rang grol o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'byung ba'i 'jigs skyob o rgyan dpa' bo gyad/ /dbyings rig mnyam sbyor rdo rje rnal 'byor lha/ /dug lnga rang grol lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor gyi lha/ /dug lnga'i nad 'joms o rgyan sman lha dang*/ /pha rol bdud rgol gzhom mdzad rdo rje'i gur/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed o rgyan phyag rgya gyad/ /phrin las thogs med lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /hor sog g.yul bzlog dregs pa zil gnon rtsal/ /lam 'phrang 'jigs skyob gu ru nyi ma 'od/ /zab gter sgo 'byed o rgyan yi dam lha/ /bar chad sgrol mdzad dpa' bo ging la sogs/ /gang 'dul der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs/
