/bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum sogs/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhi dang khro bo'i sprin/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas skabs 'gal bar chad dbyings su zhi/ /don gnyis 'bad med bsam don chos bzhin grub/ /mthar thug rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su/ /rang rig pad 'byung dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du rang slob au ḍīs mtshan can gyi bskul ngor gnam lcags bstan 'dzin pas sbyar ba'o// // (ga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i bcud bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī ye/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i bcud phul rmad/ /bde gshegs gcig la dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos sde bsam lhun ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor dril sgrub snying bsdus 'dir gsal bya/ de'ang thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ spyi dril gsol 'debs ye shes sprin phung bsnyen sgrub dang sgrub chen sogs nyams len la 'jug pa'i skabs rgyas par mi lcog na/ thun bzhi dang spros med kyi skabs don bsdus nas nyams su len par 'dod pa la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i chos spyi mthun ltar byas la/ dang po sngon 'gro la skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis:

'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dkar gtor spyi mthun/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa bkug / sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad gu gul bdug rol mo 'tsham rngam bya'o/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon kun khengs: phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta'i bdud bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: lnga pa byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ

mthar me tog bkram brdung dang bcas byin chen dbab/ drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen po'i dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ sngon 'gro spyi'-i rim pa'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid du: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang rgyan kun rdzogs/ /dur khrod rdo rwa me ri srung gur brjid/ /pho brang lte bar rin chen zur brgyad dang*/ /rigs lnga'i khri 'phangs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : dbus su hūm̐ las ma hā gu ru rje: snang srid zil gnon dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg: 'dab ldan dar gyi snyan zhu gsang gos dkar: dar dmar chos gos mthing nag phod chen gsol: smug nag ber phyam snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: rdo rje bhan+dha tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: zhabs gnyis swag lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: 'gying bag brjid ldan gzi 'od phyogs bcur khyab: dbu gtsug kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma rnams/ /snang stong sku yi phyag rgya 'od stong 'bar/ /o rgyan snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga sogs/

/dbus phyogs chos sku'i tshom bu 'ja' tshon bkra/ /de yi phyi rim phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhir/ /gnas pa'i pad+ma nyi zla'i lte ba ru/ /'byung lnga dag pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'chi 'pho 'jigs skrag rang grol dpa' bo gyad/ /mkha' spyod zab lam ston mdzad rnal 'byor ma/ /rang rang cha lugs rigs kyi tshom bu rdzogs/ /de yi phyi rim 'ja' zer mu khyud kyi/ /gtams pa'i 'dab brgyad 'od lnga'i drwa ba mdzes/ /phyogs bzhir dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi lha/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor lha dang*/ /pha rol rgol 'joms gtum chen rdo rje'i gur/ /hor sog dmag bzlog phung byed bdud dgra gzhaum/ /shar lhor dregs pa zil gnon thod phreng rtsal/ /lho nub zab gter sgo 'byed yi dam lha/ /nub byang sbas gnas lam ston nyi ma 'od/ /byang shar dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ /rang rang phyag mtshan rigs kyi tshom bu bcas/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mkha' la 'ja' ltar gsal/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkhar sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs tshom bur 'khrigs: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad las bzhi'i gar: /mtshams brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sogs/ /rigs kyi ḍāk+ki 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: gru chad bar khyams khor yug gnas yul gyi: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki ging chen sgo skyong sde: bar snang lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i rig 'dzin: rgya bod mkhas grub bka' brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs: 'dod snam mchod sprin lha mos gar stabs bsgyur: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba yi: /phyi 'khor dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' dang bstan skyong sogs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang*/ /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du/

/snang la rang bzhin ma grub gsal bar bsgom/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: 'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ dri bzang gi spos gtong zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng : gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te bzhugs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas sogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog sogs: sbyor sgrol gsang ba kho na nyid: tshogs mchod dza gad chang la sogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs du mar bcas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ

rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma ha ta na ga na dharma dha tu pū dza hoḥ.aḥ drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu bo bzhi rdzogs bde chen 'dus pa'i sku: sku gcig sku lnga mtshan brgyad bye ba brgyad: rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i sprin bkod cing*/ /rlabs chen gdul bya skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: theg pa 'dzin 'chang rig 'dzin bla ma dang : sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro yi dam lha: gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: chos dbyings ye shes rol pa chen po'i lha: shes rab dbyings las thugs rje thabs kyi skur: rtsol med rang shar phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus rdzogs: gnyis med rang snang gsal stong ye shes lha: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgu pa dzapa ྄la dang po gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub tshar gcig dang*/ dzapa ྄bskul ni/

hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol: bsnyen dmigs gsal gdab pa ni / thugs kar don gyi ye shes sems/ /rig stong rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /mi shigs thig ler hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /rig stong ka dag ngang du blta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ las sbyor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzla zhing stong tshig phul/ ༈ de nas tshogs 'bul bar spro na/ rang lugs gsol ka rnams grub nas/ na raka bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags la sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar ba dang*/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub gtor bsngo'i byin rlabs nas spyan 'dren bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ dang po tshogs sbyang spel ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas/ /bla ma bder 'dus sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum 'khor tshogs bcas/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /sna tshogs gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/

/o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa sogs 'phro skyong zhing*/ bzhi pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i rten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur nas: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzla/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐: shes bya lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bsgral zhing bstab bo/

tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mi g.yel zhing : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/ brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs dam can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar chod rtsom pa'i log 'dren rdul du rlog: oṃ gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: bka' 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan snga ru: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bsgrub pa khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma ma hring hring bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig rta bro ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'dus pas bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyi: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya nan:

bcu gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs ngo bo lhun grub ka dag la: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs/ gsum pa rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru dā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral la: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhan pa'i 'gog lam bsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ de ltar thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes phyogs bsgrigs spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam lhun ma rgyas pa sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs kyang*/

'di nyid rgyas drag pas spros med bsnyen sgrub thun bzhi sogs la sbyar ba'i skabs su mi bde zhing*/ rtsa ba gcig dril ni cung bsdus che bas gtso bo yab yum tsam las bsam lhun dkyil 'khor bcu gsum chig dril nyams len la sbyar dka' bar ma zad/ skabs 'gar dus mchod dang rgyun bkol ngag 'don tshogs 'bum bsags pa bcas rang gzhan dgos mkhor gal che bar sems te/ gter gzhung dgongs pa gzhir bzhag cing kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams kyang rang gzhung las blangs te/ 'phri snon cung zad bcas bal yul yang le shod gnam lcags sgom sder/ rab byung 17pa'i me khyi'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 15nyin gnam lcags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis/ 'phral mar bris pas nor ba mchis na rtsa gsum lhar 'chags shing dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // (nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i las tshogs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ gu ru yid bzhin nor bu la/ /btud de dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i thabs/ /man ngag bcu gsum nyams len gyi/ /snying po'i bcud bsdus nyung gsal bya/ de'ang rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi las tshogs bsam lhun sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang*/ bye brag so so'i las tshogs man ngag dang bcas pa rgyas pa gter gzhung rgya che bar bzhugs kyang*/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo bsod nams dman zhing brtson 'grus zhan pa/ sgrub pa'i long med pa bdag lta bur rtsa ba'i sngags tsam la brten nas phrin las bye brag sbyar bar spro na/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gzhung ltar bya/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags grub pa'i rjes su las sbyor ltar sbyar ba'am/ yang na gtso bo ltar sgrub par 'dod tshe dzap bskul rjes/ gzhung gi bsnyen dmigs dor nas/ o rgyan snang mtha' sogs gang la 'jug pa'i bsnyen dmigs dang*/ bsnyen pa sbyar ba sogs dmigs pa'i 'phrul 'khor gsham gsal ltar gang 'dod bsgyur shes par bya'o/

/de la dang po o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas ltar sgrub par mos na/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /skad cig snang mtha'i sku ru gyur/ /pad zlar thugs srog hrīḥdamar mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dmigs pa brtan zhing gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci 'grub bzla/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs gzhung ltar bya'o/ las kyi mtha' bye brag gnas 'dren sogs sbyar bar mos na dzap khang dbye la/ bum sgrub sbyar zhing gnam lcags gnas bsdus spyi 'gros bzhin sbyar bas grub bo/ ༈ gnyis pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal po ltar sgrub par mos na/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /o rgyan bde chen rgyal por gyur/ /pad zlar thugs srog hūm̐ yig mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p gsol 'debs ci 'grub bzla/ bsnyen pa/ om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ mchod bstod sogs gong ltar bya'o/ ༈ gsum pa o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen par gyur/ /pad zlar thugs srog hūm̐ yig mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru:

'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dang*/ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la ham̐'u phaṭḥ mchog gi las sbyor khyad par can rdzogs pa'i rim pa rmi lam dang*/ bar do sogs zur gsal bzhin nyams su len par bya'o/ mchod bstod sogs gong ltar ro/ ༈ bzhi pa o rgyan dpa' bo gyad ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rjer gyur/ /pad zlar thugs srog hrīḥyig mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsol 'debs ci nus rjes/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ badz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki mūm̐ shrī hūm̐: mchod bstod sogs gong ltar bya'o/ ༈ lnga pa o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ltar na/ skad cig gu ru pad+ma 'byung*/ /gnas 'gyur ye shes mkha' 'gro gsal/ /thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /chos sku kun tu bzang mor gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog bam̐ḥyig mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ rtsa sngags ni/

oṃ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mchod bstod sogs gong ltar rdzogs rim 'pho ba sogs zur gsal bzhin nyams su len par bya/ mchod bstod sogs gong ltar bya'o/ ༈ drug pa o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /skad cig pad+ma rgyal por gyur/ /pad zlar thugs srog hrīḥyig mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ bsnyen pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ra dzā ḍak+ki ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes ci nus bzlas shing mchod bstod sogs gong ltar bya'o/ las mtha' bye brag dbang sdud dang*/ g.yang sgrub sogs sbyar bar mos na pad rgyal ltar sbyar chog go/ //

༈ bdun pa o rgyan sman lha ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /skad cig o rgyan sman lhar gyur/ /pad zlar rtsa ba'i thugs srog mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ snying po ni/ om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya: ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya: rā dza ya: ta thā ga ta ya: ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya: ma hā rā dza ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ sman sgrub pa dang nad zhi ba'i las sbyor bye brag sbyar bar mos na gzhung ltar bya'o/ ༈ brgyad pa o rgyan rdo rje'i gur ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /gtum chen rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog hūm̐ mthing mthar/ /sngags phreng me tshwa'i phas rgol bsregs/ /tshur 'dus rdo rje'i gur gyur dmigs/ zhes dang*/ ༈ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ rdo rje rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje gur gyi snying po: oṃ badz+ra ṇi bh+rūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes ci nus bzla'o/ ༈ dgu pa o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs pa ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /gu ru drag po'i sku ru gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog hūm̐ dmar nag /sngags phreng me tshwas log 'dren bcom/ /che btsan 'gran zla bral bar dmigs/ zhes dang*/ ༈ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na:

yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /bye brag srung bzlog bsad pa'i dmigs pa spro na gzhung ltar bya'o/ ༈ bcu pa o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /drag sngags shan+tiṃ nag por gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog hūm̐ dmar nag /sngags phreng me tshwas log 'dren bcom/ /che btsan 'gran zla bral bar dmigs/ zhes dang*/ ༈ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /bye brag srung bzlog bsad pa'i dmigs pa spro na gzhung ltar bya'o/ ༈ bcu gcig pa o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /gnas 'gyur rdo rje gro lod gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog hūm̐ dmar nag /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci nus dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐:

spro bar mos tshe srung bzlog bsad pa'i dmigs pa rnams gzhung ltar dang*/ mchod bstod sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ ༈ bcu gsum o rgyan dpa' bo ging ni/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /skad cig nyi ma 'od zer gyur/ /pad nyir thugs srog hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun grub sgom/ zhes dang*/ ༈ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci rigs dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: dbyangs gsal yig brgya mchod bstod sogs tshogs mchod rjes chog rnams gzhung ltar byas pa'i grub bo/ /gter gzhung zhal gdams bsam lhun le tshan bcu gsum sgrub thabs rgyas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar bzhugs kyang*/ bdag dang 'dra ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ snying rus dben pa'i skal dman rnams kyi/ rtsa ba'i snying po tsam sgrub par nus pas kyang*/ don chen po dang ldan par sems te/ gter gzhung rtsa sngags byin rlabs can rnams blangs te lha sngags kha bsgyur bya thabs 'di'ang e wam̐ bsam gtan gling du/ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur mi phyed pa'i dad ldan sgo chen sprul ming nas me khyi khrum zla'i nyer gsum la grub par bgyis pa'o// // (ca) bsam lhun tshogs bsdus ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: /rang snang pad+ma 'od gyi zhing khams nas/ /gu ru rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha/ /bde chen tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid la sogs/ /mchod pas bskangs shing gsang gsum dam 'gal bshags/ /'khrul snang dbyings sgrol gzhi thog sangs rgyas shog /gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/

/bsam pa lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes grangs bsags ched du gu h+yaso// // (cha) thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa'i cha lag bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i sgrub thabs bcu gsum spyi khyab kyi sngon rjes sogs kyi mtshams sbyor bzhugs so/ de la'ang*/ sgrub thabs bcu gsum spyi chings sngon 'gro tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ rnam thar gsol 'debs sam gnas ri so dgu ma/ gsol 'debs 'bral med ma sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsam lhun spyi'i gsol 'debs/ spros bcas kyi tshe rdor dril byin rlabs dang*/ las bum dri'i dung zhal 'thor g.yab bcas dgod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mthing nag rgya gram dang sdig mdzub mdzad pa'i skur gyur: rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci rigs bzlas pas/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur par bsams/ bum pa bsgrub pa sogs bya'o/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bigh+nān na ma sarba ta thā ga t hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: zhes sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad gu gul bdug rol mo'i 'tsham rngam bya'o/ /mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon kun gang : phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta'i bdud bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig:

badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bye brag dkyil 'khor bcu gsum rang gzhung ltar bskyed rim la 'jug par bya'o/ mchod bstod bar rang gzhung ltar song*/ dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtog dzap bskul rang gzhung ltar bya/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi sngags so sor yod na skabs phyes la so so'i dmigs pa kha phral te bzla/ gal te rtsa sngags kho na yin na dmigs pas so sor 'phrul shes pa gal che/ lag len rtsa sngags sum stong tsam dang*/ las sngags lnga brgya/ las sbyor rnams nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bya'o/ /de nas rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ gzung thag la 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ /zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas bum sgrub ched rtsa sngags sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ las bum sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs dang thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ ༈ rig me dor ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/

hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bsngo smon mdor bsdus tsam bya'o/ de nas dkyil 'khor yol bas sgribs/ sgrub pa'i yan lag bsam lhun le'u bcu gsum gyi spyi chings rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ stod las smad las rjes chog go /dang po tshogs kyi las rim la brgyad/ sbyang spel spyan 'dren mchod skong bsgral/ /tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma'o/ /zhes pa'i thog mar chos skyong sde lnga'i bskang gsol dang rang lugs gsol ka rnams grub nas/ na rag bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags la/ sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar ba dang*/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub gtor bsngos byin rlabs bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ dang po tshogs sbyang spel ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? lan gsum gyis mang por spel/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas/ /bla ma bder 'dus sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum 'khor tshogs bcas/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/

/sna tshogs gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: phyi snod srid gsum yang pa sogs 'phro skyong zhing*/ bzhi pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i rten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur nas: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzla/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: shes bya lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bsgral zhing bstab bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bsam lhun bar chad lam sel gyi gsol 'debs bcas grol la/

skabs 'dir slob ma bos la dbang bskur ba yin/ yang bod yul rang lugs 'gas dngos grub len pa'i bar btang*/ dbang bzhi blangs nas rjes su 'jug pa'ang snang mod/ snga ma bzhin mdzad na 'thad che/ dbang bskur grub nas tshogs drang ba la 'jug /bdun pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor rdzas chen gyi: dngos grub rmad byung ro brgya'i zas: deng 'dir skal ldan rnams la stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni legs 'ong ya mtshan ldan: 'khor 'das ro gcig blang dor bral: gtsang rme gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag: dge bas de bzhin a la la hoḥ e ma hoḥ brgyad pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mi g.yel zhing : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ bskul dang chad brtan rta bro dngos grub bskul ba'o/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni/

hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs dam can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mthu chen khyod kyis mngon spyod dus la bab: bar chod rtsom pa'i log 'dren rdul du rlog: oṃ gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: bka' 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan snga ru: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma ma hring hring bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'dus pas bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chad: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya nan: lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs ngo bo lhun grub ka dag la: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhas: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

zhes dbang blangs/ gsum pa rjes chog la drug /mchod bstod nongs bshags bsdu ldang dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis so/ /dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru dā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral las: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i 'gogs lam bsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ /zhes bsam lhun le'u bcu gsum pa'i dbang bskur spyi la gces pa'i chings 'di bzhin 'jug bde ba'i ched gnam lcags bstan 'dzin 'jam dpal rdo rjes sbyar ba dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // (ja) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ zhal gdams bsam lhun le tshan bcu gsum sgrub thabs dbang chog dang bcas pa chu babs su bkod pa lam bzang gsal sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ pam̐d+mam̐'i rigs mchog chos sku 'od mtha' yas/

/pam̐d+mam̐'i spyan ldan longs sku thugs rje'i gter/ /pam̐d+mam̐ las 'khrungs sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /pam̐d 'byung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas snying dbus rol/ /rtsam̐ gsum̐m bkam̐' 'dum̐s zab gnad chom̐s kyim̐ mdzod/ /man ngag rgyam̐ mtshom̐'i yang zhun thugs sgrub che/ /rgyab chos zham̐l gdam̐ms mam̐n ngam̐g bcum̐ gsum̐m gyi/ /smin grol lam bzang gsal sgron 'dir 'degs bya/ /de la o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter gtso bo bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi cha lag zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ bsam pa lhun 'grub sgrub thabs bcu gsum gyi smin grol bltas chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ bca' bsham/ sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba'o/ dang po zur bkod ltar byas nas/ gnyis pa la bcu gsum las/ dang po o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas zhes stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i le tshan lnga'i nang tshan/ chos sku o rgyan snang mtha' la brten nas bde chen zhing khams sgrub pa la'ang*/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po/ sgrub thabs bcu gsum gyi spyi chings sngon 'gro tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ rnam thar gsol 'debs sam gnas ri so dgu ma/ gsol 'debs 'bral med ma sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsam lhun spyi yi gsol 'debs ni/ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: in+d+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po bstan pa'i chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: man+da ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad:

rgya gar yul kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar: bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du gzugs: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya cher bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: man+da ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhal mjal lung bstan gnang :

gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur te: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i sgrub thabs so so'i gsol 'debs yod rigs 'dir bya/ med kyang bsam lhun ma rang gzhung 'di ga'i chog bye brag zhing sgrub rang gzhung gi gsol 'debs ni/ na mo hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du: chos sku 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i pho brang du: spyan gzigs dbyings phyug yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdor sems spyan ma'i yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rin 'byung mā kī yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: snang mtha' gos dkar yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su:

don grub sgrol ma yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: pad 'byung mtsho rgyal yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: spyi gtsug dung khang bde chen pho brang nas: drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gror gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'di nas tshe 'phos bde ba can gyi zhing : bde gshegs 'od dpag med pas rjes bzung nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god pa yis: tshe rabs ngan 'gro'i skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ zhes dang*/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed kun: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ spros bcas kyi tshe rdor dril byin rlabs dang*/ bum pa sgrub pa sogs bya'o/ dkar gtor spyi mthun/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad gu gul bdug rol mo'i 'tsham rngam bcas bya'o/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon kun gang : phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta'i bdud bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen pos dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ sngon 'gro spyi'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed pa ni/

hrīḥ bdag lus phung po gdod nas gzhal yas khang : dbyings dang bdag mdun dbyer med dran rdzogs su: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams tshom gcig bkod pa yi: dbus su glang chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥlas chos sku sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gsal stong lham mer bzhugs: thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcu'i dbyings la gzigs: mdun du 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar: phyag 'tshal phyag rgya'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong bsnams: dbyings phyug dkar sngon bde stong yab la 'khril: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bor gsal rdzogs bsgom: hūm̐: de'i mdun seng khri zhe sdang rnam dag steng : rdau rje sems dpa' dung mdog rdor dril bsnams: spyan ma dkar mo bde stong yab la 'khril: me long ye shes snang stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: g.yas su rta mchog nga rgyal rnam dag steng : rin chen 'byung ldan chos 'chad mnyam bzhag can: rin chen zhags 'dzin mā kī ser mo 'khril: mnyam nyid ye shes bde stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: rgyab tu rma bya 'dod chags rnam dag steng : snang mtha' dmar po thugs rje'i phyag rgya can: pad+ma lcags kyu gos dkar bde stong 'khril: sor rtogs ye shes grags stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: g.yon du shang shang phrag dog rnam dag steng : don yod grub pa skyabs sbyin mchog sbyin can: rgya gram lcags sgrog sgrol ljang sku la 'khril: bya grub ye shes ka dag don rdzogs bsgom: hūm̐: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i zhing khams su: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: longs sku spyan gzigs sprul sku rigs bzhi la: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bkod pa rdzogs: 'khor du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dang : sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: khyad par dag pa rig 'dzin gtso 'khor dang : mkha' spyod zhing gi lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: bar med 'khor zhing bsam brjod blo las 'das:

khyad par mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams kyi: mngon par 'phags pa'i lha dang lha mo yi: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la: bdud rtsis khrus gsol mdzes pa'i rgyan cha 'dogs: dbu la theg chen chos kyi bsil gdugs 'bubs: zhabs la bcu drug rdo rje'i khri gdan brtsegs: sku la sna tshogs 'dzin med na bzas bklubs: thugs la gsal stong 'gags med dbyangs kyis bstod: de bzhin lha yi 'od khyim gur ras dang : 'ja' 'od zer dang nyi zla'i phreng ba sogs: lha yi me tog rgyan 'phyang yug gos phreng : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i mchod sprin gtibs: 'khor ra khor yug dag tu mar me'i phreng : lha yi gzhal med khang dang dpag bsam shing : 'dod 'jo'i rdzing dang ma rmos lo 'bras dbyung : lha yi bdud rtsi chu mig sil ma bkram: sa gzhi thams cad mig mang drwa ba ris: 'phags pa'i zhing khams me tog bkod pas brgyan: pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur sangs rgyas re re la: byang chub sems pa sems ma grangs med bcas: mchod pa'i lha mo de bzhin grangs dang mnyam: mkha' spyod 'gro ba'i don du dgongs pa dang : mkha' la spyod pa'i byams sems grangs med sogs: nyi zer char babs 'ja' dang me tog bzhin: grangs med bye ba'i rlung bzhin snang stong gshegs: zhing khams de yi mdun gyi nam mkha' ru: 'ja' 'od zlum por brtsegs pa'i pho brang dbus: rnga yab dag zhing mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od: zhing khams lta na sdug pa bkod pa'i dbus: dri med mdangs ldan rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus: ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha snang stong tshul: phyed skyil zung 'jug lha lcam gsang ye 'khril: mda' dar tshom bu yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: thugs kar 'od zer phyogs bzhir 'phros pa las: dag pa rig 'dzin rnam bzhi phyogs kyi mdog: gtso bo'i cha mthun rigs bzhi ḍāk+ki'i 'khril: gtso 'khor rnams kyi phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su:

mkha' spyod rig 'dzin pho mo sprin ltar 'khrigs: de yi 'khor du rig 'dzin drang srong rnams: pad sdong dbus dmar skyes pa'i 'dab chung steng : mnyam bzhag thor tshugs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: de yi mkha' dbyings khor yug thams cad du: lha klu rig 'dzin khye'u pho mo yis: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bla bre dang : phye ma phur ma me tog phreng ba'i sprin: kun kyang mchod sprin sna tshogs thogs nas su: mkha' lam 'gengs shing phyogs bcu'i zhing dang mnyam: lha yi 'dod yon bkod pa blo las 'das: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas mchog dam pa der: skal ldan mos pa'i 'dun pas blos blangs te: bdag dang yid can 'brel 'bras sems can kun: dag pa rig 'dzin rnams kyis mdun bsu zhing : lha yi spos dang rol mo'i bye brag phreng : zhing khams dpa' bo rnams kyis g.yas nas skyol: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro rnams kyis g.yon nas brten: sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rgyab nas phul: grangs med sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdun nas bsus: skyon bral pad+ma'i steng du skyes nas kyang : sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong ste: pad 'byung yab yum rnams kyis lung bstan nas: grangs med sangs rgyas rnams kyis smon lam mdzad: ging dang dpa' bos sa lam bar chad bskrad: byang sems 'phags tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis brjod: lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: mngon brjod rab tu gnas pa'i bsod nams kyis: lha las lhag pa'i lus thob sangs rgyas rnyed: sangs rgyas spyan dang sangs rgyas snyan dang ni: sangs rgyas shangs dang sangs rgyas ljags dang ni: sangs rgyas thugs dang sangs rgyas mngon shes bcas: lha dang mi yi tshogs drug mi re zhing : drug ldan rdo rje'i sgra dang yan lag bcu: mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu sogs: mngon par 'phags pa'i dpe byad ldan pa yis: zhing du dmigs pa'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs kyis:

bdag lus sgyu ma'i phung po'i g.ya' bral nas: zag med 'ja' lus phung po'i sku ru grol: rtsa khams 'khor lo zhing khams lnga ru shar: ka dag bdag mdun mi dmigs gsal stong ngang : ma bcos snang srid zhing khams lha ru gsal: mnyam bzhag de yi rol rtsal 'phro 'du yis: grangs med phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs kun gyi byin rlabs thugs rje rnams: ye shes gsal rdzogs spyan drangs dbyer med bstim: nus pa'i gzi byin rtsol med 'bar bar bsgom: om̐ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na pradz+nyā badz+ra hrī dha ya sarba pa ri mi ta ga ga na āt+ma ko3 haṃ:

de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs shing dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs/ thugs rje'i nus pas bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun skyabs shing rjes su bzung bar bsam: hoḥ phyogs bcu'i ga la'i zhing du bzhugs pa yis: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin ji snyed dang : de snyed bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: byams brtse'i thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs la: bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun skyob pa'i slad: nye bar dgongs shig byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: om̐ dz+nyā na pañca ā li kā li mūm̐ shrī bha ga wan: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya e h+ya hi badz+ra bud+dha rat+na pad+ma karma badz+ra bhi dh+wa dhā ra ya tad+ya thā om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza gu ru ha ri ni sa pad+ma badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra sa twa k+ṣaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐ āḥ om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: mchod pa ni/ na mo hūm̐: phyogs dus rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchog: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams la gnas pa'i: bde chen dag pa'i zhing du gang bzhugs dang : gang dag 'das dang ma byon da lta yi: dus gsum dus bzhi dus med rtogs rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can ma lus kyis: grangs med bsags pa'i bag chags g.ya' bral phyir: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'bul: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med skyes pa'i me tog ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i spos dri ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs:

bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i mar me ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i dri chab ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med bcud ldan zhal zas ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med sgra snyan rol mo ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med spyan gzigs gzugs mdzes ci mchis pa:

gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med glu dbyangs sgra snyan ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med bcud g.yo rdzas gtams ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe ho pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med ro brgya'i khyaun ltar ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra rā sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med reg 'jam rgyan bzang ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra spar+she pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nang mchod bdud rtsi dza gad sman phud chang : mkha' dbyings rak+ta rgyan bzang bha ling+ta: bde stong sbyor ba zung 'jug dga' ba bzhi:

mkha' dbyings klong las nyon mongs mtshan ma bsgral: bla med kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bzhes: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta dharma pū dza me gha mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rin chen gdugs mchog gser gyi yu ba can: bla bre 'phan gdugs ba dan dar dpyangs bskyod: phye ma phur ma la sogs me tog phreng : lha yi 'dod yon mi yi longs spyod dang : ri rab gling bzhi gling phran gser ri bdun: rol mtsho bcud g.yo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing : ma rmos lo tog lha yi skyed mos tshal: 'ja' tshon khri gdugs gur khyim 'od kyi dkyil: ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin sna tshogs 'di: blo yis blangs te yid kyis 'bul lags na: bde chen dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badz+ra sarba swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ: pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi zhing bkod bde ba can: de ru bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gzi brjid 'bum du 'khyil: thugs rje'i spyan gyis mkha' mnyam 'gro la gzigs: mtshan thos tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob: chos sku 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdun du rgyal ba longs sku spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs drug skye sgo gcod: byang chub sems mas 'gro kun snying rjes 'dren: nam mkha'i rgyal po yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shar phyogs zhing khams rdor sems yab yum la: sku yi rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: mngon dga'i zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lho phyogs zhing khams rin 'byung yab yum la: yon tan rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: dpal ldan zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nub phyogs zhing khams snang mtha' yab yum la: gsung gi rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor:

bde chen zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang phyogs zhing khams don grub yab yum la: phrin las rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: las rab zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med zhing gi lha: rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings zhing gi dbang phyug tshe dpag med: 'ja' lus skye 'chi gnyis spangs pad+ma 'byung : bde gshegs rgyal po lhun grub 'dus ma byas: sku lnga mtshan brgyad 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon: mtha' med sems can thugs rjes skyob mdzad lha: thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yum chen mo: grangs med sprul pas rig 'dzin gsang lam ster: 'ja' lus bgres rgud bral ba'i lha lcam 'khril: pad 'byung yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: lha yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: lta na bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: mi yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: stug po bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: tshe yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: mkha' dbyings bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: klu yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: lcang lo bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso 'khor grangs med pa: bdag lus blo yis blangs nas gus pa yis: phyag 'tshal bde chen zh-ing khams bgrod par shog: de nas bzlas pa la dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par

bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtog pas gsal gdab la bzlas par 'jug go /bsnyen dmigs ni/ thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: a mi dhe wa g.yas su 'khor: spro bsdu zang thal stong pa'i dbyings: ma 'gags thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob: snang ba stong gzugs sgyu ma'i ngang : sgra grags ngo bo brag cha'i dbyangs: 'gyu ba dran rig blo bral chos: phyi nang 'od phung 'ja' lus bsgom: 'khor ba myang 'das 'gro drug tshogs: thog ma'i sangs rgyas don rtogs shog: ༈ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p gsol 'debs ci 'grub bzla/ dang po sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi gzungs: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ gnyis pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi gzungs: om̐ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ gsum pa sangs rgyas rnga sgra'i gzungs: om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: bzhi pa rig 'dzin bla ma'i gzungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: lnga pa zhing khams lha mo'i gzungs: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐: drug pa bde gshegs rtsa ba'i gzungs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza hūm̐: bdun pa bde gshegs rigs lnga'i gzungs: om̐ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañca sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: brgyad pa sangs rgyas rtse mo mnyam sbyor gyi gzungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrī swā hā: rtsa sngags a mi dhe wa sum stong ngam stong rtsa las mi nyung ba dang*/ gzhan rnams lnga brgya re tsam song ste/ de nas rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ gzungs thag la 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ nas phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar

mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas bum sgrub ched rtsa sngags sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ las bum sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs dang thun mtshams kyi mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ ༈ rig me dor ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dang gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ 'di nyid kho na'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub dang dbang bskur ba sogs phrin las gud du phyung dgos tshe cho ga'i yan lag yongs rdzogs tshang dgos pas na/ chos srung gsol mchod dang skong bshags sogs spyi ltar dang*/ tshogs mchod dang rjes chog ni gong gsal smad las kyi spyi chings ltar sbyar bar bya'o/ /de dag ni gsham gyi le tshan gzhan la'ang 'gre shes par bya'o/ /dang po o rgyan snang mtha' la brten nas bde chen zhing khams sgrub pa'i le tshan no//

// ༈ gnyis pa/ 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal po la brten nas rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra nī la'i khang pa ltar bya ba la gsol 'debs spyi chings ltar dang*/ thog mar tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed kun: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgau gsum dad dang mi phyed drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o ye shes 'od kyi skur: dag pa rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'grau drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/

dkar bgegs mtshams gcod sogs so sor sgrub tshe gong bzhin 'jug dgos la du ma mnyam du sgrub tshe mi dgos/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gling bzhi'i snod mchog khor yug khyab pa yi: phyi mchod lha mo bcu drug sprin ltar gtibs: bhan+dha'i snod du nang mchod mtsho ltar bskyil: ga ṇa tshogs dang gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dbang po sna lnga'i me tog tshar du dngar: dri zhim phyur zhing spyan gzigs sprin ltar gtibs: kun bzang dgyes pa rab skyed 'dod yon tshogs: bla med bde ba chen por dgyes par bskyed: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra badz+ra shab+da gan+dhe spar+she pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas dkyil 'khor dgod pa ni/ om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: bhi shwa bi shud+dhe: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: hrīḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ ā: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral: yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram btegs: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: kham̐ las rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi brdal: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab brjid: bh+rūm̐ las pho brang gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: phyi dang nang gsal sgo rdzogs mdzes: mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐: de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: gu ru bde chen rgyal po'i sku: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum mdzes: dmar smug dbang gi phrin las rdzogs: dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag can:

rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas: dar dpyangs cod pan du ma 'phur: phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: rdo rje bhan+dha mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen dang ni rus pas brgyan: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: steng phyogs mkha' spyod rnam dag dbus: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ni: 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: gsang ba ḍāk+ki yum dang sbyor: phyag gnyis rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: gtso bo'i cha lugs lta bur bskyed: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin: shar du sar gnas rig 'dzin dkar: lho ru phyag rgya rig 'dzin ser: nub tu tshe dbang rig 'dzin dmar: byang du lhun grub rig 'dzin ljang : thams cad gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen bzhi: nyi zla dngos grub bde chen dkar: mthing 'od 'bar ma gsal stong sngo: rdo rje rnal 'byor rā ga'i mdangs: las kyi dbang mo sngo ljang dgyes: yum rnams ḍā ru bhan+dha bsnams: thams cad gtso bo'i cha lugs can: gsal stong nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar: snang la ma 'dres 'ja' ltar shar: rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: sa bon yig 'bru 'phros pa yis: dag pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod o rgyan dag pa'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i rig 'dzin gtso bo gshegs su gsol: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin rol pa'i ye shes gshegs su gsol: zhing khams phrin las rnam bzhi'i pho brang nas: dag pa rig 'dzin rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: bde stong mkha' la rol pa'i pho brang nas: gsang ba dbyings kyi yum drug gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs gsol dang phyag bgyid pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chags med pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rtog med thugs rjes 'gro la dgongs slad du: stong nyid snying rje ye shes stsol ba'i phyir: rnal 'byor gdung ba drag po'i nges 'byung gis: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag bgyid do: zab ber chos gos ldan pas phyi phyag 'tshal: phod kha sngags chas ldan pas nang phyag 'tshal: rgyan drug stag sham ldan pas gsang phyag 'tshal: gcer bu 'phur zhing ldan pas brkyang phyag 'tshal: sgo gsum tha mal gzhom pas dam phyag bgyid: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo badz+ra a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: me tog cod pan dbu la 'bul: dri zhim sman spos shangs la 'bul: nyi zla snang gsal spyan la 'bul: dza gad tshogs mchod ljags la 'bul: dbyangs dang rol mo snyan la 'bul: reg bya rgyan mdzes sku la 'bul: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra badz+ra shab+da gan+dhe spar+she pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha dum gcig rang byung snod kyi nang : sha lnga bdud rtsi pañca a mṛ ta: rigs lnga sku lnga sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: pad+ma mu la añja rak+ta sogs: mkha' dbyings dbang mo'i bde ba nyi zla'i rgyun: khā kha mu khar rdo rje rlung gis bskul: gzhan yang bha ling gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs pa dang : spyan gzigs la sogs yid la 'thad pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs shing g.yar dam stsol: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti bha su ta khā hi:

de nas gsang ba bde ba chen po'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin bde chen rgyal po la: ye shes mtsho rgyal yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ gu ru ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: gsang ba ye shes yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bi dho dha ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la: nyi zla 'od zer yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bi dho dha ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la: mthing 'od 'bar ma yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dha ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dha ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la: las kyi dbang mo yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dha ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya satwaṃ: su khaṃ sid+dhi pha la dz+nyā na hoḥ zhes bde ba chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam: dmigs pa ni lha yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang dbyer med du gyur:

mchog thun thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi yin pa'i don rtogs par bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi thob par bsams la bdud rtsi lce ru myong zhing gnas gsum du thig le bya: bdud rtsi la'ang byang sems dkar dmar bsre ba'am: yang na sin+dhu ra: cu gang ka la ma bsres: khyad par tsan+dan dkar dmar: yang na cong zhi dang rgya mtshal: yang na tsha dang : rgya skag ste: thabs shes spel ba'i rdzas so: yang na bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyis thams cad 'thu'o: sa ma ya: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu rgyal ba ma lus bzhugs pa'i yul: zhing gi mchog gyur o rgyan mkha' spyod gnas: pho brang mchog gyur rnga yab pad+ma 'od: dpal ri mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gzi byin mched: mkha' la spyod pa'i don du dgongs pa mdzad: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dpa' bo he ru kaḥ bde ba'i zung 'jug zag med rig ma 'khril: 'gro ba'i don du sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur pa: mkha' spyod zhing gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med khyab brdal rol pa las: rigs drug thar lam mchog tu smin pa'i phyir: bde chen rgyal po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : sku mdog dmar smug zhi zhing khro ba'i nyams: dbu la rigs lnga'i rtse phran prog zhu gsol: sku lnga ye shes gsal stong 'du 'bral med: sna tshogs rin chen drwa ba sku la spras: thugs rje'i 'od zer 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i cod pan du mas brgyan: byams dang snying rje'i thabs kyis 'gro drug 'dren: rus rgyan zar bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas spras: skye gnas rnam bzhi'i 'khrul rgyun rtsad nas gcod: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes bsnol ba sil: 'khor 'das chos rnams sgyu ma'i rol par rtogs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nyams kyi gar dang ldan: skye 'chi gnyis spangs ngan 'gro'i gdung ba sel:

zung 'jug bde chen mtsho rgyal pang du 'khril: dga' bzhi'i bde stong grol lam mtha' ru phyin: zag med sku la yon tan rdzogs pa'i yum: ma sring rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dbang mo che: rig 'dzin yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang : dbus phyogs mkha' spyod zh-ing khams lha yi gtso: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba ye shes 'khril: smin pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes ngang : shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams lha yi gtso: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin snang stong sku: bde chen dbyings phyug nyi zla'i 'od zer 'khril: sar gnas rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing khams lha yi gtso: phyag rgya chen po'i bde stong rig 'dzin sku: bde chen dbyings phyug mthing 'od 'bar ma 'khril: phyag rgya rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtogs ye shes ngang : nub phyogs bde chen zh-ing khams lha yi gtso: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin grags stong sku: bde chen dbyings phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: tshe dbang rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: byang phyogs las rab zhing khams lha yi gtso: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gsal stong ngang : bde chen dbyings phyug las kyi dbang mo 'khril: lhun grub rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: dzap khang dbye ba gong bzhin blang*/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag gis rab bskul dwang bas bstod lags na: byin rlabs thugs rje'i smon lam shugs mtshon te: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing : rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur te: rnga yab dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs:

༈ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs ci rigs bzla/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag mdun lha'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig dmar po mar me ltar gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ de'i mthar bzla bya'i yig 'bru rnams skar ma'i phreng ba ltar rang sgra dang bcas bkra lam mer 'khor bar gyur/ de las sngags kyi 'od zer khra lam gyis byung ba rang zhal nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ slar sngags kyi 'od zer mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ rtsa sngags ni: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: yang sngags kyi 'od zer rigs drug gi gnas su 'phros pas so so'i las nyon byang nas thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi lha yi skur gyur cing*/ sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med cing brjod kyi mi lang pa steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la phog cing rgyal ba rnams la mnyes par mchod/ dbang byin dngos grub thob/ mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sbyangs/ dam tshig gi gnad la bskul/ ci bgyis pa'i bka' nyan cing phrin las bsgrubs/ 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams la phog pas tshar bcad/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer phog pas gnod sems sdug bsngal dang bral te bde ba'i longs spyod dang ldan par byas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/

thams cad dus gcig tu dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi skur gyur cing*/ de rnams thams cad kyi dzap dbyangs sgrogs par gyur/ om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ phrin las sngags: slar yang lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang grangs med par 'phros pas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par mos/ om̐ gu ru yo gi ni ḍāk+ki ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bum sgrub/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa'i rjes rig me dor ba dang*/ gnang zhus sngar ma ltar bya ba sogs 'di man kun la 'gre'o/ ༈ tshogs mchod spyi chings ltar bya'o/ gsum pa/ o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa la brten nas cir snang tshogs drug rang grol gyi gdams pa thod phreng rigs lnga'i sgrub pa 'khrul snang rang grol ltar bya ba la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rigs kyi gtso: ma sring mkha' 'gro gsang ba dbyings kyi lha: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag yid rab tu gdung bas skyabs su mchi: sku lnga'i thugs rje'i ye shes rgyud bskul nas: srid zhir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang : myang 'das go 'phang 'thob phyir sems bskyed do:
