tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlobs ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rlung me thod sgyed steng du ka pā la: yangs shing rgya che phyogs bzhi dbus lnga ru: lha mo bcu drug gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi: phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod sbyor ba'i mchod: so so'i thugs kar sa bon 'phros pa las: bhan+dha'i nang du ye shes lnga ldan gyi: dam tshig bdud rtsi sprin phung dbyings su bsnyegs: ye shes rigs lnga'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe: rang rang thogs pa'i mchod sprin ji bzhin spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gen+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na kiṃ ni ri ti ba su ta āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni: om̐ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ bh+rūm̐: pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: hūm̐: rlung me sa chu dbang chen gzhi: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang :

phyi nang bar khyams khor yug bcas: kun tshang pho brang yon tan ldan: rang bzhin dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hūm̐ las bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog mthing : he ru ka pa'i cha lugs can: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su bsgom: de bzhin rol stabs bzhugs pa yi: pang du 'khyud pa'i gsang ye ni: lha lcam dmar mo zung 'jug 'khril: gcer bu rin chen rgyan gyis spras: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: zung 'jug gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: shar du badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: lho ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: byang du karma thod phreng rtsal: g.yas rnams phyogs kyi phyag mtshan bsnams: g.yon rnams bhan+dha bdud rtsis gtams: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug can: rol stabs bde chen ldan par bsgom: rig ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: gcer mo rin chen rgyan gyis spras: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dung dmar bsnams: zung 'jug 'khril zhing mgul nas 'khyud: yab yum bde chen rgyas par bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang : dkyil 'khor skyong ba la sogs pa: nyi ma dang ni zer bzhin du: snang la rang bzhin bral bar bsgom: gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od: o rgyan rang byung zhing khams nas: rje btsun bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi'i phrin las zhing khams nas: thod phreng sde bzhi gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas: dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas byin phob dbang chen bskur:

om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng : gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te bzhugs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gu ru bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho sogs: bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas sogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog sogs: sbyor sgrol gsang ba kho na nyid: tshogs mchod dza gad chang la sogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs du ma bcas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: thod phreng sde lnga yab yum gyi: thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma chags skyon bral pad+ma rigs kyi lha: dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : longs sku'i rang bzhin rin chen rgyan gyis spras: chos sku mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing 'od 'bar: sku gcig sku gnyis sku lnga lhun gyis grub: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung pad+ma 'byung : he ru ka dpal bde gshegs rigs kyi gtsos: bde stong zung 'jug lha lcam gsang ye 'khril:

'khor lo rgyas 'debs mchog gi rol rtsal can: zag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyas pa'i sku: ma rig gti mug dbyings su dag pa'i phyir: chos dbyings ye shes skye ba med pa'i thugs: bud+dha thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan: he ru ka dpal sku yi bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal sku la 'khril: nyon mongs zhe sdang 'khrul snang dag pa'i gsung : me long ye shes skye ba med pa'i sku: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser bzhad mdangs dang ldan: he ru ka dpal yon tan bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki kā la sid+dhi 'khril: nyon mongs nga rgyal 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: mnyam nyid ye shes skye med yon tan rdzogs: rat+na thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi las mdzad dri med rā ga'i mdangs: he ru ka dpal gsung gi bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki shākya dhe ma 'khril: nyon mongs 'dod chags 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: sor rtogs ye shes skye med gsung mchog rdzogs: pad+ma thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i las mdzad ljang nag dgyes pa'i mdangs: he ru ka dpal phrin las bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki bkra shis khye'u 'dren 'khril: nyon mongs phrag dog 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: bya grub ye shes skye med phrin las rdzogs: karma thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar/ dzap kyi thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon mongs zhi mdzad 'khrul snang rang sar grol: dus gsum mkhyen pa ye shes gu ru rje: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: bdag gi gus pas gdung zhing bstod lags na: ma gyur sems can rigs drug sdug bsngal bcas: 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor thar med bying ba rnams: thugs rje'i 'od kyi lcags kyus rjes bzung nas: rnga yab dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs:

༈ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsol 'debs ci rigs bzla/ bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po in+d+ra nī la ltar gsal zhing 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ de'i mthar sngags phreng rnams skar ma'i phreng ba ltar rang sgra dang bcas bkra lam mer 'khor bar gyur/ rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dza: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de las sngags kyi 'od zer khra lam gyis byung ba rang zhal nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ slar sngags kyi 'od zer mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ las sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru he ru ka ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang sngags kyi 'od zer rigs drug gi gnas su 'phros pas so so'i las nyon sbyangs nas thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i skur gyur cing*/ sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam/ gcig dril las sbyor ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bum sgrub/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa'i rjes rig me dor ba dang*/ gnang zhus sogs spyi chings ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa la brten nas cir snang tshogs drug rang grol gyi gdams pa'i le tshan no// // ༈ bzhi pa/ o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mo dang bcas par brten nas 'chi 'pho 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi zhal gdams dang 'brel ba'i o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi sgrub thabs ka dag rang grol ltar bya ba la/

gsol 'debs ni/ na mo: ka dag bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas: kun bzang 'gyur med gsal stong ye shes che: sna tshogs ma 'gags khyab brdal lhun gyis grub: mkha' ltar rnam dag 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: skye 'chi gnyis spangs gu ru pad+ma 'byung : phung khams rnam dag mkha' 'gro rig ma'i tshogs: 'byung bzhi gdos bral dri med rab gsal sku: dam pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung skye ba med pa'i snod mchog tu: tshogs drug yid la rgyas pa'i mchod sprin gtibs: khams lnga dbang po'i sman raka gtor mchod bcas: bla med mchog gi bde ba dgyes phyir spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta āḥhūm̐: de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de la 'khor 'das sgyu mar brten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying rje la: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: pad nyi zla gdan steng du shar: pho brang lha dang zhal phyag rdzogs: om̐ rat+na pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrī las ma chags mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: rgya gar rig 'dzin sprul sku'i cha lugs can: sku mdog dkar dmar gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: spyan lnga ldan zhing thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: dbu la pad+ma'i sag zhu'i cod pan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon sdug bsngal skyabs: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: sku la chos gos rnam gsum mdzes pas brgyan: zhabs gnyis bde chen rdo rje'i stabs kyis bzhugs: rig ma kha ṭ+wāṃ be'u bum rnam par gsal: rang bzhin ye shes rol pa'i ngang du bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan gyi steng : spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgrol ma bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang phyed pa'i skyil mo krung : rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram g.yas: g.yon rnams thams cad dril bu dkur brten pa: rigs lnga'i dar dpyangs la sogs zhi ba'i chas: 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thugs rje'i byin rlabs bskul: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog nas: paṇa chen pad+ma kā ra la: rigs bzhi 'byung lnga'i lha mos bskor: phung khams skye mched gnas dag pa'i: zang thal chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du: spyan 'dren byin 'bebs gshegs su gsol: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag gyur stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : 'ja' lus sku brnyes bla ma mtsho skyes rje: rgya gar paṇa chen bde chen yum dang bcas: brtan par bzhugs shig sarba tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: phyi yul tshogs drug nang rig stong pa'i ngang : ma 'gags gsal stong yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas: thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: gu ru ḍāk+ki pu ru sha ya hoḥ dbang bzhi stsol cig dz+nyā na badz+ra om̐: sku bzhi lhun grub pradz+nyā ha ra āḥ ka dag bde chen dharma ga ga hūm̐: sna tshogs ma 'gags ghu ya sid+dhi trām̐: dga' bzhi dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga hrīḥ byin rlabs mchog thun gu h+ya sid+dhi hoḥ gsal stong ma 'gags bai ro tsa na satwaṃ: kun bzhi ye grol skye med a la la: om̐ a dhiṣ+ṭha na maṅga laṃ shrī ye sarba ta thā bh+ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: hoḥ mchog gi dwangs ma dgyes pa'i phyir: mdzes pa'i lha mo puṣ+pe hoḥ dri zhim zhen pa tshor stong phyir: rgyun bzang ngad ldan dhū pe hoḥ gzugs kyi 'dzin pa rnam dag phyir: snang stong 'dzin pa ā lo ke: 'ja' lus sku la sgrib bral phyir: sman mchog gtams pa gan+dhe hoḥ ro yi srid pa rnam dag phyir: bcud ldan nai d+ye wi ti hoḥ grags stong skye med rtogs pa'i phyir: sna tshogs sgra snyan shab+da hoḥ sgyu ma 'od skur grol ba'i phyir: mdzes pa'i reg bya spar+she hoḥ om̐ sarba pū dza dz+nyā na hoḥ mchog gi yon tan lnga dang ldan: ma hā pañca a mṛ ta hoḥ 'dod yon longs spyod rgyan gyis phyug: bha ling+ta pū dza māṃ sa hoḥ chags med 'khor ba stong pa'i phyir: rā ga rak+ta pū dza hoḥ rgyud drug dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: ma traṃ ru tra mā ra hoḥ zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i phyir: sa khams pra mo ti ri hoḥ mchog gi dang po kho na nyid: dharma kau ri su khaṃ hoḥ sarba ma hā me gha pū dza hoḥ

de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas thugs rje byin rlabs bskul: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi 'od dkar 'dzin: phrin las rab 'byams sa bon 'phros pa las: hrīḥyig ma chags 'o mtsho'i pad sdong rtser: skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs pad+ma 'byung : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes bgres rgud bral: thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa'i sku: mtshan dpe'i sku la 'od dkyil gzi brjid 'bar: mtshan thos dran pas ngan 'gro'i gdung ba sel: byin rlabs dpal 'bar 'byung bzhi'i bar chad zhi: rig 'dzin gtso bo mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: mtshungs med 'gro mgon pad 'byung sku la bstod: hūm̐: dbu la mdzes pa'i pad zhwa gsol ba ni: mu stegs rgol ba'i bdud dpung 'joms par byed: chos gos rnam gsum rgyan gyis phyug pa yis: mdo sngags rgyud sde'i bstan pa spel bar byed: phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon mdzad pa yis: bdud bzhi nyon mongs zil gyis gnon par byed: phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag bhan+dha tshe bum gyis: 'ja' lus sku brnyes dbyings rig sbyor bar byed: kha ṭ+wāṃ gsang ba'i shes rab ni dhī las: bde stong ye shes gnyis med ston par byed: zhabs gnyis rdo rje thabs shes bzhugs stangs kyis: nam mkha'i rang bzhin mi g.yo gyad kyi sku: rgya gar paṇa chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sa khams rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi yum: bad kan nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: 'khor lo dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu khams rnam dag rin chen rigs kyi yum: mkhris pa'i nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rin chen dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen mā kī'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: me khams rnam dag pad+ma rigs kyi yum: 'dus pa'i nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: pad+ma dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs:

yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rlung khams rnam dag las kyi rigs kyi yum: rlung gi nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rgya gram dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap khang dbye ba spyi chings ltar/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: thugs rje'i phrin las 'dzam bu gling du shar: mkhyen brtse nus pas skye dgu'i gdung ba sel: 'gran gyis zla bral o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin rlabs ka dag klong nas rgyud bskul la: bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dam pa rje btsun nyid ltar bdag gyur cig: ༈ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya / bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag nyid gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dbus pad nyi zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar thugs srog hrīḥyig zla ba nya rgyas lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ de'i mthar bzla bya'i yig 'bru rnams skar ma'i phreng ba ltar rang sgra dang bcas bkra lam mer 'khor bar gyur/ de las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung nas mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slar sngags kyi 'od zer mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas phyi nang snod bcud 'byung ba lnga'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur bsdus bdag mdun dang sgrub rdzas la thim pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub pa'i nus pa spel 'gro ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs shing dag par byas/

snang grags rig gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'byams klas par gyur/ om̐ badz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki mūm̐ shrī hūm̐: bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig dril du bzla'o/ /bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs spyi ltar mtshungs so/ /bzhi pa o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mo dang bcas par brten nas 'chi 'pho 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi zhal gdams kyi le tshan no// // ༈ lnga pa/ o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs la brten nas nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa dbyings su 'pho ba mkha' spyod sgrub pa ye shes zang thal ltar sgrub pa la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dbyings rig ye shes skye ba med pa'i sku: zag med mchog dga' ye shes rab bskul ba'i: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dge des bdag gi ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do/ /tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin kho na nyid: yid sprul blo yis blangs te sprul pa'i tshogs: gsang ba ḍāk+ki mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐:

zhes pas byin gyis brlabs: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bh+rūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas zla gam sgo gcig pa: phyi nang mtshan tshang yon tan ldan pa'i lhun: chos 'byung mthing ga 'bar ba e yi klong : de dbus pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: nyi zla ti ra dbugs bral snying kha ru: hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i rje btsun rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad khros pa'i nyams: phag zhal dbu rgyan skra grol dbyings la gzigs: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs: rus pa'i rgyan drug zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum can: gru mor brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ he ru ka'iḥ gar gyi nyams ldan 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs: ral pa'i khrod na rigs bdag dang bcas gsal: phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'grau bzhi: gtso mthun nyams gyur ma nges gar stabs ldan: 'khor du 'bum phrag mkha' spyod ḍāk+ki gtibs: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rnam par gsal: de ltar thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki baṃ bha ra hi sa ma ya ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ ma: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: glu len gar bsgyur shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: ḍāk+ki sprin ltar thibs se thib: byin rlabs thugs rje sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur phyir: pad nyi bam gyi gdan la bzhugs:

mos pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: dam tshig g.yel ba mthol lo bshags: ma khyed brtse bas bsgrubs lags na: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa yi: ye shes 'pho ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ badz+ra shud+dhe hoḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon: yid las bkod pa sna tshogs dpag yas gtibs: rab 'byams zhing dang zhing rdul gtams pa'i tshogs: yum chen dbyings phyug ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sha lnga bdud rtsi pañca a mṛ ta: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ngo bo'i mchog: khyad par mchog chen ma hā rak+ta dang : bha ling la sogs dbang po rnam lnga'i rgyan: spyan gzigs mda' dar bla rten du mar bcas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin sna tshogs 'di: ma rgyud gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas mkha' spyod 'ja' lus 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ta bha su ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba ḍāk+ki nī i daṃ bha ling+ta pū dza me gha ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ badz+ra bha ra hi ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

om̐ sa ma ya ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bhi shwa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sarba ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas bdud rtsi 'bul: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ ma: dbyings rig skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul skur snang ba: chags med pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'phro: thugs rje'i 'phrul gyis 'dzin pa'i dbang mo che: gzugs mdzes lta na yid sdug tshul bzang ma: dga' ba'i mdangs 'phro bzhin gyis yid rab g.yo: lang tshos dkri ba'i mnyen lcug 'khril legs 'khyud: yid la 'khu ba'i mtshan dpes bde ba ster: rjes chags dgyes pas gzhan snang dbang sdud phyir: rab g.yo rnal 'byor ma khyod rtag tu bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dbang lhun dgyes pa'i rab dga' mo: khro 'dzum spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra 'byin: thod skam dang ni dar dmar cod pan 'phur: rin chen snyan cha gdu bu se mo do: phyag g.yas zangs gris skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pa'i bhan+dha nyon mongs klad khrag rol: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum gnas nas spar: rus pa'i rgyan drug phar phyin don dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar bsgyur snying rjes 'gro drug 'dren: 'od lnga'i klong bzhugs sku lnga lhun gyis grub: mkha' spyod zhing khams sgo 'gyed mkha' 'gro ma: bde chen rnal 'byor yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhe sdang zhi mdzad me long ye shes sku: mngon dga'i zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: zhi ba dkar mdzes brdzus skyes sdug bsngal skyobs: mkha' spyod rdo rje ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nga rgyal zhi mdzad mnyam nyid ye shes sku: dpal ldan zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo dgyes mdzad mngal skyes sdug bsngal skyobs: sa spyod rin chen ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'dod chags zhi mdzad sor rtogs ye shes sku:

bde chen zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo rjes chags drod gsher sdug bsngal skyobs: bde spyod pad+ma ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrag dog zhi mdzad bya grub ye shes sku: las rab zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: ljang mo rab g.yos sgong skyes sdug bsngal skyobs: gsang spyod las kyi ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phung khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'khor lo mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin la: bde chen thig le dpa' bo lhan cig skyes: a haṃ thabs shes zag med bde stong dang : myur lam mchog gi nā da rab g.yo ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap khang dbye ba spyi chings ltar/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul nas: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir: ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung po 'od lus chos skur 'grub pa dang : ma khyed bdag gi dpung dang gnyen mchis phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ༈ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ thugs kar 'od lnga'i thig le'i dbus/ /ye shes sems ma kun bzang mo'i/ /thugs dbus nyi steng hūm̐ dmar po'i/ /mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ /'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas/ /snod bcud mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor blta/ /rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ las sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ye shes 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i snying po: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na hrīḥ bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs spyi chings ltar ro/ /lnga pa o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs la brten nas nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad tshe rig pa dbyings su 'pho ba'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa ye shes zang thal gyi le tshan no/ /de dag gis stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i le tshan zhal gdams lnga grub nas/ da ni smad las gang 'dul der ston dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams lnga dang 'brel ba ste/ le'u drug pa nas bcu pa'i bar ro// // ༈ drug pa/ o rgyan nor lha dbyer med la bsten nas/ sems can dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung sel o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i sgrub thabs rat+na'i rgyal mtshan ltar sgrub pa la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po la: bsod nams spel zhing bsgrub phyir skyabs su mchi: o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha bsgrubs nas ni/ gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o:

tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mdzod: bsod nams tshogs zhing bsgrub phyir bla med rdzas: kun 'dus rgyal ba mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dis: pad 'byung nor lha'i dkyil 'khor dgyes gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ a hūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed ni: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: rin chen las grub rnam rgyal gzhal yas khang : sgo gru rta babs rtsig rim nor bu'i tog: phyi nang bkod pa rgyan rdzogs gzhal yas khang : de dbus rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: hrīḥm hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i mgon po ni: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer med dran rdzogs su: pad+ma rgyal po dbang lhun gzi brjid 'bar: sgeg pa'i cha byad khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i gar: rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas sku lus brgyan: g.yas pas rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha ne'u le pad+ma thogs: lha rdzas stod g.yogs smad dkris ang rag bklubs: phyed skyil pang du dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril:

lcags kyu pad+ma yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yas su lha lcam g.yon du mtsho rgyal ma: gnyis ka gcer mo rin chen du mas brgyan: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan cod pan 'phur: g.yas g.yon phyag na rdo rje pad+ma bsnams: dal 'gying nyams ldan gtso la chags pa'i tshul: phyogs bzhir 'gugs pa'i las byed pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu ne'u le thogs: snang srid skye 'gro kun gyi tshe bsod sdud: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin stsol ba'i sku ru gsal: bskyed pa'i bdag mdun mi dmigs thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros skad cig gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren zhing phyag mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung rang bzhin dbang gi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : yid bzhin nor mchog bla ma dzam+bha la: dbang sdud ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la mchog thun stsol ba'i slad: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rten la 'bral med bzhugs: bdag gi tshe rabs kun tu nyid bsgrub phyir: dam tshig dbyer med gus pas phyag bgyid do: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: badz+ra pu ru sha ya hoḥ hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran bkod pa'i tshom bu la: lha mi'i nor rdzas yo byad rgyan gyis phyug: snang srid 'di ru ci srid 'tshogs pa yi: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i 'dod rgu'i tshogs: pad 'byung nor lha dgyes phyir mchod pa 'bul: sgrub la tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang srid: yid la smon pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī pad+ma rā dza ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sa ma ya sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ma chags skyon bral dbang gi longs spyod rdzogs:

'dod rgu'i srid rje pad+ma rgyal po rtsal: dbyings phyug tshangs pa'i cha shas rnam par rol: yid 'phrog dbang sdud ma hā dhe wa'i dpyid: 'gugs pa'i rnam rol khyab 'jug zhags pa'i rlung : dbyangs can mi mo 'phrog byed mdza' na mo: seṅge gnas dang mo ma'i sor rtse nyul: 'dar ma'i rlung gis bde chen g.yo ba bzhin: snang srid dbang bsgyur chags pa'i mdangs ngar can: gzi 'od 'bum bzhin pho nya 'gugs byed 'phro: yab yum dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap khang dbye ba spyi chings ltar/ dzap bskul ni/ de ltar bstod cing bskul nas bsgrub pa'i lha: pad+ma 'byung gnas yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal: gsang ba ḍāk+ki bde chen skyed pa'i yum: 'du 'bral med par gsol btab bsgrubs lags na: thugs rje'i 'od dkar dus las mi 'da' bar: zhal mthong lung ston dngos grub sna tshogs stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ༈ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bzlas dmigs khyad par can ni/ bdag mdun pad+ma rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ hūm̐ yig dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can gyi ha khog tu hrīḥyis mtshan par gsal ba'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing dang lho nub pad+ma 'od sogs zhing khams mu med par 'phros pas phyogs dus rgyal ba rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ byin rlabs 'od dmar gyi rnam pa tshur bsdus nas/ rang dang sgrub rdzas la thim pas mchog thun grub gnyis zad mi shes pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor grub par gyur/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pas/

skye 'gro lha 'dre mi gsum sogs mthong thos dran rig thams cad/ rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar rang dbang gi brtan pa dang bral bar/ dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan pas srid pa gsum na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/ slar yang sngar bzhin thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ snod bcud kyi rgud pa bcom/ tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod thams cad 'phel bar byas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten o rgyan nor lha'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sku dang*/ sgra ru grags pa thams cad rdo rje'i sngags kyi rang sgra/ dran rtog thams cad chos nyid ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rtsa sngags dang*/ om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra rat+na mu ṭa pad+ma rā ga he sha sarba ak+ṣo bh+ya pra mo ti sarba wi ṭa ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza pā shaṃ ma ma 'dus 'dus swā hā: oṃ ka ye ku ye ku ru le pā shaṃ she pha k+ṣa dza dza swā hā: nor sgrub dang dbang sdud kyi sngags so/ /bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs spyi chings ltar ro/ /dmigs bsal g.yang gtad dang 'brel na bum sgrub kyi mthar g.yang 'gugs dngos grub char 'bebs kyang skabs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /mtha' rten tshogs 'khor sogs spyi chings ltar ro/ /drug pa o rgyan nor lha dbyer med la bsten nas sems can dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung sel gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bdun pa/ o rgyan sman lha dang 'brel ba'i dug lnga'i nad sel 'chi med bcud dril ltar sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo: sku lnga mtshan brgyad o rgyan rin po che: bdag sogs tshe la bar chad sdang lags na: 'gro mgon sman lha'i dkyil 'khor dal bzung nas: 'gro kun nyon mongs nad las grol bar mdzod:

'gro don smin grol chos 'khor bskor du gsol: gsol 'debs dang*/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dkar bgegs sogs dgos tshe spyi chings bzhin bya'o/ /mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen pos dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po cir yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying po gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐:

om̐ hūm̐ trām̐: om̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ nyid zhu ba las: bhan+dha yangs pa rin chen gzhal yas khang : gru chad zlum skor phrin las rnam bzhi ldan: de dbus rdo rje rgya gram lte bar hūm̐: dran rdzogs gnas 'gyur seṅge sgra sgrogs sku: mthing nag khro tshul spyi bor seng zhal gdangs: seng ldeng gaṇ+ḍi sgrogs pas stong gsum g.yo: 'bar ba'i dbu skra thod skam phreng bas brgyan: sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi lhab tu gsol: rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu bsnams: brkyang bskum gar ldan zung 'jug yum la 'khril: lha mchog de la 'khril ba'i rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zung 'jug yab la 'khril: yab yum ye shes rab 'bar klong du gsal: de yi spyi bor gu ru dug lnga sel: sman lha mthing ga zhi 'dzum thor tshugs can: phyag g.yas rnam par rgyal ba'i a ru ra: 'gro la sman sbyin phyag rgya mchog sbyin can: phyag g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs: mnyam bzhag dgongs pas tshe yi bar chad sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs bsgom: bhan+dha'i phyogs bzhir 'gugs pa'i lha mo bzhis: rang rtags phyag rgyas 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus nas: yab yum sku la gnyis med thim par bsgom: slar yang rang gi thugs kar hūm̐ gsal ba'i: 'od dang mdun bskyed dam tshig sa bon gyis: ye shes lha tshogs skad cig spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni ma ga dha yi yul: mu stegs 'dul mdzad gnam lcags zor mda' 'phen: bdud dang 'byung po bgegs srin tshar gcod pa: rje btsun drag po gtum chen gshegs su gsol: drag mo rnal 'byor phag gdong gshegs su gsol: rigs bdag sman lha 'tsho mdzad gshegs su gsol:

deng 'dir gso ba sman gyi dkyil 'khor du: dam ye dbyer med brtan par bzhugs nas su: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur du gsol: om̐ badz+ra bhai ṣa dz+yai rā dza ya ā yur ṣe badz+ra sengha gan+ḍa bai ro tsa na bha ra hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: a we sha ya badz+ra a mṛ ta tsaṇ+ḍa mu tra ak+ṣo bhai swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ na mo pū ru sha ya ho/ zhes spyan drangs shing dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'chi med dbang po sman gyi dkyil 'khor lha: 'ja' lus sgrub mchog tshe yi rig 'dzin la: phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med mchod pas mchod: dgyes par bzhes nas 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'chi med ngo bo pad 'byung sman gyi lha: tshe bdud tshar gcod drag po seṅge'i sgra: rtsa rlung dpal bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor yum: snod kyi bcud 'gugs pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad lha: dug gsum nad sel dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: rlung mkhris bad kan khrag dang 'dus pa yi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar dang*/ ༈ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ dmigs pa khyad par can ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag po yab yum gyi thugs dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtha' mar sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phros/

rigs bdag o rgyan sman gyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ phyag gis 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ slar yang 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi sman lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag mdun thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi sman 'dzin mkha' 'gro sde bzhir bskul bas phyag rgya'i 'od zer snod bcud 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus shing*/ bdag dang sgrub rdzas la thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mos la/ rtsa sngags ni: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: las sngags: auṇ+ya ya sengha gan+ḍe badz+ra wa ra hi ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba pañca hrīḥṭhaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sham bur: om̐ badz+ra gu ru bir+ya pā ṇi sarba a dhiṣ+ṭha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: 'di nyid so sor ci nus bzla: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā ghan+ḍa badz+ra bha ra hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ

bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba rjes kyi tshogs skong sogs spyi chings ltar mtshungs so/ /bdun pa o rgyan sman lha dang 'brel ba'i dug lnga'i nad sel gyi le tshan no// // ༈ brgyad pa/ o rgyan rdo rje gur la brten nas pha rol bdud rgol zhi byed rdo rje gur gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med gnam lcags ri bo ltar sgrub par byed pa la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la: rdo rje skye 'chi 'jigs dang bral: rdo rje bgres rgud gzhom gzhig med: bla ma o rgyan rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje 'dzin la skyabs su mchi: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni/ /gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen pos dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las:

brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ nyid yongs su gyur pa las: rlung ri mi shigs srid pa'i rdo rje ni: rgya gram bsnol ba mi 'gul sra brtan gsal: de steng 'bar ba spu gri'i 'khor lo ni: gyen du kha phyogs bar du dgra bgegs gsal: steng na chu gri'i 'khor lo mthur du sbub: lte ba'i dbal sos dgra bgegs snying khar bsnun: de steng sa gzhi rdo rje rgya gram brdal: de dbus rdo rje gsum tshom gzhal yas khang : lte ba'i dbus su pad 'byung gnas gyur pa'i: gsang bdag mthing nag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu rgyan spyi bor khyung chen lding : sku la mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: dur khrod chas rdzogs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram thogs: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse nas thog rgod 'bebs: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon: thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: ting 'dzin sems dpa' nā da'i nang du gsal: drag sngags tshwa tshwa dang bcas g.yas su 'khor: phyi nang ba spu'i bu gar khro chung gtams: rtsibs la rang 'dra'i khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: rang srung sngags rnams bung ba'i dbyangs ltar sgrog: rab 'jigs me dpung mched pa'i klong du gsal: shar phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar las: gtum po rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog dkar: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu thogs: lho phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ser las: gtum po mi g.yo mgon po sku mdog ser: phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs: nub phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar las:

gtum po dbang phyug stobs chen sku mdog dmar: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas zhags dmar thogs: byang phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon las: gtum po dbyug pa thogs pa sku mdog sngo: phyag g.yas rdor dbyug g.yon pas dril bu thogs: thams cad gtso bo'i cha lugs rngam tshul can: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thogs pa grangs med 'phros: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: dam tshig sems dpa' rang mdog dang bcas gsal: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra'i khro bo yis: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thogs pa grangs med 'phros: pha rol byad ma'i g.yul ngo rdul du brlag: phyi rol mtshon cha'i dbal kha dgra la 'debs: nang du rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur: bskal pa'i me ri 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal: de ltar pho brang lha bcas bskyed pa yis: bdag mdun thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'phro 'du yis: pad 'byung dregs pa 'dul mdzad spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: gsang bdag g.yul las rgyal byed khro bo'i 'khor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i nus pas skyobs: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: mi shigs sra brtan pho brang rdo rje'i gur: mi 'gyur gnam lcags ur mo'i gzer gyis bsdams: rdo rje bsnol thabs lte dbus gdan gyi steng : gtum chen rdo rje'i go cha bzhugs su gsol: bdag gis gsol 'debs mos pas gus phyag bgyid: 'gro mgon bdud bzhi bcom pa'i gar thabs can: lhag pa'i lha mchog snang srid 'dul la bstod: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku la dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab 'bul: gsung la dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'bul:

thugs la dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rdzong chen 'bul: yon tan dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i pho nya 'bul: phrin las dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'bul: drug cu rtsa bzhi'i drwa mig skyong ba'i phyir: phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod lha mo 'bul: khyad par gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i phyir: dgra sha khrag mchod 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : gsang bdag rdo rje'i go khrab thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs khro bo rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs khro bo mi g.yo'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs khro bo stobs chen thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs khro bo dbyug sngon thugs dam bskang : drwa mig skyong mdzad rdo rje'i pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gnam lcags gdugs kyi rtsibs la 'gyu ba yi: gdugs dkar lha mo nyer gcig thugs dam bskang : 'khor lo mtshon cha'i rtse la 'gyu ba yi: gzhan gyis mi thub khro mo gdugs dkar mo: ma mo g.yul bzlog ma yi thugs dam bskang : gyad bzhir gnyis 'phros brgyad dang steng 'og bcu: gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i thugs dam bskang : dbal la 'phro ba gnod mdzes bgegs mthar byed: gtum po las byed sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas mi shigs rdo rje yis: mkha' dang srid pa rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra lo ha par+she badz+ra shang ha badz+ra ko ṭi badz+ra dha ra bha la badz+ra ā yur dha badz+ra ma tri ma tri ya tri ya me gha pū dza hoḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gnam lcags 'khor lo'i dbus 'gyings gar gyi dbang : gsang bdag tshul 'dzin ma rungs 'joms mdzad pa: gtum chen khro bo gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal: dpal chen sde bzhir gling bzhis 'gran zla bral: 'bar ma pho nya ma mo srid pa'i 'khor: ye shes ngang las las kyi cho 'phrul du:

'khor 'das gnyis med dbang bsgyur rdo rje'i sku: 'gyur med 'gags med 'khrul med mnyam pa nyid: ngo bo ye shes rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: pad 'byung gtum po'i skur bzhengs bdud 'joms pa: khro bo 'khor dang las kyi pho nya mo: rdo rje gur gyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap khang dbye ba spyi chings ltar/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i phyir: deng 'dir thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa la: drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'grub par mdzod: ༈ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag mdun gyi lha'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ sngags phreng me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas g.yas su 'khor ba las rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin snang srid khyab/ srid gsum gyi lha 'dre sogs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag gi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas thugs srog la thim pas/ gzi brjid cher rgyas pa'i 'od zer las mchod sprin gyi lha mo grangs med pa spros te rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams la mnyes mchod phul de thams cad kyi thugs dam dgyes pa bskyed nas/ gsang bdag rdo rje'i gtum po'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya dang sngags phreng 'od zer gyi tshul du bdag la thim pas srid gsum kun tu che btsan 'gran zla med par gyur ba'i che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed bzhin rtsa sngags bzla/ rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje'i thugs kyi sngags ni: hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭḥ yang thugs srog gi sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad cing rang gi zhal nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing slar lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs te thugs srog la thim/ thugs kyi 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal nas drag sngags 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra dang*/ 'od zer mthing nag dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing 'od zer mkha' khyab tu brdal bas rgyal ba rnams mnyes par byas/ dam can rnams las la bskul/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dpa' bskyed/ 'jig rten dregs pa rnams dbang du bsdus/ khams sum gyi log rtog zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ snang srid snod bcud dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs par mos la sgrub sngags/ rdo rje rol pa'i snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rdo rje 'gyed pa'i snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra ghar+bha tsaṇ+ḍa khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rdo rje gur gyi snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra ṇi bh+rūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje mtshon thogs kyi sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra tik+ṇa dz+wa la raṃ ts+tshi ka tshan+dha pre sha duṣatsa ṭi te a mu ka ma ra ṇa na kharga: badz+ra kī la ya ru tra sha truṃ: tshin+dha tshin+dha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: ma tha ma tha: dhu na dhu na: krak+ko sha ya rbad: hu ra hu ra nan nan tsit+ta sha ma sha ni: mā ra mā ra rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: las sbyor srung bzlog bsad pa'i dmigs pa bcas srung bzlog sngags nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzla'o/ /bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ /brgyad pa o rgyan rdo rje gur la brten nas pha rol bdud rgol zhi byed rdo rje'i gur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ dgu pa/ o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi'i dgongs pa la brten nas bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad las skyob par byed pa o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi sgrub thabs dmod pa'i spu gri bdud dpung mthar byed ltar sgrub pa la/

gsol 'debs ni/ na mo: dbang drag rol pa'i cho 'phrul dgyes pa'i gar: dpal chen khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod: lha srin gdug pa 'dul phyir skur bzhengs pa'i: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ sde brgyad lha srin 'dul ba'i drag rtsal can: mngon spyod chen po'i dus las mi 'da' phyir: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zhi ba dang : gcan 'phrang la sogs ma rungs 'dul ba'i phyir: phyag rgya zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mod: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing : 'gro kun gnas chen bgrod par sems bskyed do: lam log lam gol 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: thog mar skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon ltar las: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: phyi mchod sna tshogs 'dod yon gter: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga:

blo yis blangs te dmigs pa'i tshogs: rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: e las gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: rdo rwa dur khrod me ris bskor: phyi nang dmar chen rlabs su 'khyil: de dbus pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las dpal chen he ru kaḥ dmar nag gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ am gtsigs khro gnyer spyan rtsa 'khrugs: dbu la bdud 'dul sngags zhwa gsol: phyag g.yas rtse gsum klad la bskor: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsgril: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: dug sbrul nag po'i sku rags bcings: sked par gnam lcags phur bu 'chang : zung 'jug dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis zil gnon gar stabs can: khrag 'thung mngon spyod tshul du gsal: hūm̐: shar du 'gugs byed khro bo dkar: rnam rgyal beng dang lcags kyu thogs: lho ru 'ching byed khro bo ser: gshin rje kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags pa 'dzin: nub tu sdom byed khro bo dmar: rta mgrin dbyug pa lcags sgrog bsnams: byang du myos byed khro bo mthing : dbyug sngon dgra satwa dril bu thogs: kun kyang dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: gtum rngam bzhad gshe khro gar bsgyur: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum sgrol: dregs pa kun 'dul lha tshogs rnams: ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams skad cig gis snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs las byon te snang srid thams cad dngangs shing 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin can du bsgom:
om̐ ram̐ ram̐ badz+ra he ru ka kro ta tsa tur he phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ

spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: dregs pa zil gnon 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya ldan: gtum gshe rngam dang dgod pa'i khro bos bskor: snang srid dbang du sdus phyir gshegs su gsol: srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir gshegs su gsol: sde brgyad bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: ma mo las la mngag phyir gshegs su gsol: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bstan dgra cham la dbab phyir gshegs su gsol: sgos dgra thal bar brlag phyir gshegs su gsol: gcan 'phrang gdug pa gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: gzugs can gzugs med 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: dam can pho nya 'gyed phyir gshegs su gsol: chos skyong dgra la rbad phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya āḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ: de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: nyi zla pad+ma bam ro'i steng : dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i khro tshogs rnams: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i phyir: phrin las drag po'i skur bstan nas: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar stabs kyis: rab tu dwang bas phyag bgyid do: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po khro bo'i rgyal: 'jigs byed dregs pa zil gnon lha tshogs la: dbang po'i me tog gu gul bdug pa'i spos: tshil chen mar me dmar chen dri chab gtams: 'bru nag gri khrag sbags pa'i bha ling+ta: sman sbyor drag rdzas ngar btags tshogs gtor bcas: gtum chen phyag rgya zil gnon khro bo bzhi: khrag 'thung mngon spyod lha la mchod pa 'bul: snang srid dregs pa 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms pa'i dus la bab:

lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gcan 'phrang gdug pa sgrol ba'i dus la bab: srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī ri ti raṃ ha la rak+ta so sa kā la bha ling+ta shab+da shang kha dum du bhi gaṇ+ḍi ye kro ta he ru ka sarba tsa dur kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sarba pañca rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza māṃ sa go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'jigs rung e las grub pa'i pho brang nas: stobs bcu'i dbyings la ye shes rdzogs pa'i lha: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ khros pa'i gar gyis srid gsum gnas nas spar: bdud dpung gzhom phyir spyi bor sngags zhwas brgyan: khro chu'i dbal ldan mche ba am gtsigs bsdams: spyan rtsa sdang mig smin ma glog ltar 'khyugs: snyan nas drag po'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: shangs nas gnam lcags bu yug tshwa tshwa 'thor: ba spu'i dbyings nas khro bcu'i sprul pa 'gyed: phyag g.yas stong gsum snyil ba'i mkhar phur 'phyar: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pas bar chad sgrol: gnam lcags phur pa sked bcug bstan dgra sgrol: dur khrod chas ldan bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo 'joms: rin chen rgyan ldan ma sring dbang du sdud: dar nag ber chen snang srid dngangs shing 'dar: sbrul nag chings rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: rgya lham mthing nag dam sri'i mgo bo 'gems: me dpung dmar nag 'tshub cing rlung nag g.yo: sku la mtshon cha'i bu yug chi li li: gnam lcags thog char dgra bgegs steng du 'bebs: che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i dpa' bo che: yang le shod du dmar nag gro bo lod: yang phur bde chen snying po sgrub pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phur pa rnam gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub: bal bod mtshams su lha 'dres srog snying phul:

dregs pa'i sde dpon shān+tiṃ ghar+bha la: rig 'dzin bdag gis gus pas nyer bstod na: sa lam bar gcod zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs khro chen rnam par rgyal: 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya lcags kyu gdengs: shar phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: lcags kyu 'bar bas snying nas zungs: g.yas pa'i beng gis rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: shar phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: rnam par rgyal la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lho phyogs khro chen gshin rje'i gshed: 'ching ba'i phyag rgya zhags pa 'khyugs: lho phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: zhags pa can gyis mgul nas 'ching : rtse gsum mtshon chas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: lho phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: gshin rje'i gshed la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: nub phyogs khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: sdom pa'i phyag rgya lcags sgrog spro: nub phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdom: dbyug pa 'bar bas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: nub phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: rta mgrin rgyal por bdag bstod do: hūm̐: byang phyogs khro chen dbyug pa sngo: myos pa'i phyag rgya dril bu 'khrol: byang phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: dril bu 'bar bas myos su chug: dgra satwa 'bar bas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: byang phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: dbyug pa sngon por bdag bstod do: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar la/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i phyir: deng 'dir thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa la:

drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'grub par mdzod: ༈ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig dmar nag sngags phreng me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas/ g.yas su 'khor ba las rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin snang srid khyab/ srid gsum gyi lha 'dre sogs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag gi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas thugs srog la thim pas/ gzi brjid cher rgyas pa'i 'od zer las mchod sprin gyi lha mo grangs med pa spros te/ rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams la mnyes mchod phul bas de thams cad kyi thugs dam dgyes pa bskyed nas/ dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi tshul du bdag la thim pas srid gsum kun tu che btsan 'gran zla med par gyur ba'i che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed bzhin rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang thugs srog gi sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing slar lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs te thugs srog la thim/ thugs kyi 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal nas drag sngags 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra dang 'od zer mthing nag dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing 'od zer mkha' khyab tu brdal bas rgyal ba rnams mnyes par byas/

dam can rnams las la bskul/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dpa' bskyed/ 'jig rten dregs pa rnams dbang du bsdus/ khams sum gyi log rtog zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs par gyur/ sgrub sngags ni: om̐ kro ta a pa rā tsi ta bi dza ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa nī la daṇ+ḍa kro ta sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags 'di sgrub pa'i skabs su gang 'grub 'bungs: mtshon phur gyi sngags ni: om̐ ka la he ka shrī kro ta karma raṃ raṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lam 'phrang gi bar gcod thams cad bigh+nān trig nan: thar ni thar ni 'ching ya: mi rgod dgra bo'i bla snying satwaṃ bha ya nan: sum bha ni trig thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ /dgu pa o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi'i dgongs pa la brten nas bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad las skyob par byed pa o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bcu pa/ o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la brten nas/ hor sog dmag gi g.yul bzlog dregs pa dmag 'gyed shan pa spu gri ltar sgrub pa la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: bla ma bder 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: drag po thod phreng gtum chen bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las bgyid pa yis: bdud dang mu stegs 'joms par dam bca'o: dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o:

tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: thod pa skam rlon lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang : dbang po rnam lnga dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs: ri ltar spungs shing 'khor yug kun la khyab: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis spel: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed sngags ni: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: ru tra ti ra bam̐ ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: hūm̐: e las grub pa'i gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : zur bzhi logs brgyad khro chu khol ma'i dbus: bdud dgra mu stegs bsgral ba'i snying kha ru: hūm̐ las bdag nyid bdud 'joms nag po'i sku: rdo rje thod phreng shān+tiṃ ghar+bha ni: dmod pa'i las chas dregs pa yongs kyi gtso: snying rje khros pas bdud bzhi 'joms par byed: srid gsum srog bdag gshin rje khros pa'i tshul: sku mdog nag po dam nyams kun gyi gshed:

mu stegs rgol ba 'joms pa'i gnod sbyin che: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu'i mtshon: rwa yi g.yas zur gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor: g.yon par srog bdag khros pa'i lcags sdig ni: mgo dgu kha dgu rwa ni bco brgyad gzengs: sdig pa'i kha nas dug rlangs mtshon cha ni: gnam lcags las grub phur bu char du 'bebs: srid gsum phrin las kun 'dus gshegs su gsol: mu stegs 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha khrag dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: kham nag ral pa gzengs pa'i skra gseb nas: sprul pa'i bya khyung grangs med thog ltar 'gyed: thod skam dbu rgyan dar nag pu ru ru: dmar zlum spyan rtsa sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril dgra yul hab kyis za: ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung mtshon thogs 'phro: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham mgo phreng brjid: rdo rje'i go dang spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal sbrul chun 'khyugs: srid gsum tshar gcod sku smad dbal zur ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug tsha ngar ldan: byad ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: dgra bgegs dmag dpung gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya: om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma rbod gtong gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar phyogs rtsibs steng lha yi dregs pa ni: shel khrab rmog zhu ral gri ru mtshon thogs: lha g.yag bzhon nas shar phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: shar phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na shar phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

hūm̐: lho phyogs rtsibs steng gshin rje dregs pa ni: mchong khrab rmog zhu khram shing ru mtshon thogs: ma he bzhon nas lho phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: lho phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na lho phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub phyogs rtsibs steng ma mo dregs pa ni: dung khrab rmog zhu phur pa nad rkyal thogs: g.yu 'brug bzhon nas nub phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: nub phyogs dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: du ru tsa sha na a ya ma nub phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: byang phyogs rtsibs steng bdud kyi dregs pa ni: lcags khrab rmog zhu dgra satwa zhags pa thogs: bdud rta bzhon nas byang phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: byang phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: du ru tsa sha na a ya ma byang phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar lho'i rtsibs steng rgyal po'i dregs pa ni: bswe khrab rmog zhu zangs ral tsit+ta thogs: seṅge bzhon nas shar lho'i dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: shar lho'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ru tsa sha na a ya ma du shar lho'i dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: lho nub rtsibs steng btsan gyi dregs pa ni: zangs khrab rmog zhu mda' gzhu ru mtshon thogs: mtshal stag bzhon nas lho nub dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: lho nub g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: tsa sha na a ya ma du ru lho nub kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub byang rtsibs staing gnon sbyin dregs pa ni:

gser khrab rmog zhu kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo thogs: dom nag bzhon nas nub byang dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: nub byang g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sha na a ya ma du ru tsa nub byang gi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: byang shar rtsibs steng klu yi dregs pa ni: g.yu khrab rmog zhu sbrul zhags lcags par thogs: chu srin bzhon nas byang shar dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: byang shar g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: na a ya ma du ru tsa sha byang shar gyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: steng phyogs rtsibs steng gza' bdud dregs pa ni: sku mdog dud kha gnam lcags thog mda' 'gyed: glog dmar rta bzhon steng phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: steng phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: rā hu la na sha tsa ru du ma ya a steng phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: 'og phyogs rtsibs steng dmu rje'i dregs pa ni: 'ob zhu stag thul shang lang sog le thogs: dred mong bzhon nas 'og phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: 'og phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+rūm̐ mi ra tsa na sha tsa ru du ma ya a 'og phyogs kyi dgra bgegs dmag dpung thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khor yug rtsibs steng yul lha'i dregs pa ni: ma nges go khrab rmog zhu mtshon cha thogs: rigs mthun rta bzhon phyogs phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: phyogs phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hri ṭi ta hri ke du e dza bh+yo rā hu la ki king shag bh+yoḥ na sha tsa ru du ma ya a phyogs phyogs kyi dmag dpung steng du bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces gtor mdos nang du gtor chung re 'bul: mchod pa dmar chen gtor zhing : hūm̐: srid gsum g.yul bzlog drag sngags 'dus pa'i lha: dpal chen khro rgyal dregs pa 'khor bcas la: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: phyi nang mchod sprin dur khrod bkod pa'i khyon: sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho bcas: dbang po'i zhal zas khor yug khengs pa'i tshogs: pha rol g.yul ngo'i khams la dmigs nas su: dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs la 'bul lags na: bstan pa'i ru tra gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ne wi d+ye shab+da dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: stobs ldan nag po mngon spyod dmod pa'i chas: drag sngags thal 'byin rdo rje pha lam skus: sde brgyad g.yul 'gyed phas kyi rgol ba 'joms: bstan dgra bgegs dpung tshar gcod kī la ya: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo dbal gsham can: sku las spros pa'i khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: sha khrag srog la dbang ba'i dregs pas bskor: sde brgyad dmag dpon gza' mchog rā hu la: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad bcas: rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod cing bstod nas su: bskul zhing rbad pa'i phrin las bcol ba'i tshe: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' dam tshig can: bdag gis bla med byang chub sgrub pa la: bdud dang 'gong pos byed du ma ster nas: phyogs kyi dgra sdang nang gi yul gru bcom: dkon mchog gnyan la nyer 'tshe'i dgra dar bas: lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho dpung la bzhengs:

pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: de yi thugs dam gnyan po dus 'dir bskul: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas mngon spyod 'grub par shog: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar la/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i phyir: deng 'dir thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa la: drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'grub par mdzod: ༈ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig nag po sngags phreng me'i tshwa tshwa dang bcas g.yas su 'khor ba las rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin snang srid khyab/ srid pa gsum gyi lha 'dre sogs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ de dag gi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad tshur bsdus nas thugs srog la thim pas/ gzi brjid cher rgyas pa'i 'od zer las mchod sprin gyi lha mo grangs med pa spros te/ rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams la mnyes mchod phul de thams cad kyi thugs dam dgyes pa bskyed nas/ 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo'i sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi tshul du bdag la thim pas srid gsum kun tu che btsan 'gran zla med par gyur ba'i che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed bzhin rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang thugs srog gi sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ rang gi zhal nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing slar lte ba nas thon rang gi lte ba nas zhugs te thugs srog la thim/ thugs kyi 'od zer 'khor rnams la phog pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal nas drag sngags 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra dang 'od zer mthing nag dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing 'od zer mkha' khyab tu brdal ba'i rgyal ba rnams mnyes par byas/ dam can rnams las la bskul/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dpa' bskyed/ 'jig rten dregs pa rnams dbang du bsdus/ khams sum gyi log rtog zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha'i go 'phang la bkod/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs par gyur/ om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hriḥshag ru raṃ nā ga bh+rūm̐ mi hri ṭi ta hriḥke du a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rgyun sngags so: thun sngags bsad sngags zlog sngags thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba ni: om̐ he ma ṭa ma ṭa da ha da ha tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha byad ma ṇi tri ma ra ma ra pa tsa pa tsa ha na ha na hu lu hu lu: dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri sha truṃ: trig thum spur thum hur thum tsit+ta 'gas 'gas ya ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog nan nan rbad rbad: bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ /bcu pa o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la brten nas hor sog dmag gi g.yul bzlog dregs pa dmag 'gyed kyi le tshan no/ /'di rnams smad las gang 'dul der ston dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs las dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ dbang sdud zil gnon sogs phrin las bar pa'i le tshan lnga rdzogs so// // gsum pa phrin las bye brag ni/ dus ngan snyigs mar sbas yul dben rir snyegs pa/

las can zab gter 'don pa/ sbas yul gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs la mkho ba'i cha lag le tshan bcu gcig dang bcu gsum bar gyi gzhung tshang bar 'byung ba las/ ༈ bcu gcig pa/ o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor bcas la brten nas sbas gnas sgo 'byed kyi bar chad lam sel ye shes drwa ba ltar sgrub pa la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed na: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ skabs 'dir gser skyems dang srung mar bka' dam bsgrag pa rnams dmigs bsal las la sbyor ba'i skabs las 'dir dbang bskur gyi skabs su mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: thod pa skam rlon lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang : dbang po rnam lnga dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs: ri ltar spungs shing 'khor yug kun la khyab: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis spel: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ lha bskyed cing spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: rang nyid skad cig pad zla'i gdan steng du: hūm̐ las rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer sku: dmar ser bram gzugs he ru ka yi chas: khro 'dzum nyams ldan phyed skyil rol stabs can: rus rgyan stag sham phyag g.yas nyi zer bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs la 'khril ba'i yum: bde chen dpa' mo 'od zer can ma ni: dmar mo khro gnyer rnam rol zim bu'i mdangs: skra grol thor tshugs lhag mas sku rgyab khebs: rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan na ra ra: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas me long 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan dang rin chen phreng bas spras: zung 'jug zhabs gnyis bde chen yab la 'khyud: yab yum sku la ye shes gzi 'bar bsgom: phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhi: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: phyag g.yas thams cad mda' dar me long thogs: g.yon pas rang rang sgo chas lde mig bsnams: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem lang tsho bcu drug ldan: bde ba'i nyams ldan gar stabs ling nger bzhugs: phyi rol mu mtha' mdun gyi sa gzhi ru: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag ma lus kyis: gus 'dud phyag dang mchod 'bul bskor bar bskyed: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas kyi 'khor yug tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon tshul: de la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: gsal snang ma 'dres dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon yig 'bru yis: rje btsun yid bzhin nor bu spyan drangs gyur:
