byin gyis rlobs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rje'i dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : sbas yul dben rir bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gis byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi bstsal nas su: 'bral ba med par rtag tu skyong gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya āḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gyur pad 'byung chos kyi rje: 'gro mgon bla ma dpa' bo ging dang bcas: mi 'bral dbyings kyi spyi bo'i mkha' ru bzhugs: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod: dam pa nyid ltar thugs rjes bdag gyur nas: lam 'phrang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: gsang mchod bla med sbyor sgrol tshogs kyis mchod: spyan gzigs dkor cha gling bzhi ri rab bcas: maṇ+ḍal mchod pa gcig tu bsdus nas kyang : rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mtshungs med 'gro mgon o rgyan rje la 'bul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang srung mar 'bul: dgyes par dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes su gsol: lam 'phrang gegs med bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di skabs gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byin brlabs las:

snang mtha'i sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon: rgya gar sku 'khrungs 'gro don mdzad: bod yul lha srin dam la btags: bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub: rgyal po'i dgongs pa mtha' ru phyin: lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rje'i nyi ma bod la shar: yar ngo tshes bcur mngon sum mjal: skal ldan bu la lung bstan mdzad: 'gro don dgongs pa rgyun chad med: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang gsum bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de nas 'dzam gling gangs can du: chos kyi bstan pa btsugs mdzad tshe: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: bdud 'dul sngags pa'i cha lugs can: shān+tiṃ ghar+bha mngon spyod tshul: rdo rje phyar zhing phur bu bsgril: gnam lcags sdig pa'i sprul pa 'gyed: bdud dang mu stegs dam la btags: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas su: mu stegs thams cad dam la btags: mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i:

bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rgya gar bal bod sa mtshams su: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: rgya bod gnyis kyi lha 'dre 'thab: sde brgyad cho 'phrul byung ba'i tshe: phur pa rnam gsum gdeng tshad thob: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og a su ra yi brag: gnod sbyin spun gsum dam la btags: drag sngags shān+tiṃ ghar+bha dngos: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og spa gro stag tshang du: dregs sde sum cu dam la btags: stag zhon sbrul gyi gdengs ka can: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og bal bod mtshams kyi gnas: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags:

mu stegs sgrol ba'i dam bca' bzhag: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og gung thang la thog tu: sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags: dge slong bzhi la dngos grub gnang : drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og kha la rong gi gong : ma yams thams cad dam la btags: rdo rje'i phyag rtags rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og gtsang rong nag po ru: the'u rang thams cad dam la btags: 'gong po spun dgu tshar yang bcad: bran du khas blangs tha tshig phul: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og shang gi g.yag sde ru: rdo rje legs pa dam la btags: phyag mtshan rdo rje phyag tu phul: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og dpal mo dpal thang du: thang lha yar bzhud dam la btags: klu yis 'tsho ba sna tshogs phul: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og 'dam shod snye mo ru: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: gnam lcags rdo rje thog ltar phab: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og mang ri dpal 'bar ru: yar lha sham po dam la btags: lha rabs skyong ba'i g.yar dam phog: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs:

mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og gnam mtsho'i sgrub gnas su: mal gro gzi chen dam la btags: dge bsnyen kun gyi srog snying phul: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: 'phan yul sprel gyi lha khang ru: srin po he pa dam la btags: rak+sha mi 'gyu dam bca' phul: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og sgrags kyi yang rdzong du: mgul lha bcu gsum dam la btags: bod khams bstan pa skyong bar bskos: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: bsam yas has po'i ri rtse ru:

dgongs pa me 'bar mtsho la gtad: gtsug na rin chen dam la btags: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og mchims phu'i brag dmar du: sde brgyad yongs rdzogs dam la btags: bsam yas chos 'khor lhun gyis grub: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og khams kyi g.yar mo thang : a mye bya thul dam la btags: rgya dang khams kyi sa mtshams gnyer: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og rong chen gnas bzhi ru: dge bsnyen bco brgyad dam la btags: sbas yul thams cad skyong bar gnyer: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod dam la btags: sbas gnas sgo 'byed gter kha bzhag: drin chen bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rje btsun 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung : dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal sogs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: 'bral ba med par rjes bzung nas: rtag tu chos la spyod pa dang : rigs ldan gtsang ma'i lus thob nas: zag med bde bas 'tsho bar shog: rtag tu ngan 'gro'i las spangs shing : skye dgur chos char 'bebs pa yis: gzhan don mtha' ru phyin gyur cig:

dzap khang dbye ba spyi chings ltar/ ༈ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag mdun gyi lha'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng nyi zer ltar 'phros pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin gyis rgyal ba rnams mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ dbang byin dngos grub 'od zer gyi rnam par rang la bsdus pas nus stobs bskyed/ mkha' 'gro dam can rnams la phog pas sngon gyi tha tshig dran zhing thugs dam dang dam tshig gi gnad la bskul/ ci bgyis pa'i bka' nyan zhing phrin las sgrub/ 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams la phog pas tshar bcad/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer phog pas/ gnod sems sdug bsngal dang bral te bde ba'i longs spyod dang ldan par byas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ thams cad dus gcig tu dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi skur gyur cing*/ de rnams thams cad dzap dbyangs sgrogs par gyur/ slar yang lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang grangs med par 'phros pas/ phrin las rab 'byams kyi las thams cad thog med du 'grub par mos/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ /bcu gcig pa o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor bcas la brten nas sbas gnas sgo 'byed kyi le tshan no// // ༈ bcu gnyis pa/ o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pa brten nas/ rin chen gter sgo 'byed pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed ltar sgrub pa la/

skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ hoḥ na mo bla ma rigs 'dus rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga mtshan brgyad o rgyan rin po che: dbang drag khro bo badz+ra lo ha he: grub thob rgyal po stag zhon sprul pa'i sku: ḍāk+ki'i gtso mo dpa' mo he ru kar: bdag dang dbyer med gus pas skyabs su mchi: o rgyan yi dam mkha' 'gro sgrub nas ni: gang la gang 'dul tshad med phrin las kyi: 'gro drug 'khrul snang sgrol bar dam bca'o: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod sprin dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon: yongs su 'gengs pa rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: zab lam bde chen bsgrub pa'i ngo bor gsal: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ā hūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hrīḥm: hūm̐ bh+yo: sa bon phyag mtshan gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su:

pho brang rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur e yi dbus: pad nyi gdan la stag mo grus ma'i steng : dmar nag dbang sdud rdo rje gro bo lod: he ru ka dpal rnam 'gyur 'gying stabs can: rgyan drug gtum nyams dpa' bo dpa' ba'i chas: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu gdeng : sdigs mdzub rtse la sdig pa'i sprul pa 'gyed: spyi bor rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbyings phyug gsang ye dang bcas gsal bar bsgom: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir pad 'dab rim pa bzhin: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: rang mdog khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: phyag g.yas so so'i phyag mtshan mda' dar bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar gyi nyams ldan bsgom: de yi phyi rol bka' gter srung ma yi: gter gyi rgya bkrol sgo dbye gus par bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: rnga yab zhing dang dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas pa: spyan drangs dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i pho brang nas: che btsan khro bo gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: chags bral pad nyi'i khri 'phang gdan la bzhugs: sgrub mchog gter la spyod phyir brtan par satwaṃ: mnga' bdag dregs pa'i rje la gus pa yis: gdung bas phyag bgyi mos pas rab tu bstod: lha mchog lha la mchod pa'i bye brag ni: phyi mchod lha mo bcu drug mnyes pa'i sprin: nang mchod sman raka bdud rtsi sbyor ba'i rdzas: gsang mchod dbyangs snyan sbyor ba'i dza na mo: bsgral mchod bha ling+ta dang dbang po lnga: snang srid 'di ru ji srid bsdus pa'i tshogs:

rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol: sku gsung thugs kyi brda sgo klong du phyes: 'byung lnga'i drwa ba'i rgya chings dgrol du gsol: 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ om̐ a be sha ya a āḥ om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la khā hi: om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : ma skyes gsal rdzogs dran rig ngo bo hūm̐: rang bzhin ngang gis khros pa khro bo'i rgyal: bla ma drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra lo ka dmar nag he ru kaḥ dregs sde 'dul byed dpa' bo stag zhon ni: gtum pa'i shugs las khros pa'i am gtsigs bsdams: dus mtha'i me ltar dbu skra kham nag bsigs: thod skam 'bar ba'i rgyan ldan dar dpyangs 'phur: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing sma ra smin ma gzengs: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu las: hūm̐ dgu phaṭ dgu ram̐ dgu'i tshwa tshwa 'phros: phyag g.yon las phur za byed sdig pa la: bh+yo dgu rbad dgu ram̐ dgu'i zi ra 'khyugs: rus rgyan stag sham thod rlon phreng ba 'dren: rin chen wang long phyag zhabs gdub bu 'khrol: stag mo grus ma'i steng na dor thabs bzhugs: sku las gzi byin me dpung lnga ldan 'khrigs: khro rgyal rdo rje srin por phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥmūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug bde ba'i gar: pad+ma thod phreng dbang gi bdag nyid che: rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams shing phyed skyil bzhugs: sgeg pa'i nyams ldan rnal 'byor cha shas rdzogs: dbyings phyug mthing nag zag med bde bas 'khyud:

gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings dpal lha mo: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros thugs kyi bar chad sel: dga' bzhi'i 'khor lo ye shes mdangs kyis g.yo: rol pa'i dga' ston 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ bzhin bzang lha mo zhi ba'i phrin las sku: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ngo bo nyid: rdo rje mkha' 'gros sku yi bar chad sel: dkar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo shar phyogs bdag: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sgeg mo lha mo rgyas pa'i phrin las sku: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ngo bo nyid: rin chen mkha' 'gros yon tan bar chad sel: ser mo 'bum gyi gtso mo lho phyogs bdag: snying rje'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ chags pa'i lha mo dbang gi phrin las sku: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtogs ngo bo nyid: pad+ma mkha' 'gros gsung gi bar chad sel: dmar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo nub phyogs bdag: dga' ba'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgyes pa'i lha mo drag mo phrin las sku: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ngo bo nyid: karma mkha' 'gros phrin las bar chad sel: ljang mo 'bum gyi gtso mo byang phyogs bdag: btang snyoms 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar dang*/ dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ pad+ma thod phreng mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: dbyings phyug bzang mo lha lcam man+da ra: dmar nag gtum po rdo rje gro bo lod: stag mo grus ma bhi na sa yi sprul: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : ka la sid+dhi shākya de ma dang : bkra shis khye'u 'dren bcas pa rtsa gsum lha: dngos grub zad med gter la spyod pa yi: pad 'byung yi dam khyed nyid dgongs su gsol: o rgyan chen po tshe rabs bla ma nyid: dpa' bo me phreng sgrub pa'i yi dam lha: rdo rje phag mo tshe rabs gtan gyi yum: mkha' 'gro sde lnga bstan srid rig ma mchog: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bdag la byin gyis rlobs:

༈ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag nyid khro bo 'chol ba'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ dmar nag gi mthar/ sngags phreng gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa dpag tu med par 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i lam 'dre rgyal 'gong rnams gzhob thul du bsreg /de dag gi tshe bsod bkrag mdangs rnams tshur bsdus te thugs srog la thim pas nus stobs 'gran med du gyur/ phyogs dus rgyal ba rnams mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ mkha' 'gro dam can rnams las la bskul/ 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams tshar bcad/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer phog pas gnod sems sdug bsngal dang bral te/ bde ba'i longs spyod dang ldan par byas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje srin po'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par lam gyis song bar dmigs bzhin/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma rā dza pā shaṃ sa mā ya dza mūm̐ bud+dha ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ ke kā+au ri pad+ma mu ṭa rā ga he sha ḍāk+ki nī pā shaṃ sarba thun thun dza dza swā hā: bum sgrub/ mchod bstod rig me dor ba sogs gong dang mtshungs so/ /bcu gnyis pa o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pa la brten nas rin chen gter sgo 'byed pa'i le tshan no// // ༈ bcu gsum pa o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar brten nas sbas yul sgo 'byed dpa' bo ging sgrub rin chen lde mig ltar sgrub pa la/

skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur: skyabs sems ni/ na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga mtshan brgyad sku la skyabs su mchi: dpa' bo ging gi lha tshogs sgrub nas ni/ /'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o/ /bdag ni dben ri sbas yul bgrod pa la: mgon mchog pad 'byung lam sna drang du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen pos dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid las: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ dngos gzhi bskyed pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen gzhal yas khang : gru chad sgo rdzogs phyi nang bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba'i khrir:

pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: rgyal po'i cha lugs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje mkhar gdeng thabs shes bhan+dha bsnam: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten mdzad 'gying bag can: g.yas g.yon bde chen dbang phyug yum chen gnyis: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang bcas: snang la ma 'dres 'ja' tshon dkyil 'khor ltar: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon yig 'bru yis: rje btsun yid bzhin nor bu spyan drangs gyur: byin gyis rlobs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rje'i dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : sbas yul dben rir bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gis byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi bstsal nas su: 'bral ba med par rtag tu skyong gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya āḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gyur pad 'byung chos kyi rje: 'gro mgon bla ma dpa' bo ging dang bcas: mi 'bral dbyings kyi spyi bo'i mkha' ru bzhugs: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod: dam pa nyid ltar thugs rjes bdag gyur nas: lam 'phrang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ

mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: gsang mchod bla med sbyor sgrol tshogs kyis mchod: spyan gzigs dkor cha gling bzhi ri rab bcas: maṇ+ḍal mchod pa gcig tu bsdus nas kyang : rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mtshungs med 'gro mgon o rgyan rje la 'bul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang srung mar 'bul: dgyes par dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes su gsol: lam 'phrang gegs med bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ nam mkha'i gos can dbyings phyug man+da ra: bde chen gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal yum: zab lam bde stong ma cig rnal 'byor ma: ḍāk+ki'i gtso mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ gar gyi nyams dgu ldan pa'i dpa' bo dang : rngam gshe dpa' bar 'gro ba ging gi tshogs: gnas yul mkha' la 'gro ba'i ma mo ste: dpa' bo ging dang ḍāk+ki rgya mtshor bstod: hūm̐: snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu gsol ba yis: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byin rlabs thugs rje sdud: sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub par byed: gnam lcags thog gi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: rdo rje sgro phod dar snas brgyan pa yis: grub thob rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs par byed: nga rgyal seṅge'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: me long lnga dang nyi zlas brgyan pa yis: dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dbang du sdud par byed:

gti mug glang po'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sgo bzhi'i khyung du 'dab ldan rgyas pa yis: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar gsal: zhe sdang stag gi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sku la phod kha lhab lhub gsol ba yis: khro bo khro mo zil gyis gnon par byed: phrag dog mi rgod 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sku rags ljang dmar sngags chas spras pa yis: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i grogs lam bsten par byed: nyon mongs chu srin 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: chos gos gser gyi 'ja' ris gsol ba yis: drang srong grub thob rig sngags dmod par byed: dmag 'khrug rgyal po'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: za ber smug nag bklubs shing gsol ba yis: snang srid lha srin zil gyis gnon par byed: zhe sdang sbrul gyi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga phyar ba yis: lam gyi 'byung po ma rungs 'dul bar byed: cho 'phrul me yi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: phyag g.yon bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams pa yis: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i phrin las sgrub par byed: lam 'phrang tshe yi bar chod bskyab tu gsol: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan du bcug pa yis: 'dre rgod 'byung po rdul du brlag par byed: gcan 'phrang gru gzings 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol ba yis: sgab 'dre dam sri rdul du brlag par byed: lam log lam gol 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gis bskor ba yis: sbas yul sgo 'byed bstan pa skyong bar byed: bar gcod mi mthun phyogs kun bskyab tu gsol: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru thod phreng rtsal: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bskyab tu gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dzap khang dbye ba gong ltar/ dzap kyi thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon mongs zhi mdzad 'khrul snang rang sar grol:

dus gsum mkhyen pa ye shes gu ru rje: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: bdag gi gus pas gdung zhing bstod lags na: ma gyur sems can rigs drug sdug bsngal bcas: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thar med bying ba rnams: thugs rje'i 'od kyi lcags kyus rjes bzung nas: rnga yab dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: ༈ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p zhes gsol 'debs kyang bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar gsal mar me ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ de'i mthar sngags phreng skar ma'i phreng ba ltar rang sgra dang bcas bkra lam mer 'khor bar gyur/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de las sngags kyi 'od zer khra lam gyis byung ba rang gi zhal nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ slar sngags kyi 'od zer mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: yang sngags kyi 'od zer rigs drug gi gnas su 'phros pas so so'i las nyon sbyangs nas thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i skur gyur cing*/ sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med cing brjod kyis mi lang ba steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la phog cing rgyal ba rnams la mnyes par mchod/ dbang byin dngos grub thob/

mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sbyangs/ dam tshig gi gnad la bskul/ ci bgyis pa'i bka' nyan zhing phrin las bsgrubs/ 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams la phog pas tshar bcad/ byang chub sems kyi 'od zer phog pas gnod sems sdug bsngal dang bral te bde ba'i longs spyod dang ldan par byas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ thams cad dus gcig tu dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi skur gyur cing*/ de rnams thams cad kyis dzap dbyangs sgrogs par gyur/ slar yang lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang grangs med par 'phros pas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par mos/ las sbyor dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sngags ni/ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: ging pho mo'i sngags ni/ om̐ dha sha gṝ wa ging ka ra sarba tshin+dha tshin+dha ya hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭḥ de nas rnam bum bsgrub pa ni/ gzung thag la 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ nas phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ /zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas bum sgrub ched rtsa sngags sum brgya las mi nyung bar bzla/ las bum sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying sogs dang thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar

bsam mo/ ༈ rig me dor ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ /gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bcu gsum pa dpa' bo ging dang srung mar brten nas sbas yul sgo 'byed kyi le tshan no/ /las bum ni dbang sgrub dang po gang yin par byas pas rung*/ nyin gyi bar ma chad na gzhan kun la mi dgos/ de bzhin thog mar dkar bgegs dang bskang gsol tshogs mchod sogs kyang gcig gis 'thus la/ yang o rgyan sman lha lta bu dag /gcig kho na bskur na thams cad 'gro dgos pa yin/ yang nyin gcig dbang sna gsum bzhi byed dgos tshe nyin re bzhin thog mar dkar bgegs dang*/ thams cad sgrub tshar ba'i rjes gsol ka tshogs skong sogs bya chog pa yin pas de don skabs phyed par gal che'o/ /gang ltar yang mchod bstod 'od zhu bzod gsol grub nas dbang bzhi len pa'am/ min kyang ting 'dzin gyi dbang blang*/ rig me dor zhing gnang ba zhu ba bcas grub/ dkyil 'khor yol bas sgribs/ chos skyong sde lnga'i bskang gsol dang rang lugs gsol ka rnams grub nas/ na raka bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags la/ sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar ba sngon du song nas tshogs kyi mgor/

rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi gtor bsngo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas tshogs byin rlabs skong bshags kyi bar btang*/ phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa sogs 'phro skyong zhing*/ tshogs drang ba'i mgor dus gsum sangs rgyas bsam lhun bar chad lam sel gsol 'debs bcas grol lo/ /yang bod yul rang lugs 'gas dngos grub len pa'i bar btang*/ dbang bzhi blangs nas rjes su 'jug pa'ang snang mod/ snga ma bzhin mdzad na 'thad che/ gang ltar tshogs sogs smad las spyi chings zur gsal ltar shes par mdzad 'tshal/ de dag gis gnyis pa ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa rdzogs so/ /skabs 'dir bcu bzhi pa chos skyong srog gtad bya tshul ni gzhan du shes so// // (༈) ༄༅/ gsum pa sgrub pa zin nas dbang bskur ba dngos bshad pa la/ de'ang bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i snying po don 'dus thugs sgrub rnam gsum las/ rtsa ba bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos rje 'bangs grogs rnams la gdams pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ spyi don gsum las/ nang gses bcu bzhir dbye ba ni/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams lnga dang*/ smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams lnga/ phrin las bye brag gi zhal gdams bzhi bcas bcu bzhi'o/ /de la dang po/ snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po bde gshegs rigs lnga'i bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyes rabs gsol 'debs sogs song nas/ gzhung gi gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung ste bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar/ rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/

gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar/ sngon du 'gro bar bya dgos pa zhib par sgrub pa'i skabs bshad zin pa bzhin 'og ma rnams su yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir sgrub thabs bcu gsum gang yin rung so sor bskur dgos tshe sngon rjes kyi spyi chings ni/ thog mar khrus nas dbyung ba sogs sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ slob ma rnams sgo drung du bos la las bum gyi chus/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chu: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: bkru bar bgyi'o byang zhing dag gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyang ni/ h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig

/gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom mo/ /de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas sgra dag la gsal ba'i sgo nas/ de'ang grub pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhal snga nas/ dag pa khrus nas ma dbyung bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi sgo mi dbye/ /byur dang mi shes ma bsal bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi gral mi dgod/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ma bsgoms par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chos mi bshad/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ phyi 'jug gi yan lag tu/ khrus nas dbyung ba dang*/ bgegs bskrad srung gur sgom pa rnams so/ /da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ de'ang thun mong theg pa'i lam la zhugs na bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa'i rtsol sgrub kyi yun 'gor bas/ de'i bar du ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal dos drag pos mnar bar 'dug pas/ da res tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bras bu rdo rje theg par zhugs par bya'o/ /de'ang smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sngon du ma song na mi rungs ste/ rgyud gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na/ /nyan la sogs par brtson pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/

zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ lam rim gnyis la slob par bya snyam pas thog mar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug mi 'dzin pa lnga dang bcas pa spangs nas legs par gsan dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa thugs nges dang*/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/ chos nyams su len pa ni/ sman bsten na nad nye bar sel ba'i 'du shes te yang dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos su mos gus dad pa dang ldan pas sgo gsum legs par bsdams te gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar rang re rnams kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon pa'i dpe brgya stong gis char yang mi phod pa/ shin tu rnyed par dka' la rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus rten bzang po zhig rnyed zin kyang*/ de kho nas mi chog ste phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos shig bsgrub dgos/ de'ang 'phral du ma sgrub tshe lar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'tsho rkyen ni dkon zhing*/ 'chi rkyen ni mang bas/ nam 'chi cha med dang 'chi rkyen nges med yin pa ma tshad tha na de ring dang sang nyin tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe/ gnyen nye 'brel/ grogs dga' mdza'/ thob go sa/ nor longs spyod sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang bar/

las dkar nag 'ba' zhig rjes su 'brang bas bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi bslu bar myong dgos/ de'i tshe da lta dge ba ma sgrub par khyer rgyu ni med/ sdig pa mi 'dod kyang 'dor du ni mi btub/ de bas da lta nyid nas blang dor phyin ci ma log pa zhig sgrub pa gal che/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ des na pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs rnam grol gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos/ de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang mthun pa'i/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa dman pa dang theg pa chen po gnyis su 'du la/ de'ang nyan rang theg pas dngos su lam dang 'bras bu thar pa'i cha shas tsam las rnam grol gyi lam rdzogs par ma bstan cing*/ rang 'bras mthar phyin thob nas kyang*/ gzod theg chen la 'jug dgos pas lam dman la/ theg chen ni theg dman las khyad par chen po bdun gyis 'phags tshul/ mgon po byams pas/ dmigs pa chen po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub gnyis dag pa dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ /yang dag grub pa chen po dang*/ /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po dang*/ /chen po 'di dag dang ldan phyir/ /'di ni theg chen zhes byar brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ dmigs pa chen pos chos nyid nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la dmigs pa/ sgrub pa chen pos rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don sgrub pa/ ye shes chen pos bdag 'dzin gnyis ka stong pa'i chos nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes/ brtson 'grus chen pos bskal pa grangs med par sems can gyi don la brtson pa/ thabs mkhas chen pos srid zhi'i mtha' gang la mi gnas pa/

grub pa chen pos stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan tshad med pa/ phrin las chen po 'khor ba ji srid bar gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung ba bcas thabs bdun gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen ni lam gyi mchog yin no/ /de la'ang gnyis te/ gal po las/ mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas rgyu ru shes/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas nyid du shes/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gang yin pa/ /phyogs kyis rab tu shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu lam du byed pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis kas/ spyir bsgrub bya byang chub thob par 'dod pa don gcig kyang*/ sgrub byed thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par che ste/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi/ /dbang po rnon po'i rkyen byas te/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes 'jug sgo dbang sogs thabs la ma rmongs pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'bad med du sgrub par byed pa'i thabs mang po/ dka' ba mang po spyad mi dgos par 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs sla ba/ dbang po rnon pos dbang du byas te gsungs pa'i snga ma las khyad 'phags kyi chos du ma dang ldan pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgya gar 'phags yul du de lta'i dbye ba med mod/ gangs can yul 'dir lo tsā bas 'gyur snga phyi la brten nas sngags gsar rnying gnyis su btags pa las/ 'di ni phyi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa gsar ma las spyan 'dren pa po yon bdag /phyag bzhes gtsug lag khang*/ zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta/ sgyur byed lo tsā ba/ zhu rten me tog /bsgyur bya'i chos kyi khyad par te/ khyad chos drug ldan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi chos sde dang gsum yod pa las/

da lam 'dir bka' ma las bka' bab lung bstan/ smon lam dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ste/ khyad par gyi brgyud pa gsum dang*/ gtso bo brgyud thag nye zhing*/ gter yig gi dpe dpang mnga' bas khungs btsun pa/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dus dang mtshon pa mngon par snang ba'i zab lam nub pa med pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin la/ de'i zab khyad kyang*/ o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi bka'i thang yig tu/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams: spyir ni bod khams gsar dad che ba dang : snyigs ma'i 'gro la phal cher snying brtse bas: dbus mtha' thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab: ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan: sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang ris dregs can: rang che 'byin zhing gter la rtsod na yang : snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cher gter gyis 'dren: zab la kha tshang ma 'grib mtha' rgyas shing : gdams pa sna res gang zag grol bar nges: de bas las sad skal ldan sbyangs pa can: 'chi ba dran rnams gter chos nyams su longs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob bo rje 'bangs grogs: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag ni dus bab zab gter la rag las pa yin/ de lta bu'i zab gter rnams gu ru yab yum gyis phyi ma'i bstan 'gro'i btsas su dgongs nas gangs can gyi ri brag mtsho gsum dang*/ nam mkha' bar snang thams cad du ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i rgya yis btab ste/ ye shes dang las las grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung rnams la gnyer kha gtad de/ dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la sprod ces smon lam dang bcas sbas par mdzad la/ de nyid spyan 'dren po'ang sngon gyi chos rgyal lo paṇa sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i 'phags chen rnams gang 'dul sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa sogs byon par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gu ru'i thugs sras snying gi bu dgu zhes 'phags yul gyi grub chen rig 'dzin brgyad dang tha mi dad pa sgrub sde brgyad kyi bka' bab bu dgu'i nang tshan/

'jam dpal sku'i bka' bab dang*/ khyad par du mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa'i shing rta chen po/ gangs ljongs sngags 'chang phur thogs yongs kyi rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal zhing*/ grub gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa/ grub pa'i rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur zhing nyi zla gdan du bting ba dang*/ brag la phur pa 'debs pa/ sdigs mdzub gtad pa tsam gyis sra mkhregs brag gi ri bo'ang rdul phran du bshig nus pa sogs/ mdor na bdud rje glang dar ma'ang rje 'di'i nus mthus zil gyis mnan pas mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa gos dkar lcang lo'i sde dang bcas par glags blta bar ma nus pas mtshon bstan pa 'dzin srung spel ba'i bka' drin che zhing*/ sku tshe'ang mnga' bdag khri srong nas rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi bar mi lo sum brgya ma zin tsam bzhugs pas mtshon/ nus pa'i mthu/ rnam bzhi'i las/ 'chi med tshe sogs thun mong gi grub pa dang*/ thun min sku tshe de ny-id la theg mchog snying po'i lam mthar son cing*/ mthar sku mi snang bar 'od lus su gshegs pa de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar sprul pa'i gter chen gtsug lag dpal dge /dum rgya zhang khrom/ dri med kun dga' sogs gter ston rkyang pa bdun dang gzhan du ma byon par gsal la/ snga ma gter lung rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ gnubs chen khyod 'di nas skye ba bcu bdun pa'i mtshams su ming gnam lcags las grub pa ma nges pa rlung ltar rgyu ba zhig 'byung ngo zhes dang*/ lung byang chen mo las/ da lta'i dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: skye ba 'phrul med mdo khams phyogs su 'byung : rgyal khams rngam sgra nag po yul gyi ming : bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong : rtsi shing mdung rtse gzengs pa lta bu'i tshal: yab yum gshed gzhi zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: shes rab blo ldan zab gsang las sad pa'i:

lus la brda rtags sha mtshan ri mo ni: drag po'i rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan: rgyud smin dbang rtags so zho tshe bum ldan: stong nyid don ldan snying khar sme bas brgyan: tshigs rnams pad+ma brda ni shes rab ldan: gsang bar hūm̐ mthing karma las 'brel gling : mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang : ma nges brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod: phyogs med 'gro don rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: ti sgro g.ya' lung brag gsum nas bzung ste: rong chen lnga yi zab gter rtags bdun dbang : bka' gsang shog dril bdun cu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhi blang zhing phab nas yang gter sbos: zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i bka' gsang zab mo gter gyi ring lugs la dbye na dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu/ shar gter 'dril ba sdong po lta bu/ lho gter gyes pa yal ga lta bu/ nub gter gsal ba me tog lta bu/ byang gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bur gsungs pa las/ da lam 'di ni zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i dbus gter gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin/ de la'ang phyi gter nang gter gsang gter yang gter ma ning gi gter kha la sogs pa gter rigs bco brgyad du grags pa las 'di ni gsang gter gyi khongs su gtogs pa ma zad au rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod khams phan bdai'i rtsa lag dam par rdo rje lung gis bsngags pa rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'am/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho/ pad+ma gter bdag gling pa sogs mtshan dgu dang ldan pa de nyid/ mdo khams spa rong zhes par rlangs dpal gy-i seṅge'i gdung la rab byung bcu gnyis shing pho khyi'i lor sku 'khrungs shing*/ dgung lo lngar son pa'i tshe gu ru yab yum gyis rjes su bzung zhing dbang bskur lung bstan pa sogs dag snang mang du gzigs/ khyad par ti sgror gu ru yab yum gyi zhal gzigs/ dag pa'i snang bar zangs mdog dpal rir phebs nas gu ru yab yum dga' rab rdo rje kun bzang yab yum rnams las dbang bzhi dang*/

khyad par rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob ste chos nyid kyi dgongs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ snang ba thams cad sgyu mar shar bas snang srid 'dod rgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes/ chos skyong rnams bran du khol zhing*/ khyad par du mi min ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'dod khams dbang phyug dang*/ dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma rnams kyis gsang ba'i las rgya mdzad cing zab gter gyi brda grogs mdzad/ rim par kha byang gi dngos grub thob nas shing pho rta nas bzung khrom gter dang gsang gter sogs ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu nas zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ khyad par du gyur pa 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus ni/ lha sras rje 'bangs la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs: bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jig me btsa' bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyi bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje la zhus pa'i bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas:

bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rigs gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: de yang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas: kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gong thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa'i: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs su bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams bstsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams dang bcas mang du bstsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' bstsal/ 'on kyang da lta spel ba'i dus min par bstan pa'ang de nyid las/ da lta spel ba'i dus min yig ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul gdul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul gung thang la kha bya ba ru: bal bod mtshams der sleb dus khyod la gtad:

gdams pa shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor zungs: da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ri'i gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan thig le gnyer du bskos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyis su gu rus gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang snying gi bu lnga la skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/ ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' bstsal ba bzhin/ gter kha khag tu bkram nas sbas pa'i dus rtags lung bstan dang mthun par sprul pa'i gter chen rnams kyis rim bzhin 'byin par gsungs pa'ang*/ 'di nyid 'byin pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni/ sum cu kha dar nyi shu'i dus dang mtshungs: khyad par 'di nas gdung rab mi ring bar: rnam smin bskyed rgyal phyogs dang phyogs nas 'byung : lo skor dus dang zla zhag so so ru: gdams pa 'di nyid nye bar mkho ba 'byung : de dus lha sras skye ba rim brgyud dang : da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lngas rim par 'byin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa sogs sprul pa'i gter chen du mar bka' babs 'ga' zhig gnas dus rten 'brel skal bas phongs nas phyis su yang gter dang dgongs gter sogs su 'phos pa yang byung ngo*/ /de dag las khyad par du gyur pa 'di nyid ni zhal gdams las/ dam chos don chen yang snying 'dus pa yi: bka' yi them byang 'gag tu 'dril ba 'di: 'byin pa'i sa rtags dbus yul bdud kyis 'dzin: sa steng g.yo ba'i mtha' dmag dbus su 'khrigs: bsam yas rta mgrin mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs: jo shāka mdun du khrag gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: gtsug lag sgrub gnas bshig nas sil bur 'thor: byang sems skyes bu mang po gri ru 'chi: bdud sprul sde dpon mang pos snying khrag 'pho: chos spyod sde pa mang po dmangs su 'bebs: dmag 'khrug nad yams mi lo bco brgyad 'byung :

bdud kyis ma bslus chos byed nyin skar tsam: me chu rlung gsum 'khrugs pa'i na bun bzhin: phyi dang nang med dbyar sos rlan ltar 'brub: de dus nga nyid sku yi sprul pa'i cha: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes khyod la gdams: gsung sprul bai ro tsa na khyod la gdams: thugs sprul lha sras rje bo khyod la gdams: yon tan rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod la gdams: phrin las dbang gi mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: shog dril sgrub khog lnga ru bgyid nas su: sku tshab gter lnga dbang ba'i bu la bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan grogs lngar snga phyi ru: rten 'brel dus las mi 'da' 'phrad par shog: khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags rgya can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin par 'gyur: zhes dang*/ sa steng thon pa tsam gyis sgom sgrub dang : spel sbyong 'dzin 'chang klog la nan tan gyis: thugs rjes bskyab nges the tshom bor la sgrubs: pad 'byung nga ni sems can don las med: 'di phyi don yod nga phyir 'jug rlom na: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: dad ldan mdun du nga nyid sprul pa re: mos gus can la sgo nyal lta bu yod: khyad par tshes bcu'i dus su mngon sum mjal: gsol btab rab gnas thebs rnams dag zhing bgrod: rnga yab gling du bdag mjal the tshom med: lhag par sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag tshe: blo yi gzu dpang nga nyid gzu bor zhog: 'di yi go rim yi ge 'phrin pa bcas: skal ldan kun gyi rna bar sim par gyis: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ nye ba'i char sngar gu ru'i rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus rnam gsum chos kyi smin grol mdzad pa'i gnas mchog bod yul sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po/

bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang de nyid du gu ru yab yum gyis skad cig gis mig 'phrul ltar mi snang bar rgya yis gdams pa mdzad pa'i sku tshab mthong grol chen mo/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/ thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag zhal gdams bcu gsum las phran dang bcas pa/ bod rab byung 12sa khyi lo'i zla tshes la phyi nang gi 'byin pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes shing zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ rwa ston stobs rdo rje sogs la gnang*/ snga ma las o rgyan dri med gling pa dang*/ rtsa nang gter chen/ lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa sogs nas rim par 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i khu rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin la/ de la'ang bder 'dus rtsa ba'i dbang chen dang*/ yan lag sgrub thabs bcu gsum sogs ji snyed bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni yan lag sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de la yang spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams lnga dang*/ smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams lnga dang*/ phrin las bye brag gi zhal gdams gsum bcas bcu gsum du bzhugs pa las/ dang po stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams don lnga'i sgrub pa: snang mtha' thog ma'i rigs lnga o rgyan bde gshegs sgrub par dbus phyogs chos sku'i lha tshom: shar du 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa rig 'dzin o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i lha tshom: lho ru cir snang lam khyer tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lha tshom:

nub tu 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi lha tshom: byang du nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa chos dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshom: bcas yod pa las skabs su bab pa 'di ni

zhes sogs lo rgyus rgyas bsdus ci rig brjod rjes/ gsham gsal le tshan bcu gsum gyi dbang chog so sor sbyar dgos pas skabs phyed bya'o/ /bye brag gi 'khyogs mtshams ni/ mchan dang po/ snang mtha' thog ma'i rigs lnga o rgyan bde gshegs sgrub pa ni/ gsol 'debs las/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gdod ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas bde gshegs rigs lnga la bsten nas/ bde chen zhing khams sgrub pa ye shes gsang lam dang 'brel ba'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba yin la/ de'ang zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs dag snang sgyu mar snang ba'i tshe: lha sku stong ra gzugs sku sgyu ma'i ngang : dran rig snang mtha'i ngo bor sgrub pa la: rang nyid rnam snang chos bdun ldan pa'i sku: nga nyid zung 'jug bde chen rgyal por sgoms: spros bcas spros med bskyed rdzogs zung ldan las: zhing khams lha khrid dkyil 'khor thog ma'o: zhes dang*/ gzhung las/ e ma hoḥ gdams pa'i zhal lung rgyud kyi man ngag las: rgyal sras grogs la nges 'byung tshigs su bcad: blo yi rab ma chos kyi mdun bsus la: skye gnas 'jig dang tha ma'i bar do gsum: nges par da lan lus 'dir 'byung ba la: rnam g.yeng bdud kyi blo sna mi 'dzin par: mi rtag 'chi ba'i nges shes rang rgyud bskul: tshe la long med snum zad dkar me 'dra: chu tshod yud tsam 'chi ba nye ru ldang : tshe 'dir bsags pa'i nor rdzas sbrang rtsi bzhin: bsags pa'i dbang yod za ba'i go skabs med: dmangs po'i zas nor btsan pos 'phrog pa bzhin: gzhon lus mi rtag nam langs ba mo ltar: 'chi bdag nyi mas dal 'byor zil pa skam: snying ring dred po'i zas skal gshin rjes 'phrog: tshogs ma bsags rnams gtan rgyags lam la zad:

zhim lto 'jam gos sprin dkar 'dab ma bzhin: rtsol sgrub tha ma ston nam g.yer ba 'dra: blo gtad rtswa shing 'bras bu thal ba 'byung : gtong bsam chen po byed don gnad la 'gags: yengs ma lam la mi tshe stong log mkhan: rten 'brel bcu gnyis lus kyi sgrom bu 'di: dur khrod rus pa'i khra khrol ya re nga : mi gtsang 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i phyi thag 'di: 'di phyi gnyis phung yin pas kye re hud: zob po'i dge bshes 'jig rten dkor nag rngam: skye srid kun la mi phan zhe re pham: ser gzugs a 'thas 'gong po mi chos mkhas: zog pos chos brgyad sgrub pa bdud kyi grogs: 'phral bzang 'phro med g.yo can sbyin pa bzhin: de mthong skal ldan rnams kyis chos sgrub tshe: sngon chad shi ba rnams la skyo bas bskul: da lta yad yud 'di la mi rtag sgom: phyis 'byung tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma la: gnas lugs ngo bo chos sku'i nyams len skyongs: zhing khams dag pa longs sku'i rtsal snang sbyongs: 'bras bu dag pa sprul sku'i 'dun ma sgrubs: lha sras dam 'dzin rje 'bangs grogs rnams kun: ma 'ongs dus su snying nas chos byed dkon: khyad par snyigs ma lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: mi rnams dug lnga rang phung spyod pa yis: 'bras bu rnam smin dus ngan gnyis tshogs 'khor: de dus sgrub la long med glo bur 'chi: nyams len skyong ba nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: dge bcu'i srol bstod nam phyed me dmar mtshungs: de 'dra'i skabs su sems can a tsa ma: nges par ngan gol lam la snyegs pa'i tshe: da lta'i grogs rnams skye ba rim brgyud nas: phan sems bla na med pas rgyud bskul mthus: nga yi snying byang don tshan 'byed par 'gyur: de dus zhal gdams 'di dang gang 'phrad rnams: o rgyan bde chen zhing la bgrod par 'gyur: 'di la sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum ste: phyi ltar tshogs bsags cho ga'i phyag len dang : nang ltar nyams len bskyed rdzogs skyong thabs dang :

zung 'jug bdag lus zhing khams ltar sbyangs nas: dran rig mngon sum chos skur sgrub pa'i thabs: spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med de: 'di nyid 'od lus chos skur grol ba'i thabs: don rdzogs sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bstan pa'i phyir: sgrub pa'i go rim bde chen gsang lam bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger gzugs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi snyigs ma'i tshe: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor du/ o rgyan bde chen rgyal po?sogs le tshan gang yin kha bsgyur/ mchan dbang bskur ba la bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha yi rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag snyim par me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka' yi gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ skal ldan dam gtsang rigs kyi sras: snod kyi dam pa mchog rnams nyon: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: smin phyir bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad pa la/

phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs bsags par bya ba'i slad du yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don yid la bzung zhing tshig gi rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /lan gsum/ de nas dam chu btang ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni bde gshegs bla med chu: bsrungs pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:

nyams pas ltung ba'i las su 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar 'gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ye shes btsan thabs su 'bebs pa la/ rang gnas kyi ye shes snying las bslangs te rim pas dbang gi rten gyi rten gzhi so thub tu sgrub pa la/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung srog rtsol kha sbyor du 'ching*/ yid tshogs drug gi yul las ma g.yeng bar dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ zhes pa'i rjes su bye brag le tshan bcu gsum gang yin ltar dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa la 'jug par bya'o/ mchan oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa 'og min bde ba can gyi zhing khams gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar bar gyur/ hrīḥyig gnas 'gyur rang nyid 'od mi 'gyur/ mnyam bzhag skyil krung gsal stong lham mer bzhugs: longs sku spyan gzigs sprul sku rigs bzhi la: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bkod pa rdzogs: 'khor du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dang : sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: khyad par dag pa rig 'dzin gtso 'khor dang :

mkha' spyod zhing gi lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: bar med khyab pa bsam brjod blo las 'das: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha yi gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal ba la/ mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rang snang 'og min bde chen dag pa'i zhing nas bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar gyi/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi sogs?tshig bdun gsol 'debs rjes/ hoḥ phyogs bcu'i ga la'i zhing du bzhugs pa yis: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin ji snyed dang : de snyed bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: byams brtse'i thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs la: bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun skyob pa'i slad: nye bar dgongs shig byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: gnas mchog 'di ru?stsol: om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad/

khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ /ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprad de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che bum pa bdud rtsi chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprad pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed kyi sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig /mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/

gtso bo 'od dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lus can sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: mnyam bzhag skyil krung bde stong lham mer bzhugs: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyan ras gzigs thogs la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: dbyings phyug dkar mo bde stong zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje sems dpa' thogs la: hrīḥ zhe sdang rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dung mdog snang stong spyan ma sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen 'byung ldan thogs la: hrīḥ nga rgyal rnam dag bcom ldan rin chen 'byung : gser mdog bde stong mā kī sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ rat+na sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: snang ba mtha' yas thogs la: hrīḥ 'dod chags rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: zangs mdog grags stong gos dkar pang du 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ don yod grub pa thogs la: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag bcom ldan don yod grub: mthing mdog tshor stong dam tshig sgrol ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ karma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprad pa ni/ sems kyi chos nyid thig ler nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du/ bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig byung zhing zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥdamar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes mdzod/

om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ om̐ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.a mām̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza hūm̐: om̐ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañca sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrī swā hā: zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/

bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /de nas thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad/ rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma thogs la: yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog:
