om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ rang snang ba gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag pa gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing*/

gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed/ sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: de ltar o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med kyi sogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i sogs gsham gsal rnams su lha mtshan kha bsgyur bas grub/ mchan dbang bskur thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung sdom gyi 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod spyi chings ltar shes par bya'o/ de dag gis dang po o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med kyi bde chen zhing dbang grub bo//

// ༈ gnyis pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal po ni/ lo rgyus rgyas bsdus mtshams sbyar ltar ci rigs par longs khom dang bstun nas 'chad la/ 'khyog mtshams lo rgyus bye brag kha bsgyur ni/ da lam khyed rang rnams la 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa'i rig 'dzin o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang bskur bar byed pa'i skabs su babs pa yin la/ de'ang gsol 'debs las/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ mi rtag sgyu ma'i grogs po g.yar khang lus: 'byung bzhi'i na tsha 'khrugs nas 'chi ltas phog: nad gcod drag pos mi bzod sdug bsngal bskyed: 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi 'byung lnga'i kha dog brten: 'byung bzhi so sor bral la nye ba'i tshe: nga nyid bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bor sgoms: rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas su bgyis: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i tha ma ru: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lngar spyod: dge las ldog pa'i sdig spyod sna tshogs kyis: gti mug rgyud nyal rigs drug duḥkha myong : de tshe sems can skyabs med a tsa ma: las kyi gzhung 'di chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra: rnam smin rdzing 'di dmyal ba'i me 'obs 'dra: mthong zhing 'khor ba bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: de phyir skyabs med las kyi sems can tshogs: rig 'dzin dag pa'i zhing du sgrol ba'i thabs: lnga ldan lha khrid tshom bu 'di lta bu: rang bzhin ma bcos stong pa'i rol rtsal las: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rnga yab pad+ma 'od: 'ja' 'od gur dang lug gu rgyud kyi phreng : sna tshogs snang ba'i dbus su tshom bu'i lha: dbus su gu ru bde chen rgyal po bzhugs: steng du rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs:

shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: lho ru phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: nub tu tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: de la rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs: 'ja' tshon zer thag nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: snang stong sgyu ma'i snang ngor dmigs nas su: bdag sogs 'gro ba pha ma'i skye gnas bzhi: gsol btab ma rig rigs drug sgo bkag nas: sdug bsngal snang ba'i 'khrul rgyun chad par sgoms: sar gnas rig 'dzin dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs: phyag rgya rig 'dzin yi dwags sdug bsngal skyobs: tshe dbang rig 'dzin byol song sdug bsngal skyobs: lhun grub rig 'dzin mi yi sdug bsngal skyobs: bde chen rig 'dzin lha min sdug bsngal skyobs: smin pa'i rig 'dzin lha yi sdug bsngal skyobs: rigs drug 'khrul snang sdug bsngal ci shar yang : rig 'dzin so sor 'dun pa bskyed pa'i tshe: 'khrul snang sdug bsngal rtsad nas gcod pa dang : rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: khyad par nam zhig bar dor 'pho ba'i tshe: dag pa rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhing khams nas: 'od zer mi bzod dpag yas 'ja' ltar du: rang gi snying khar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: rig 'dzin bsu ba yin par nges shes bskyed: de dang mnyam por nyams pa'i 'od drug ni: rang gi lte bar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: rigs drug bsu ma yin pas rjes ma 'brang : de bzhin thim rim rdzogs nas ro rkyang du: rlung rnams zhugs nas bar do'i snang ba 'char: de tshe rang nyid rig pa bag gyis klod: sngangs skrag la sogs snang ba ci shar yang : thams cad stong pa'i rang gzugs shes par gyis: dgra la sdang ba'i rnam pa mi bgyi zhing : gnyen la byams pa'i brod kha spang bar bya: dge sdig la sogs rnam smin mthong ba'i tshe: gshed ma rnams la byams sems snying nas bskyed:

de tshe dge ba'i rtsi kha zin par 'gyur: gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: mngon dga'i zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: shar phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: kun snang pre ta'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: dpal ldan zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: lho phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: gti mug dud 'gro'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: bde chen zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: nub phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: 'dod chags mi yi snang ba shar ba'i tshe: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: las rab zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: byang phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: phrag dog lha min snang ba shar ba'i tshe: bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: rnga yab zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: dbus phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: nga rgyal lha yi snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: mkha' spyod zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: steng phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: de ltar 'dzin rtog 'jigs skrag snang ba rnams: ma yengs gtan du dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs: gang shar thams cad chos nyid rol par skyongs: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa'i rig 'dzin o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams?

sogs gong gsal bde chen zhing dbang ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs pa stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og min pad+ma drwa ba'i zhing khams gzhal med khang*/ bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ dmar gsal gyi rang bzhin du gsal thob/ de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: gu ru bde chen rgyal po'i sku: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum mdzes: dmar smug dbang gi phrin las rdzogs: dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag can: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas: dar dpyangs cod pan du ma 'phur: phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: rdo rje bhan+dha mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen dang ni rus pas brgyan: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par sgoms: gzhan yang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gsal stong nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ni: snang la rang bzhin 'ja' tshon ltar: ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings su sgoms: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun gyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal thob la/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rang snang longs sku'i rigs lnga'i zhing khams nas bla ma bde gshegs rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rig 'dzin grub thob bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang*/

dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs/ dag pa lha yi phyag rgya sad pa'i gsang ba gsum las/ phyag rgya/ yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod o rgyan dag pa'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i rig 'dzin gtso bo gshegs su gsol: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin rol pa ye shes gshegs su gsol: zhing khams phrin las rnam bzhi'i pho brang nas: dag pa rig 'dzin rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: bde stong mkha' la rol pa'i pho brang nas: gsang ba dbyings kyi yum drug gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha:

sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che bum pa bdud rtsi chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ bde chen rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dmar smug mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ ma hā su ṣa rā dza hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: zung 'jug gsang ba'i ye shes sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho bi shwa dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sar gnas rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin sku: dkar gsal chags med nyi zla'i dngos grub 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon dga'i rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra badz+ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: phyag rgya rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: lho ru phyag rgya rig 'dzin chen po'i sku: ser gsal skyon bral mthing 'od 'bar ma 'khril:

de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dpal ldan rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi bho dha ra rat+na hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: nub tu tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku: dmar gsal bde stong rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: pad brtsegs rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra pad+ma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lhun grub rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku: ljang gsal skye med las kyi mkha' 'gro 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra karma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprad de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang :

lnga ldan bdud rtsi snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ gu ru yo gi ni ḍāk+ki ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste:

sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprad pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab gsum gyi tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag:

rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma thogs la/ yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprad pa'i dbang thob par mos/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub 'thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams 'thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dha ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pas bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprad pas sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas pa shing gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed/ sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ gsum pa o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ sngon rjes rnams spyi ltar la/ bye brag lo rgyus 'khyogs mtshams ni/ da khyed rang rnams la cir snang tshogs drug rang grol o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa thod phreng sde lnga'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams le tshan las/ bzang ngan las dbang rkyen gyi rtar bskyon nas: bar do gnyis snang 'jigs skrag shar ba'i tshe: thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i dpa' gdeng skyed: sngon byung srid pa'i bag chags sha gzugs la: ma chags ma zhen sgyu mar shes par gyis: nga nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ngo bor sgoms: rang nyid bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gsal stong ngang : sa ma ya: rang gzhung las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam thar dpag yas kyang : chig dril sgrub pa thugs kyi thig le nyid: yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar 'phags pa: zab lam snyan brgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i rdzing : de la rnam par dbye ba'i don tshan nyid: gang zhig sems can sgyu lus 'jigs pa'i tshe: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul bag chags sna tshogs 'thab: 'dod khams lha rnams gnyid log ci bzhin du: rtag mi thub ste lug rgyud mched pa ltar: gcig snang gnyis 'phel rgyu 'bras so so'i gzugs: gang la chags pa'i rnam pa mthong bar gyur:

de tshe rang nyid rjes shes so ma'i steng : nyin snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyangs pa'i tshe: rdo rje thod phreng me long ye shes ngang : rnam rtog bzang ngan phra rags ci shar yang : snang yang bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha skur grol: de nas mtshan mos rmi lam sbyangs pa'i tshe: rat+na thod phreng mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : nyin snang mtshan mo'i bag chags bying ba dang : rna bar sgra sogs snyan dang mi snyan rigs: brag cha dang ni rmi lam lha mo bzhin: dbyangs dang rngam skad gcan gzan 'tshe ba sogs: gnyan la dgra sdang gang gis smra ba rnams: stong pa'i 'brug skad rlung sgra ci bzhin du: pi waṃ gdangs ltar rang bzhin stong par 'gro: de nas bar do'i kun rtog sbyangs pa'i tshe: pad+ma thod phreng sor rtogs ye shes ngang : nang tshan bar do'i las mkhan rngam tshul dang : yid kyis rtog dpyod so sor gol ba'i dus: snang ba dgrar langs rtogs pa rngo mi thogs: de tshe gnas pa gzhi la 'gyu ba'i lam: brtag dpyad gzhig bral cir yang 'char ba'i tshe: sngon bsu rjes gcod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: gang shar 'dzin med chos sku'i ngang du grol: de nas skye gnas rnam bzhi sbyangs pa'i tshe: karma thod phreng bya grub ye shes ngang : byed spyod thams cad sgyu mar shes par bya: las kyis shugs la srid par 'jug pa'i tshe: gang du skye ba'i yul de rtag tu mthong : srid pa rigs drug pho mo 'khrig pa sogs: reg bya'i yul la rtag mi thub par 'char: de tshe rang rig bla ma yi dam dang : rgyu 'bras bskul ba'i chos rnams la sogs pa: dag snang gus 'dun sbyang ba'i dus gcig go: bden pas bsu ba smon lam mtha' btsan pas: rigs ldan bram ze mtshan bzang rnyed par 'gyur: srid par gnas tshe mya ngan snang ba skye: cir snang dag pa longs sku'i zhing du sgoms: nam zhig las kyi rlung gis rab bskul bas: 'jig rten mi yul mthong nas bag tsha zhing :

reg bya rtsub sogs sdug bsngal sdang ba'i tshe: snang stong grags stong gsal stong tshor stong dang : mi rtog ye shes gnas lugs ngang du zhog: 'di phyi'i byed spyod sgyu ma'i ngang du grol: de nas bskyed rdzogs lam la sbyangs pa'i tshe: bud+dha thod phreng chos dbyings ye shes ngang : pad 'byung dus gsum mkhyen pa dus med rtogs: 'das pa'i rtog pa ye grol gdod nas dag: da lta'i rtog pa dran rig chos skur grol: ma 'ongs rtog pa glo bur byar med ngang : gnas skabs rtog pa shar grol mnyam rjes bral: dus bzhi dus kyi dus dang gnas skabs bral: dus gsum mkhyen pas phyi nang bral ba'i phyir: sngar 'das da lta phyis 'byung stong pa nyid: chos rnams ji snyed mi dmigs stong pa nyid: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje stong pa nyid: mthar 'das 'dor len med pa stong pa nyid: de bzhin rgyu dang mtshan ma stong pa nyid: de bzhin sgyu lus 'byung lnga stong pa nyid: ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i 'khor lo can: bskyed rim snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i ngang : rdzogs rim gang shar ka dag gdod nas grol: 'byung 'jug sngags rnams rlung gi rang bzhin gdangs: kun kyang nam mkha' che la sems kyang che: sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas skye 'gag bral: med bzhin snang yang dam tshig dmigs su med: 'gyu ba'i snang ba gnyis snang 'gyu zhing stong : staung zhing gsal ba gsal stong skye ba med: rnam rtog skye bas chos sku 'gags mi 'gyur: rnam rtog gnyis snang chos sku'i dbyings su yal: yang rtog blang dor ma rig 'thib pa'i tshogs: gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i dbyings la ltos: lta ba klong yangs nam mkha'i mtha' dang bral: nam mkha'i mtha' la rgya dpang ris su med: de bzhin bcad cing dum bur btub tu med: dgag cing bsgrub pa med pa'i rdzogs pa che: gu ru dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal gdams nyid: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab:

rin chen za ma tog gi nang du bskyil: gsang rgya zab pa'i snying thig ti la ka: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs pa ltar/ cir snang lam khyer tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa thod phreng sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid bgyi 'os sogs/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba nas gsol 'debs skyabs sems sdom bzung dam bzhag bar snga ma ltar 'gres shes par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa 'og min rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od/ o rgyan rang byung gi zhing khams gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing gsal 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de nyid yongs gyur skad gcig gi /gu ru bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog mthing : he ru ka pa'i cha lugs can: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su bsgom: de bzhin rol stabs bzhugs pa yi: pang du 'khyud pa'i gsang ye ni: lha lcam dmar mo zung 'jug 'khril: gcer bu rin chen rgyan gyis spras: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: zung 'jug gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal gdab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rang snang sprul pa'i zhing khams 'og min pad+ma drwa ba nas bla ma thod phreng sde lnga'i lha tshogs rig 'dzin grub thob bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang dag pa lha yi phyag rgya sad pa'i gsang ba gsum las/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs rjes/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od: o rgyan rang byung zhing khams nas: rje btsun bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi'i phrin las zhing khams nas: thod phreng sde bzhi gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs lnga mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas: dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas byin phob dbang chen bskur: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/

rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ /ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprad de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig tu/ bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/

hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par/ so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ bud+dha a bhi dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

rdo rje thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dkar po rdo rje'i rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: byams pa tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rat+na thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser mo rin chen rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: snying rje tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ rat+na ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma'i rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ pad+ma ma li ta hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: karma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ljang gu las kyi rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ karma ma li ta hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad/ bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal 'bul: de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/

lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprad de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon pas/ thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ āḥhūm̐:badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dza: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gu ru he ru ka ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes su mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/

gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma thogs la: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas pa/ gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/

ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gzhan spyi dang mthun no/ /gsum pa o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i smin byed kyi le tshan no// // ༈ bzhi pa/ o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mo dang bcas pa'i dpa' bo gyad ni/ lo rgyus 'khyogs mtshams ni/ da khyed rang rnams la 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor/ o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi smin byed dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs skye gnas 'du byed rnam bzhi yis: 'phro 'du srid pa'i chu rlung rab g.yos nas: byer zhig stong la khru chad had por lus: sgyu ma'i grong la smig rgyu spyod pa bzhin: rtag mi thub ste dri za'i grong khyer ltar: ngos bzung cing med grog ma'i tshang zhig 'dra: bya gcan yid mtshar 'tshogs pa'i spu ris bzhin: yid brtan mi snang gar mkhan lag dang mtshungs: rgyal 'gong 'tshogs pa'i sgo them ji bzhin du: yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phung shul 'dra: de dus gdams ngag snying po 'di kho na: lha sras rje bo'i thugs la de skad chongs: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dal 'byor rnyed dka' rdo rje lus kyi sgrom: phung po lnga dang khams lnga dbang po lnga: snang ba tshogs drug rnam shes tshogs chen brgyad:

rten 'brel srid pa skye mched bcu gnyis te: rlung lnga srog 'dzin las rlung ye shes rlung : brgyad khri bzhi stong rtsa khams 'khor lo drug: yas brtan ro ma dbu ma rkyang ma gsum: mas brtan khrag rlung rtsa srin rtsa ba gsum: rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa rnam pa bzhi: a haṃ tsha grang gnyis dang 'pho ba brgyad: kun rgyu nges par rgyu dang shin tu rgyu: bcu drug lus kyi cha shas rdzogs pa la: don lnga snod drug khams dang dbang po'i tshogs: de la brten pas skye 'chi zhes bya ste: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chod kyis: sgyu lus nyams shing ngal ba'i nad byung na: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi sgrub par brtson: sa ma ya: dpa' bo gyad kyi mtshan nyid ci zhe na: sku la skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba'i phyir: 'byung bzhi'i tshe yi bar chod glags mi rnyed: gsung la grags stong ma 'gags sgra ldan pas: 'byung 'jug rlung gis 'phro 'du ya mi nga : thugs nyid nam mkha'i gsal stong mtha' bral bas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i khu sprin bag mi tsha: snang stong mtshan ma'i gzhom gzhig bral ba'i phyir: rgyu 'bras bden pa gang gis dor mi nus: de bzhin ka dag dbyings kyi gyad dang mtshungs: ka dag la yang rnam pa gsum 'dod de: ngo bo ka dag rang bzhin gdod nas dag: dbyings kyi ka dag mtha' dbus ka nas dag: snang ba ka dag tshogs drug 'dzin pa bral: rgyu yis ma byas rkyen gyis mi 'jig pa'i: 'ja' lus skye 'chi gnyis med pad+ma 'byung : 'ja' lus de yi mtshan nyid ci zhe na: bsdu bya sgyu ma'i tshul la ma brten pas: snang stong tshogs drug mi dmigs rang bzhin gsal: sa khams ma mchis sangs rgyas spyan mar grol: chu khams ma mchis mā ma kī ru grol: me khams ma mchis gos dkar ma ru grol: rlung khams ma mchis dam tshig sgrol mar grol: snang bar mi gol dbyings phyug ma ru grol: de bzhin 'byung bzhi dag kyang rang sar grol: grol ba'i gdams ngag 'dogs par bya ba la:

'byung lnga sbyangs shing bsgyur te sprul pa tsam: dang po rnam snang chos bdun ldan pa'i ngang : stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo zung 'jug brten: skabs su dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhis 'dren pa dang : gsal gdab rlung ro bsal zhing rngubs nas bsgom: gzhil zhing 'khrul 'khor lnga yis legs par bcun: dbab ste gnas su shin tu pheb par bya: bkram pa bzhi yis laigs par dgram par bya: sprug pa drug gis rtag tu sprugs par bya: skabs su rlung sems lte ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyis: mnyam bzhag dang ni dbu ma legs par sbyangs: 'byongs tshe khams lnga rang bzhin gnas su dag: sa rlung dag pas ri brag zang thal 'gro: chu rlung dag pas rgya mtshor nya ltar 'phyo: me rlung dag pas me dang gnyis med ldog: rlung sems gnyis med mkha' la lding zhing gshegs: de tshe lus la grib ma mi 'byung zhing : ngang pa'i rgyal po bzhin ltar shin tu gsal: snang srid skye gnas bud+dha'i zhing du 'gro: 'phral gyi yon tan dag kyang 'di 'dra ste: mdangs ni rma bya rtsal ni khyung chen 'dra: tshul ni seṅge shugs ni gyad mi 'dra: dbyangs ni tshangs pa bzhin ni kun tu bzang : de phyir khams gong lha rnams sgyu mar rig: 'dzam gling 'di la ma ltos grangs med kyang : 'jig rten gnas rnams ye shes zang thal mthong : de nas rlung sems lte ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: tshe 'di'i 'byung bzhi'i gnad gcod ma ltos par: 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'di tsam ya mtshan med: o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mo'i don: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs 'di la mi g.yel bar: gcig tu dril na rang rig pad+ma 'byung : bla mar 'dus te rje yi sgrub par brtson: gdeng dang ldan pas pad 'byung gyad kyi sku: mi 'jigs gdeng bzhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa brgyad: dbang phyug yan lag bdun ldan 'phags pa'i lam: byang chub sems lnga tshad med rnam pa bzhi: snyoms par 'jug dang stong nyid bcu drug bcas: de sogs yon tan spyi dang bye brag rgyu:

theg dgu bcu gsum sku la rdzogs pa'i phyir: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi mtshan nyid de: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di kho na: yang snying bla ma mkha' 'gro dbyer med nyid: nyams len bla ma'i sgrub pa'i zhal gdams 'di: dam pa rje yi bka' bstsal bslad med du: kho mo dbyangs can bdag gis yi ger btab: gsang rgya shwa na ma yis brda bgyis te: bla ma bde gshegs bka' 'dus cha rkyen du: brag dmar mchims phu'i ke'u tshang rgya ru btab: da lta'i gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: ma 'ongs rin chen gter la spyod pa'i tshe: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus 'di dang 'phrad par shog: rgya 'di sngags bdag lha mos rtag tu skyongs: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi 'pho 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid

sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi/ gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa 'og min bde ba can gyi zhing khams gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rig pa hrī yig dkar la dmar mdangs 'phro ba zhig tu gyur/ hrī yig gnas 'gyur mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku/ rgya gar rig 'dzin sprul sku'i cha lugs can: sku mdog dkar dmar gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: spyan lnga ldan zhing thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: dbu la pad+ma'i sag zhu cod pan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje'i sa gnon sdug bsngal skyabs: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhan+dha tshom bu bsnams: sku la chos gos rnam gsum mdzes pas brgyan: zhabs gnyis bde chen rdo rje'i stabs kyis bzhugs: rig ma kha ṭ+wāṃ be'u bum rnam par gsal: rang bzhin ye shes rol pa'i ngang du bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal ba la/ mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rang snang 'og min pad+ma drwa ba nas rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha tshogs/ rig 'dzin grub thob bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

de thams cad kyang dag pa lha'i phyag rgya sad pa'i gsang ba gsum las/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog nas: paṇa chen pad+ma kā ra la: rigs bzhi 'byung lnga'i lha mos bskor: phung khams skye mched gnas dag pa'i: zang thal chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du: spyan 'dren byin 'bebs gshegs su gsol: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag gyur stsol: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ badz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing :

bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ /ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig tu bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/

sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: mtsho skyes rdo rje skye 'chi gdod nas dag: rgya gar rig 'dzin pan chen cha lugs 'chang : deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu la khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sangs rgyas spyan ma thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lha mo yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje rigs kyi lcam: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sa yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ badz+ra ra ti mum̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mā ma kī thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lha mo yum chen mā ma kī: sku mdog ser mo rin chen rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ra ti lām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gos dkar mo thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lha mo yum chen gos dkar mo: sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ rā ga ra ti pām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dam tshig sgrol ma thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lha mo yum chen dam tshig sgrol: sku mdog ljang mo karma rigs kyi lcam:

deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ pradz+nyā ra ti tām̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig ler nyag gcig tu mtshon par/ thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/

/gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥdakar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki mūm̐ shrī hūm̐: zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes su mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/

tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad/ rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa'i ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten:

'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i/ longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung*/ mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/

sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i mtshon byed/ sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bzhi pa dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ lnga pa/ o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs ni/ lo rgyus 'khyogs mtshams ni/ da khyed rang rnams la nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod:

de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: zhes dang*/ zhal gdams las/ nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug rnams rim par sdud: snang mched thob gsum shar nas lus sems bral: rnam shes myu gu'i me tog yal ba'i tshe: nga nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam sgoms: dran rig 'od lus āḥyig chos skur 'pho: rang nyid rnam snang chos bdun khregs ser bzhag: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus yang snying 'dus pa las: zab lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs nyid: tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag 'chang gdams pa ste: da lta spel ba'i dus min sba ba'i dus: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: mi rnams skye 'chi mi rtag lcag gis bskul: tshe 'di'i snang ba rlung nang mar me bzhin: drag tu bskyod pas rnam shes myu gu yal: dkar nag las kyis nam yang mi bslu phyir: rang byas rnam smin bag chags 'thab pa'i tshe: sdug bsngal bzod dka' me 'obs dong 'drar lhung : skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir: bya byed thams cad don med kye re hud: legs par bsams na snying rlung mi ldang ngam: de phyir don med 'khor bar mi brtson par: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam nyams su longs: legs par gdams so lha sras bod kyi rje: rje 'bangs grogs rnams ma brjed yid la chongs: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams rang snang rol pa'i pho brang zla gam sgo gcig pa phyi nang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rnam thar gsum ldan e dbyings su/ ma chags pad+ma dang thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtog med mtshon pa'i ti ra mgo g.yon du byas pa'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng*/ khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa hūm̐ dmar po zhig gsal thob/ de nyid yongs gyur rje btsun rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad khros pa'i nyams: phag zhal dbu brgyan skra grol dbyings la gzigs: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs: rus pa'i rgyan drug zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum can: gru mor brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ he ru kaḥ gar gyi nyams ldan 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs: ral pa'i khrod na rigs bdag dang bcas gsal: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rang snang mkha' spyod ḍāk+ki'i gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor rig 'dzin dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang dag pa lha'i phyag rgya sad pa'i gsang ba gsum las/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/

hūm̐ ma: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: glu len gar bsgyur shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: ḍāk+ki sprin ltar thibs se thib: byin rlabs thugs rje sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥsatwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams/ gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags:

nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang*/

bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ rdo rje phag mo thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed pa'i yum: dbu ma'i 'khor lo'i sgo 'byed rigs bdag brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'pho ba 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra yo gi ni ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' spyod rdo rje'i rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dkar mo zhi ba'i 'od zer ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ha badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: sa spyod rig 'dzin rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ser mo rgyas pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ri rat+na ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ka dag 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ni pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: tshogs spyod karma las kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ljang mo dgyes pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: myur lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su+u gsol: sa karma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas gyur par shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na hrīḥ zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/

me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod:
