de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lngar rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang shar ba'i ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rnam rol gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/

khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas pa gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ lnga pa o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no/ /'di'i yan stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i las tshogs lnga song nas/ gnyis pa smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi le tshan lnga yod pa las/ de'ang gter gzhung las/ dngos gzhi smad las gang 'dul der ston pa'i rgyu ni: mtsho rgyal dang grogs rnams la gdams pa: sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i mu ge:

gti mug las gyur pa'i nad rigs: zhe sdang las gyur pa'i dmag 'khrug: nga rgyal las gyur pa'i chom po: phrag dog las gyur pa'i mtha' bzhi ral pa sogs 'byung gsungs: de dag mi 'byung ba'i gdams pa ma hā gu ru'i zhal gdams su gnang bar stsol: ces zhus pas bka' bstsal pa: spyir sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa kha yan du spyad pa'i las las grub pa yin te: dug lnga rang grol gyi gdams pa dang gsol 'debs mtshams sbyor gyi sgrub pa 'di ltar dgos so: sa ma ya: de'ang dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung ba kun sel ba'i dbus su o rgyan nor lha dbyer med pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshom: shar du dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i lha tshom: lho ru pha rol bdud bzhi'i rgol ba gzhom pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi lha tshom: nub tu bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshom: byang du phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi lha tshom: de ltar smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang bdud kyi rgol ba gzhom pa dang dbang sdud zil gnon gyi don tshan phrin las lnga rim par bskur bar bya ba yin no// // ༈ drug pa/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha ni/ spro na bse rag bkar yas sngon du 'gro/ de'ang khyed rang rnams la sems can 'dod chags las byung ba'i mu ge dang dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung sel o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i: 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: dgos 'dod lhun grub nor lha'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs:

bkra shis 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams bsags nas su: rang nyid gnod sbyin dbang phyug chas su bgyid: nga nyid pad+ma rgyal po sgeg pa'i gzugs: mkha' 'gro dbang sdud 'bum bcas bskyed par bya: dngos grub nor 'gugs zhal gdams gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bsod nams phun tshogs dge 'bras smin pa'i phyir: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu'i dpal la longs spyod pa: sngon bsags pre ta'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad lha: snang srid g.yo ba'i rlung rnams rab brtan cing : lha 'khrug sde brgyad 'khu ldog rkyen dbang zhi: gang phyir 'dod sred zhags pa'i me 'od kyi: tsha gdung la brten sems can bsod nams rgud: 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis gzer ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: o rgyan nor lha mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: bkres skom dbul phongs sel bar the tshom med: nges par gdams so lha sras rje 'bangs rnams: gsang rgya 'di nyid kun las gces pa yin: 'ching bu zang zing dngos po mang lags kyang : yid bzhin nor bu 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: bsod nams 'phel byed rnam sras la sogs kyang : mtha' 'khob rgyal po'i bsod nams gnas skabs tsam: 'di phyi kun tu bla ma'i nor sgrub gtso: mchog thun zung gcig 'tshogs 'gyur the tshom med: bsod nams gzugs skus bla mar 'ching ba ste: sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu nor gyi mchog: chog shes longs la 'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub: de phyir yang snying 'di nyid rtag tu sgrubs: gsol ba gang btab bdag gis bslu ba med: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can 'dod chags las byung ba'i mu ge dang dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung sel o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyis gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab rtsig rim nor bu'i tog dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs pa'i yongs su bskor ba'i bar mtshams thams cad rin po che sna bdun gyi gram thang du brdal ba/ dbus su rin po che dang pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng rang gi sems nyid hrīḥms mtshan pa pad+ma rā ga'i 'od 'bar bar sgoms/ de nyid yaungs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: pad+ma rgyal po dbang lhun gzi brjid 'bar: sgeg pa'i cha byad khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i gar: rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas sku lus brgyan: g.yas su rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu bsnams: g.yon du bhan+dha ne'u le pad+ma thogs: lha rdzas stod g.yogs smad dkris ang rag bklubs: phyed skyil pang du dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: lcags kyu pad+ma yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin stsol ba'i sku ru sgoms: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/

khyad par rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dam can chos skyong dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang gu ru pad+ma rgyal po o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: gter 'byung rang bzhin dbang gi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : yid bzhin nor mchog bla ma dzam+bha la: dbang sdud ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra rat+na mu ṭa pad+ma rā ga he sha sarba ak+ṣo bh+ya pra mo ti sarba wi ṭa ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza pā shaṃ ma ma 'dus 'dus swā hā: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur bas dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprad de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/

zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprad pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ pad+ma rgyal po yab yum thogs te: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang sdud 'dod rgu'i dpal yon can: sku mdog dmar snum dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: tshe la dbang zhing mchog gi rig 'dzin gter: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi rjes chags can:

deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i 'ja' lus stsal du gsol: om̐ ā yur ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rig las rdo rje'i brda skad sgrog: zhi 'dzum mdzes pa skye 'gro'i snang ba 'gugs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dod yon longs spyod gter la dbang sgyur shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī su khaṃ dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: shar phyogs la sogs lha yi dpal 'byor sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der stsol cig: om̐ badz+ra ku le a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen pho nya thogs la: hūm̐: 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: lho phyogs la sogs mi yi mnga' thang sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob par shog: om̐ ku le shaṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: nub phyogs pho nya thogs la: hūm̐: ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: nub phyogs la sogs klu yi longs spyod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bang mdzod 'dod rgu 'du bar shog: om̐ ku le hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byang gi pho nya thogs la: hūm̐: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur pho nya mos: byang phyogs la sogs gnod sbyin tshe bsod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dang dpal 'byor stsol: om̐ ku po ti a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag:

rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga/ ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥdamar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra rat+na mu ṭa pad+ma rā ga he sha sarba ak+ṣo bh+ya pra mo ti sarba wi ṭa ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza pā shaṃ ma ma 'dus 'dus swā hā:

oṃ ka ye ku ye ku ru le pā shaṃ she pha k+ṣa dza dza swā hā: zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/

lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ /deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/

gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i/ ye shes kyi skur gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/

rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa'i phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ spro na pad+ma rgyal po ltar g.yang 'gugs sbyar la g.yang gtad kyang bya'o/ /drug pa o rgyan nor lha'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bdun pa/ o rgyan sman lha ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de'ang gsol 'debs las/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs sems can gti mug las gyur tshe: na tsha 'byung bzhi 'khrugs dang 'chi ltas phog: tshe rabs rnam smin lus la 'khor ba'i tshe: ye shes gsal rdzogs sman lha'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid a tsa ra yi cha lugs 'chang : nga nyid sman lha rab khros seng sgrogs sgoms: sman sgrub rlung sgrub tshe sgrub gnad du bsnun: 'chi med 'ja' lus gsal rdzogs bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: 'byung 'dus sgyu ma'i g.yar khang bsdu bya la: 'dus byas smig rgyu'i rnam rtog 'thibs pa bzhin: rab rib ngang la thim rim phung po rdzogs: 'ga' zhig mi 'dod khur gyi duḥkha myong : la la rnam smin 'khor tshe rkyen dbang che: spyir ni dbyar mjug ston kha'i me tog bzhin:

skye 'chi mi rtag rlung nang mar me 'dra: phra rags rnam rtog rlung gi rtar bskyon te: rags pa 'chi ltas phog ste rang gis mthong : phra ba tshe 'phrang yin pas sgrol thabs 'bungs: nges par sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung nas: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis gzer ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad yin kyang nges par re zhig bshol: bar chad phra mo tsam la lta ci smos: de bas gu ru nga la gsol ba thob: rtsa rlung 'byung ba'i rkyen gyis 'khrugs pa ni: nga nyid dbyer med mtsho rgyal zab lam sbyong : tshe rabs las sgrib gcong nad grum po la: nga nyid zhi ba sman lha ji bzhin sgrubs: bar chad bdud kyis 'phral du sdang srid na: nga nyid bdud dang mu stegs 'dul byed pa: zil gnon seṅge sgra sgrogs sku ru sgrubs: khyad par ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo la: sngon las bas kyang 'phral rkyen shin tu hrag: dam sri bdud dang 'gong po kha dar bas: chos byed pa dang chos rgyal gdung dag la: 'dre rgod 'byung pos glags blta shin tu mang : khyad par dge ba sgrub la bdud mi dad: mu stegs rnams kyis sangs rgyas mi shes shing : dam chos sgrub pos bdud la blo mi 'gro: sangs rgyas rnams kyis mu stegs las mi spyod: des na snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams: dge sdig gnyis kyi blo sna mi mthun nas: rkyen ngan phal cher de yi rgyu las byung : dus ngan tha ma'i sems can ngan dbang che: dper na ma dag mi dge pa la mos: mi gtsang ba la sbrang bu 'khor ba bzhin: dbyar 'bu gtibs bzhin sems can a tsa ma: dge phyogs chos sgrub nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: dus bzang skabs su 'phags pa ma gtogs pa: ci bder 'char ba'i nges pa mi rig pas: rang tshod zin na nyi zlar 'gran ma btsal: sngar byas da res smin cing phyi ma'i las: blo yis zhib dpyad 'phral du 'dun ma sgrubs:

chos rgyal ma rig blo la a 'thas na: 'tshang can rkun ma thang dkyil nam langs 'dra: rje 'bangs khyed rnams 'di phyi'i gtan chos sgrubs: sems can nyon mongs nad kyis zin pa na: dug lnga lam 'khyer sman gyi gdams ngag dgos: khyad par khro mo rdo rje tsaṇ+ḍa lī: phyi yi gtum mo me 'dra 'bar ba'i shugs: bskyed rim khro nyams bdud kyi rgol ba 'joms: nang gi gtum mo sman 'dra'i nus pa bskyed: 'byung bzhi'i nad rnams tsha grang snyoms pas 'dul: gsang ba'i gtum mo dpa' bo seng sgrogs dang : ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs zil gyis gnon: seṅge'i sgra skad wa spyang 'gran zla bral: des na sangs rgyas seṅge'i nga ro yis: bar chad mu stegs wa spyang klad pa 'gems: de bzhin rgya gar maṅga dha yi gnas: bdud 'joms seṅge sgra sgrogs zhes grags pas: bdag la gsol ba gang btab bdud las rgyal: phyi yi sman mchog nus ldan bzang drug gtso: nang gi sman mchog tshogs drug lhug par gtso: gsang ba'i sman mchog sgo drug rlung la sbyang : gso ba'i sman mchog rdzas dang lag len sbyor: bskyed rim sman mchog lha sku'i stong ra sgoms: rdzogs rim sman mchog rang rig gtan la phob: 'di nyid rtogs pas nga nyid sman lha dngos: rten 'brel man ngag sman rnams so sor gsal: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid

sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ phrin las bzhi'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ dran rdzogs gnas 'gyur seṅge sgra sgrogs sku: mthing nag khro tshul spyi bor seng zhal gdangs: seng ldeng gaṇ+ḍi sgrogs pas stong gsum g.yo: 'bar ba'i dbu skra thod skam phreng bas brgyan: sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi lhab tu gsol: rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu bsnams: brkyang bskum gar ldan zung 'jug yab la 'khril: lha mchog de la 'khril ba'i rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zung 'jug yab la 'khril: yab yum ye shes rab 'bar klong du gsal: de yi spyi bor gu ru dug lnga sel: sman lha mthing ga zhi 'dzum thor tshugs can: phyag g.yas rnam par rgyal ba'i a ru ra: 'gro la sman sbyin phyag rgya mchog sbyin can: phyag g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs: mnyam bzhag dgongs pas tshe yi bar chad sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal gdab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par du shar phyogs lta na sdug gi pho brang nas o rgyan sman gyi lha tshe'i rig 'dzin drang srong grub pa thob pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gis thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing khams gang bar 'phros pas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni ma ga dha yi yul: mu stegs 'dul mdzad gnam lcags zor mda' 'phen: bdud dang 'byung po bgegs srin tshar gcod pa: rje btsun drag po gtum chen gshegs su gsol: drag mo rnal 'byor phag gdong gshegs su gsol: rigs bdag sman lha 'tsho mdzad gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams/ gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag cing mthar tshig don ngo sprod de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog:

om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed kyi sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ seṅge sgra sgrogs thogs la: hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod bcom ldan seṅge'i sgra: nyon mongs pham mdzad rdo rje phag mo 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'byung bzhi'i nad kyi bar chad zhi bar shog: om̐ singha ghaṇ+ḍe ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rigs bdag sman lha thogs la: hūm̐: baiḍūr mdangs ldan 'chi med bcud 'dzin lha: tshe 'phrang bar gcod rgol ba zhi mdzad phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skyob par shog: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai ye a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar gyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dkar mo nyi zla'i dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lho'i mgyogs ma thogs la:

hūm̐: mi yi yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ser mo ri rab dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkhris pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: nub kyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: klu yi yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dmar mo lang tshor dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bad kan nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: byang gi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ljang mo srid gsum dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dus pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig tu skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon pa'i thod pa zlum po'i nang du/ bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: auṇ+ya ya sengha gan+ḍa badz+ra na hi ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba pañca hrīḥṭha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra gu ru bir+ya pā ṇi sarba a dhiṣ+ṭha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i/ me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ /thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/

deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa/ yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa:
skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa/ sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa'i phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bdun pa o rgyan sman lha'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ brgyad pa/ o rgyan rdo rje gur ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la pha rol bdud bzhi'i rgol ba gzhom pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: zhes dang*/ zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs sems can nga rgyal las gyur pas: chags sdang dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar zh-ing 'khrugs: phyi nang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid drang srong gnam lcags rtsibs zhus brgyan: nga nyid gtum po gnod sbyin bzhi bcas sgoms: bsrung bzlog phyi nang 'khor lo drwa mig gdab: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang lnga pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: byin rlabs nus pa rgyun 'bebs ti la kaḥ 'di la rnam pa gsum gyis ston pa ni: bla ma sku bzhi sku lnga rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje'i sku la gzhom zhig mi mnga' phyir: pad 'byung nga ni rdo rje'i gur dang ldan: rdo rje'i gur la mtshan nyid gang ldan na: sra ba brtan pa mi chod mi shigs pa: mi 'jigs mi g.yo mi 'gyur mi 'gul ba: gur dang bla re drwa ba rwa ba dang : rgya gram bzhi la ur mo 'bub pa'i rdzong : rtsibs dang drwa mig tog dang srung 'khor bcas: bco brgyad po 'di nga nyid rdo rje'i gur: sgom sgrub nyams len po rnams rdzong chen thob:

ma 'ongs sems can nga rgyal spyod pa yis: zhe sdang phrag dog dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: de yi rkyen gyis mtha' 'khrugs bod khams rtsod: chos rgyal gdan khri bdud blon dmangs kyis 'bebs: de yi rkyen gyi pha mtshun dgra lha 'khrugs: skyes lha yul lha yid 'gyur dgra la phyogs: mtha' bzhi ral nas dbus su mi gad rdib: dbus pa'i pha tshan lcang kha'i byis chung 'dra: glo ba'i grogs pos snying gi khrag rtsa gcod: mchin pa'i bran 'khor mkhris pa'i nang tshan rul: pha tsho nye 'khor seṅge'i khog dang mtshungs: phung bshig 'gong po'i sprul pas yul gru dkrugs: dam nyams dge bshes dmag las sna thag 'dren: 'dzam gling bde skyid sde dgon ban+des dkrugs: pha sde bzang por phung bshig nag mos byed: yul gru'i dam rgya gnyan pa rkun mas gtor: gos su mi sdug lcags kyi slog pa gyon: zas su dug dang nye ba'i lci ba za: rgyan du rang srog phung ba'i mtshon cha thogs: grogs su dam nyams sdig to mkhan la dga': dgos dus rang srog mi khebs btsan rdzong bzo: sems can nyam chung thams cad sdug la gtad: ma byin ka cha 'phrog nas chos brgyad bzhengs: smon lam log par 'brel ba'i dmag dpon bstod: phyag dang zhe sa sdig spyod rgyal por 'bul: gsang sngags gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor khyad du gsod: bsod nams zad pas rang nor gzhan gyis spyod: ri klung med par dgra dang chom pos gang : gom gsum 'gro yang skyel ma dgos pa'i dus: phyug po rnams kyi srog rtsa nor gyis gcod: med po rnams kyi lto rin srog gis 'jal: yod med gnyis po sdug gis bslu ba'i dus: ma nyes cog ger 'dug kyang khrims la bcug: sems can thams cad mtshon cha'i rwa bar btsud: phal cher thams cad mda' mdung gri khar 'chi: smon lam log pas sdug 'dre'i yul du skye: de tshe sems can bde skyid zad pa ste: lto med gos dbul bse rag grong khyer 'dra:

phyug po phal cher yi dwags gter srung bzhin: sbrang bus bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi gzhan spyod bzhin: bdag bsags gzhan gyis spyod par mi mthong ngam: skyes pa'i pha yul 'brog pa'i bskyas shul 'dra: gtan gyi mkhar rdzong bzo ba blo re 'khrul: phyi chas sgrub pa'i gnyen 'dun phal mo che: dri za'i rnam shes bar dor 'phrad dang mtshungs: phyi ma mi sgrub da lta'i gtan don gnyer: brag la skas btsug kha la thal 'debs 'dra: sngar bsags rdzogs 'jug da lta'i 'dod yon rnams: 'bab chu chad pa'i rdzing chu skam pa 'dra: kha dkar gting nag g.yo sgyu'i chos byed de: gso sman dug par nang du 'chang dang mtshungs: g.yang khar rdog pa 'chal ba'i gsol 'debs dang : rab khar skyabs 'gro byed pa'i 'bras bu dang : dgra dod mkhar rdzong 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang : shi 'tsher bla mar 'phral du dad pa bzhin: shing rul bye mar btsugs pa'i lo 'dab 'dra: de bas byang chub snying po sgrub 'dod na: sngon sbyangs sngar bsags da lta'i 'phro mtha' mthud: phyi ma'i las kyang da lta'i 'bras bu yin: lha sras rje 'bangs thugs la de ltar bcag: gnas skabs 'dir yang nga nyid dran par gyis: da lta dus dang bskal pa yar ldan yang : ma 'ongs bdud sprul sa steng g.yo ba 'byung : de dus kho bo dus drug dran par gyis: gang zhig las dang rkyen dbang drag po yis: srog gcod bshan pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: legs par gdams so lha sras bod kyi rje: dam tshig rnam gsum snying gi khrag ltar srungs: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha rol bdud bzhi'i rgol ba gzhom pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung ra mi shigs srid pa rdo rje'i rgya gram bsnol ba'i steng du/ me chu'i 'khor lo so 'thab tu 'khor ba'i lte ba'i dbal so dgra bgegs kyi snying gar bsnun pa/ de'i steng du 'og thams cad rdo rje sa gzhi/ logs thams cad drwa ba dang ra ba/ steng du rdo rje gur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje tog gis spras pa'i lte bar rdo rje'i rgya gram hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan par gyur/ de nyid gnas 'gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: gsang bdag mthing nag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu rgyan spyi bor khyung chen lding : sku la mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: dur khrod chas rdzogs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram thogs: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse nas thog rgod 'bebs: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon: rab 'jigs me dpung mched pa'i klong du gsal: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par gsang chen khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi lha tshogs/

rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad gar dgu'i nyams ldan me rlung thog mtshon gyis gnam sa g.yo ba'i sgra dang bcas/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhir gang ba spyan drangs te/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas srid zhi'i khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i bdag nyid du gyur ba'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: sku gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: gsang bdag g.yul las rgyal byed khro bo'i 'khor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i nus pas skyobs: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: gnas mchog?stsol: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung :

bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar/ tshig don ngo sprod de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myong ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/

sems nyid spros bral du mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po kyi skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ gtso bo gsang bdag thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: gnam lcags shugs 'chang spyi bor khyung gis brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rnam rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: brtan pa rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra bī dza ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

mi g.yo ba thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ kro ta a tsa le a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: stobs po che thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbang phyug stobs chen gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi chod rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ ma hā bha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbyug sngon thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad dbang drag rdo rje srin po'i sku sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag par mos mdzod/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig tu skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par/ thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas gyur par shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ghar+bha tsaṇ+ḍa khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ṇi bh+rūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra tik+ṇa dz+wa la raṃ ts+tshi ka tshan+dha pre sha duṣatsa ṭi te a mu ka ma ra ṇa na kharga badz+ra kī la ya ru tra sha truṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha dhu na dhu na krak+ko sha ya rbad hu ra hu ra nan nan tsit+ta sha ma sha ni mā ra mā ra rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag:

rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda yi bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa shes pa sher dbang ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag:

rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ brgyad pa o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ dgu pa/ o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ gang zhig snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gnas skabs su: skye 'gro kun kyang sil bor 'thor nas su: ri rlung shwa rdel phyogs su 'bros pa dang : khyad par phyogs med bgrod dang dben rir snyogs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i skyi g.ya' 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag chom lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sogs: ya nga rab rgyu bag tshar gyur pa la: nga nyid phyag rgya bzhi yi gtum chas sgoms: rang nyid dmod pa'i ngan sngags chas su zhugs: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi snyigs ma ru: dam sri bdud kyi sprul pa rlung ltar 'tshub: mtha' bzhi'i so kha dbus su rim par 'jug: bod kyi 'dun ma rgyal khrims 'chol zhing g.yeng : gtsug lag chos 'khor dben gnas rim par gud: gsang sngags bstan la bdud sprul 'tshe bas rgol: bod kyi gnas gzhi sgom khang shin tu gog: mi rnams nyon mongs dug lnga'i dpung chen hrag: slob dpon bka' la slob mas mi nyan cing : rjes zer 'bangs kyis mi nyan gyen du log: phas zer bu yis mi nyan blo mi mthun: chos khrims rgyal khrims thang khrims sngar bas stong : yi dam lha bor the'u rang phugs su mchod: mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya bral nas sman mo sgrub: bstan pa'i chos skyong bor nas yul lha 'bod: srid pa'i lha rabs bskyur nas shi 'dre brngan:

de yi rkyen gyis rang bzhin 'byung ba 'khrugs: yi dam lha zhal ri rab ngos la gzigs: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad ma rgyud bdud du 'bebs: chos skyong 'khu bas bstan sel phugs su gzhug: dgra lha 'khu bas rang mgo mi 'og 'chor: brtan ma 'khrugs pas 'bru bcud phyug g.yang nyams: yul lha 'khrugs pas gre bo rlung ltar 'tshubs: sa bdag 'khrugs pas dmar yams lhog rgod 'bebs: ma mo 'khrugs pas nad mug mtshon bskal dar: gza' dang rgyal po ma mo klu rnams 'khrugs: de tshe sngar nas med pa'i nad rims dang : mtshon gyi bskal pa dar zhing snang srid 'khrugs: steng 'khrugs 'og 'khrugs yul gru kun kyang 'khrugs: de yi rkyen gyis sems can bde skyid zad: sbas yul dben gnas rong bzhi ma gtogs pa: sdod pa'i gnas med bros sa'i yul yang dkon: dper na dar mtshon sbur mas g.yogs pa 'dra: lo re bzhin du dpyid kha'i rlan bzhin du: bdud sprul dmag rnams dbyar gtsang lta bur 'brub: ma 'ongs bod 'bangs sbal yul rong bzhi ru: blo gtad bgyis pas gnas skabs rkyen las grol: phyi 'byung bde sdug de yang rten 'brel gnad: ma yol 'grigs na chos srid bstan gnyis dar: rim par pad 'byung nga la gsol ba thob: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpang du tshugs: gzhi bdag sde brgyad rnams la bka' bsgo 'bog: rigs ldan grogs bcas rten 'brel ma 'chol gnad: dus tshod lung bstan gong 'og rnam gsum bstun: nges par dgos phyir the tshom bor la sgrubs: de yi cha rkyen gnas chen bgrod pa dang : lha srin gzhi bdag 'khu sogs bar chod rigs: zil gnon phyag brgya bzhi yis mthar byed pa: o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon sgrub thabs te: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab: ma 'ongs las can 'phrang las bgrod pa'i tshe: tsau ra rgol ba 'joms pa'i gnyen po ru: gsang rgya rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrom du sbas: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog:

ces gsungs pa bzhin/ sems can phrag dog dang nga rgyal las gyur pa'i chom po sogs bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba la/ bdag nyid kyi bgyi 'os? snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ drag pos rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa'i lte bar pad nyi dam sri gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rig pa hūm̐ gi mtshan par gyur/ de nyid yongs gyur dpal chen po: dmar nag gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ am gtsigs khro gnyer spyan rtsa 'khrugs: dbu la bdud 'dul sngags zhwa gsol: phyag g.yas rtse gsum klad la bskor: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsgril: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: dug sbrul nag po'i sku rags bcings: sked par gnam lcags phur bu 'chang : zung 'jug dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis zil gnon gar stabs can: khrag 'thung mngon spyod tshul du gsal: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum la rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog te thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon lha tshogs kyi rnam par nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/

snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung*/ 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pas sku che ba yan lag rags pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar 'bar ba'i/ snang srid kun na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sku mngon sum du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: dregs pa zil gnon 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya ldan: gtum gshe rngam dang rgod pa'i khro bos bskor: snang srid dbang du bsdus phyir gshegs su gsol: srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir gshegs su gsol: sde brgyad bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: ma mo las la mngag phyir gshegs su gsol: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bstan dgra cham la dbab phyir gshegs su gsol: sgos dgra thal bar brlag phyir gshegs su gsol: gcan 'phrang gdug pa gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: gzugs can gzugs med 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: dam can pho nya 'gyed phyir gshegs su gsol: chos skyong dgra la rbad phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ /

brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas/ mthar tshig don ngo sprod cing rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/

zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig /bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myang ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum por skye med kyi rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig /mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ dregs pa zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag srid gsum stobs 'dus sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dbang bskur ro: om̐ artsig nirtsig a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shar phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol:

khro bo chen po g.yul las rgyal ba yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ sum+bha rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gshin rje'i gshed thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po gshin rje'i gshed po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: oṃ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rta mgrin thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbyug pa sngon po thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ daṇ+ḍa dh+wika a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/

byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pas gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar nag gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ta a pa rā tsi ta bi dza ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa nī la daṇ+ḍa kro ta sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ka la he ka shrī kro ta karma raṃ raṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lam 'phrang gi bar gcod bigh+nān trig nan thar ni thar ni 'ching ya mi rgod dgra bo'i bla snying satwaṃ bha ya nan sum bha ni trig thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/

/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: thugs me long la brten nas brda bzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/

gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru drag po'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste yon tan gyi gtor ma la brten pas dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/
