/hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag pa gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas pa gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa shes pa sher dbang*/

ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dgu pa o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba'i le tshan no// // ༈ bcu pa/ o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs sems can zhe sdang las gyur pa'i: mtha' 'khob dmag dpung dbus su 'khrigs pa'i tshe: gtsug lag chos 'khor 'jig pas nyen gyur na: smug nag khro bo dbal gsham dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid dmod pa sngags pa'i chas su bzhugs: nga nyid sde brgyad dpung bcas gsal bar bskyed: dmag dpon rā hu la la gnyer byang gtad: bdud sde dpung 'joms mngon spyod gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum gyi lha: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i gzi byin can: 'bar ba'i rtsal bcu dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas: ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs mthar byed pa: mtha' 'khob zhe sdang gdug pa'i g.yul chen 'joms: hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor na: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jigs la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob:

nga nyid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dmag dpung hur thum bzlog par the tshom med: lha sras rgyal po'i thugs la de ltar chongs: snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can 'dul dka' yang : drag sngags mtshon chas mi shigs gang yang med: srid gsum ri rab rmang yang 'gyel nus na: skye 'gro phra mo sgrol la lta ci smos: bsad pa 'di ni rdo rje spu gri yin: bzlog pa 'di ni bar snang sgyogs chen yin: srung ba bya na rdo rje'i khrab ring yin: dmod pa bya na dug mda' rgyug 'gyel yin: rbad pa'i dus su pho nya glog zhags yin: 'bebs pa'i dus su thog mda' dbal 'gyed yin: de bas man ngag 'di la brtson pa dang : ma 'ongs de dus kho bo dus drug sgoms: spros pa chen po'i sgrub pa long med pas: spros med spros bcas cung tsam 'grel ba 'di: yang snying yin pas med thabs med do gsungs: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid

sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi snod rab 'jigs dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar bar gyur/ de las spro bsdu don gnyis byas/ /de nyid yongs gyur skad cig las/ /slob ma dpal chen he ru ka: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: gtum rngam klong du gsal bar bskyed: rdo rje thod phreng shān+tiṃ ghar+bha ni: dmod pa'i las chas dregs pa yongs kyi gtso: snying rje'i khros pas bdud bzhi bcom par byed: srid gsum srog bdag gshin rje khros pa'i tshul: sku mdog nag po dam nyams kun gyi gshed: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms pa'i gnod sbyin che: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu'i mtshon: rwa yi g.yas zur gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor: g.yon pas srog bdag khros pa'i lcags sdig ni: mgo dgu kha dgu rwa ni bco brgyad gzengs: sdig pa'i kha nas dug rlangs mtshon cha ni: gnam lcags las grub phur bu char du 'bebs: srid gsum phrin las kun 'dus tshul du gsal/ de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum la rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog te thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang khyad par lho nub rnga yab rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas/ rig 'dzin thod phreng drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas/

steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad drag sngags shān+tiṃ nag po rdo rje thod phreng lha tshogs kyi rnam par nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pas/ sku che ba yan lag rags pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar 'bar ba'i snang srid kun na/ che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sku mngon sum du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: gtum gshe rngam dang dgod pa'i khro bos bskor: drag sngags nag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /hor sog dmag dpung bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol/ /snang srid dbang du bsdus phyir gshegs su gsol: srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir gshegs su gsol: sde brgyad bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig /bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog:

om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myong ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ gtso bo stobs ldan he ru ka thogs la: hūm̐: khrag 'thung nag po stobs ldan he ru kaḥ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad spyi bor bya khyung brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan lha srin gtso bo'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e dza bh+yoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas shar phyogs lha'i sde dpon thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ a rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gshin rje thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ya rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ma mo thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: ma mo'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can:

deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ma rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bdud thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ du rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: shar lho sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar lho'i dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ru rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: btsan thogs la: hūm̐: lho nub sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: lho nub dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ tsa rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnod sbyin thogs la: hūm̐: nub byang sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub byang dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ sha rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: klu thogs la: hūm̐: byang shar sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang shar dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ nā rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gza' thogs la: hūm̐: steng phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gza' yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: steng phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ rā hu rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dam can thogs la: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: dam can dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol:

om̐ sā dhu rā dza a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur par shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/

/gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ yig nag po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hriḥshag ru rāṃ nā ga bh+rūm̐ mi hri ṭi ta hriḥke du a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rjes zlos byar gzhug /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: thugs me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas:

gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen gyi thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa'i ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs:

o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing*/ gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda'i bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

bcu pa o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ gsum pa/ phrin las bye brag gi skor/ gter gzhung las/ gsum pa phrin las so sor sgrub pa'i rten 'brel phyogs maid du 'char ba gnas dang ri sul 'grims pa: skal ldan las can chos dang 'phrad pa'i lung bstan smon lam gyis rgyud bskul ba'i cha lag zur gsal: thog mar lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer gyi lha tshom: gnyis pa gnas yul 'grims par bar du gcod pa mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba o rgyan rdo rje gro lod kyi lha tshom: gsum pa ting 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel du ma las mi g.yel ba o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi lha tshom: bzhi pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom dang bcas bzhi las/ thog mar bcu gcig pa/ o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i dbang ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyi/ phrin las sgrub pa o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyegs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs sems can chos la the tshom zh-ing : gsang sngags zab lam gnyan por smad pa yis: sbas yul srung mas 'khu zhing bka' chad 'bebs: lam log lam gol rkyen stobs che ba'i tshe: nyi ma 'od zer dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs: tshogs bskang rgyal brngan lha 'dre dam bsgrag bya: gser skyems brngan cha la sogs legs par bsgrengs: bro gar glu dbyangs dam bskang kho nar 'bad: rang nyid rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su spyod:

nga nyid nyi ma 'od zer cha lugs sgoms: nam mthongs phye zhing lha 'dres phrin las sgrub: sbas yul sgo 'byed rten 'brel bdun pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus yang snying 'dus pa las: byin rlabs bla ma'i dngos grub 'byin pa'i phyir: thugs rje'i 'od dkar gdul bya'i zhing du 'phros: 'dul zhing dgongs pas bod la smon lam mdzad: skye dgu rnams la chos kyi nyi ma shar: dngos grub zab mo rje 'bangs rnams la gnang : 'phel 'grib med pa nus pa'i rgyun thag sbrel: phangs pa med par gdams pa yi ger btab: nyams pa med pa'i rin chen gter du sbas: zad pa med pa'i dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa phog: mtshungs pa med par byams pas 'gro ba skyong : yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal gdams bcu gsum sogs: nam mkha'i rgya mtsho'i mdzod gling thams cad kun: lha sras rje dang rje 'bangs rnams la gdams: da lta spel ba'i dus min ma 'ongs par: stod kyi phyogs nas mu stegs nag po rdol: bar gyi phyogs nas man ngag nag po rdol: smad kyi phyogs nas mon te mug ti rdol: bar khams dbus phyogs rnam smin skye rgyal 'byung : du ru kha dang dur min dur 'dra gsum: du ru kha yi dus ni 'tshogs dus med: dur min dus su sdig spyod dbang po dar: chos pa'i gzugs brnyan dam log dge bshes tshogs: dur 'dra zhes pa dam sri du ru 'dod: re re la ni ra can khri phrag bskor: bdud kyi blo mthun satwa re'i so ltar 'grig: stod nas g.yo zhing mtha' nas dbus su 'khrugs: bar nas 'thab cing smad nas chu ltar khol: 'jig rten sa la bde ba skad cig med: sdug bsngal myong zhing nya mo gzan 'tshol 'dra: mthong yang mi dga' sdug bsngal phyi thag la: 'dod chags tshwa chu bzhin du nyer len 'khor: las ngan myong dgos bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: the tshom can dang skal med log lta mkhan: 'dug sa'i sa 'phrog 'gro ba'i lam yang gol:

skal med de la dben ri'i go skabs med: sdug bsngal thar med sna thag yun ring bsring : gcig rjes gcig slebs chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra: khyad par sbas gnas mi bgrod rnam pa gsum: blo sna bdud kyis bslu la las 'phro med: phyug po nor phyir 'brangs la las 'phro med: gsang sngags gshe skur mkhan la las 'phro med: 'phro mtha' yod pa'i skal ldan rnam pa gsum: 'di phyi pad 'byung khyed shes las 'phro yod: 'khor ba phyi phyag 'tshal la las 'phro yod: smon lam bzang pos rgyas thebs las 'phro yod: las 'phro dge bas mthud cig rje 'bangs rnams: ma 'ongs smon lam dbang gis gter 'byin tshe: sa rtags lung bstan 'di ltar shar ba'i tshe: lo zlar mi 'da' gter 'byin rten 'brel sgrigs: gter kha phyes nas skal ldan mang po la: spel nas 'gro ba yongs la go bar gyis: ma 'ongs blo rmongs 'ch-ing bas yang yang grol: bshad pa'i tshig kyang go bar rag las pas: 'bad par i byos 'di phyi'i don la gnyer: long med blo sna btung dgos dus gcig go: kha dkar gting srin can la blo ma 'dri: g.yo can khrel med grogs kyi ngo ma srungs: 'khri ba mjug mthud can gyi zas ma za: rang mthong khengs sems can la dam ma sbrel: mi 'grub kha po can la re ma bca': gdams ngag nor 'dod can la dpe ma bstan: zob po mi chos mkhan la kha ma gtam: gdams ngag g.yo sgyu can la chos ma 'chad: dred po phyi bshol mkhan la gnad ma bslab: grogs ngan mi yi rgya ma yin pa'i phyir: snying gtam mi bya shi ba'i ro la sbos: rten 'brel lam ni chos mthun byed las rnams: mi la mi bshad bdud dbang shor dag 'ga': snga phyi med par mi rgod gcig rgyug bzhin: gang 'grigs legs nyes de thog yo lang sbyor: skyid shog sdug shog pad 'byung khyed rang shes: kha gting med pa'i skyo bas nga la bos: the tshom med na bdag gis bslu mi 'gyur: da lta nas bzung snga phyir 'byung gyur kun:

gang 'dul der ston tshigs bcad zhal gdams 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i brda ru thob: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub ā thaṃ rgya: ma 'ongs las can bu la sprod cing gnyer: gza' klu rgyal po khyed rnams tha tshig skyongs: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyi mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gdod nas rnam par dag pa 'og min pad+ma drwa ba'i zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig dmar ser 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de nyid gnas gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /rang nyid rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer ni/ /dmar ser bram gzugs he ru ka yi chas: khro 'dzum nyams ldan phyed skyil rol stabs can: rus rgyan stag sham phyag g.yas nyi zer bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs la 'khril ba'i yum: bde chen dpa' mo 'od zer can ma ni: dmar mo khro gnyer rnam rol zim bu'i mdangs: skra grol thor tshugs lhag mas sku rgyab khebs: rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan na ra ra: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas me long 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan dang rin chen phreng bas spras: zung 'jug zhabs gnyis bde chen yab la 'khyud: yab yum sku la ye shes gzi 'bar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum la rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/

hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ slob dpon gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dag pa'i zhing dang*/ khyad par rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer 'khor rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ gnam sa bar snang sa gzhi thams cad nas kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te/ mtsho chen po la char bab pa bzhin khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas/ rdo rje ye shes btsan thabs su skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /tshig bdun rjes/ gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyams pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung :

bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul mtshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig /bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myong ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ nyi ma 'od zer yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: dmar gsal tsha zer zhags pa'i 'od 'byin pa: khro gnyer gtum mo zung 'jug sku la 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer dbang bskur ro: om̐ sūr+ya rasmis a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags kyus nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma:

mda' dar me long zhags pas nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags sgrog nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long dril bus nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bhan+dha thogs la/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang :

lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par/ thod pa zlum po'i nang du bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas gyur par shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar ser gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med:

o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i/ me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ /deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag:

rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe:

kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda yi bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa/ phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs:

mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bcu gcig pa o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bcu gnyis pa o rgyan yi dam lha ni/ yang khyed rang rnams la gnas yul 'grims pa'i bar du gcod pa mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba o rgyan rdo rje gro lod kyi/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams las/ ma 'ongs rin chen gter la spyod pa'i tshe: thog mar yar tshes dge ba'i dus nyid du: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor legs par bshams: skal ldan rig ma bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: rang nyid he ru ka yi cha lugs 'chang : rang nyid bde chen dpa' bo yab yum sgoms: rten 'brel sna tshogs bgyis pas phun tshogs gyur: zhal gdams gter gyi lde mig dang po'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ yid bzhin nor mchog bde gshegs kun 'dus la: rnal 'byor gang zhig gter la spyod pa'i tshe: sde brgyad cho 'phrul mi min 'jigs pa dang : mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya mi phyed yi mug tshe: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: nga nyid yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: legs par gdams so nga yi rjes 'jug rnams: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas yul 'grims pa'i bar du gcod pa mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba o rgyan rdo rje gro lod kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbabs pa'i skabs/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ drag po'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lte bar pad nyi rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rig pa hūm̐ dmar nag gis mtshan par gyur/ de nyid yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /pad nyi'i gdan la stag mo grus ma'i steng : dmar nag dbang sdud rdo rje gro bo lod: he ru ka pa'i rnam 'gyur 'gying stabs can: rgyan drug gtum nyams dpa' bo dpa' ba'i chas: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu gdeng : sdigs mdzub rtse la sdig pa'i sprul pa 'gyed: spyi bor rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbyings phyug gsang ye dang bcas gsal bar bsgom: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir pad 'dab rim pa bzhin: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: rang mdog khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: phyag g.yas so so'i phyag mtshan mda' dar bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar gyi nyams ldan bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum la rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par 'og min pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang*/ laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i pho brang nas che btsan khro bo gtum chen g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi lha tshogs/

rig 'dzin grub thob bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad kyang dag pa lha'i phyag rgyar sad pa'i gsang ba gsum las/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/

tshig bdun rjes/ hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i pho brang nas: che btsan khro bo gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams/ gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas:

pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying po gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin/ gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang*/ lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myong ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral du mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/

/de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par/ so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ yi dam gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: dmar nag stag zhon spyi bor thod phreng brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan yi dam lha yi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kro ta lo ka sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rdo rje rig ma thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags kyu'i lde mig zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rin chen rig ma thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen rin chen rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zhags pa'i lde mig rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen pad+ma'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags sgrog lde mig dbang gi las mdzod cig: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen las kyi rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dril bu'i lde mig drag po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa:

skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de/ byang chub kyi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du/ bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dmar nagamathar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma rā dza pā shaṃ sa mā ya dza mūm̐ bud+dha ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ ke kā+au ri pad+ma mu ṭa rā ga he sha ḍāk+ki nī pā shaṃ sarba thun thun dza dza swā hā: /phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/

tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med par nyams su myong bzhin du/ brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten:

'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ rang snang du shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ka tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā:

a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing*/ gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda yi bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa/ phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bcu gnyis pa o rgyan yi dam lha'i dbang bskur gyi le tshan no// // ༈ bcu gsum pa/ o rgyan dpa' bo ging ni/

yang khyed rang rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel dus las mi g.yel ba/ o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la de'ang*/ gsol 'debs las/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: ces dang*/ zhal gdams la/ ma 'ongs sems can phrag dog las gyur pas: mtha' bzhi dbus 'khrugs bod 'bangs sil bur 'thor: skyabs med sems can bar do ci bzhin du: sbas yul nags khrod dben ri 'grim pa'i tshe: dpa' bo 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dkyil 'khor bzhengs: gar ging dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i chas su zhugs: rten 'brel ji srid rdzas kun tshags su bcug: nga nyid rig 'dzin kun 'dus ngo bor sgoms: dgu 'grigs lnga 'grigs sum 'gṛgs rgyan gyis spras: dben ri sbas gnas mthun rkyen drug pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum lha: ye shes rol pa dbyer med nam mkha'i khyon: gang 'dul der ston mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung : ma 'ongs dus su thugs rje'i nyi ma shar: rang byung bla ma'i zhal gdams gsol 'debs ni: gang phyir snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus kyi tshe: mtha' 'khob dmag gis bod 'bangs hab shar spyod: de dus sbas yul ma gtogs bde skyid zad: ma 'ongs sems can sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe: o rgyan sbas yul rnams la blo gtad 'chang : bsags pa'i tha ma zad long med par 'phrog: skyes pa'i tha ma shi long med par gsod: bros pas bgrod long med par rting nas slebs: dag gtsang bshad long med par khrims la sbyar: sbrang tshang nang du me 'obs 'khyil ba bzhin: dbang med las kyi dmag gis gtum zhing 'ded: skyabs med rngon pas ri dwags ded pa bzhin:

sa btsan rdzong mkhar rang mgo bskor ba'i rgyu: lo re bzhin du bar do'i ngo sprod bzhin: dmyal ba mngon sum bkod bzhin rang thog slebs: de bas dben pa'i ri la blo gtad gyis: zhes dang*/ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa 'grim pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs pas lam bkag nas: stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'jigs pa brgyad kyis nye bar 'tshe ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid dpa' bau ging dang srung ma bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: legs par gdams so lha sras rje 'bangs rnams: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyus yid la bcag: ces gsungs pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel dus las mi g.yel ba/ o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la/ bdag nyid sogs/ snga ma ltar sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbabs pa'i skabs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod rnam par dag pa 'og min pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de nyid yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su/ pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: rgyal po'i cha lugs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje mkhar gdengs thabs shes bhan+dha bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mo brten mdzad 'gying bag can: g.yas g.yon bde chen dbang phyug yum chen gnyis: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang bcas: snang la ma 'dres 'ja' tshon dkyil 'khor ltar: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum la rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/

āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ sku gsum pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas bla ma snang srid zil gnon rig 'dzin grub thob bde gshegs rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun rjes/ gnas mchog?stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya rā rā rā rā: tsa la ya tsa la ya hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a dzhaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ / brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: de'ang*/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdul tshon me long bum pa dang*/ /gtor ma la sogs rdzas dag la/ /brten nas mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bskur na/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi de nyid mchog /bzhi pa'i de nyid dbang bzhi thob/ ces dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dbang thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa de nyid sgrub par byed pa/ de ltar bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas lnga po re re bzhin gnas gsum du bzhag nas mthar tshig don ngo sprod de/ rim bzhin dbang ba'i bdag nyid can du bskur na rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ zhes mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar bum dbang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog:

om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing khrus byas pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing bum chu myong ba gsang dbang*/ snying gar bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ sems nyid spros bral mtshon pa'i bum pa zlum po skye med du rtogs pa don dam mtshon byed kyi chus bkang ste bskur bas/ dug gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dag par shes pa sher dbang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye ba ni bzhi pa ste/ lus lha skur smin byed sku bum pa la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /de nas sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par so so'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas lha sku so so'i byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ thog mar o rgyan snang srid zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: skye 'chi gnyis spangs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje'i lus la gzhom zhig bral ba'i sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo ging gi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu ru au ḍī ya na ging ka ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: mā ra ti kar tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: 'ja' lus nam mkha'i dbang phyug dpa' mo yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog tu brnyes par shog: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ye shes mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: zab gsang 'khor lo'i dbang mo yid bzhin gter: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rtag tu gsang sngags rgyun gyis phyug par shog: om̐ dz+nyā na dzi wan mu ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dpa' bo thogs la:

hūm̐: bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo rnam par sprul: bde chen rig 'dzin dbang bsgyur mkha' la shar: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpa' bo rgya mtsho mchog gi ded dpon shog: om̐ tshan+dha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen cha shas mdzes byed yid 'phrog rigs: brda 'gros mkha' la 'gyu ba'i gar stabs can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zab lam bde ba'i rtse dgar rol bar shog: om̐ ma hā mu tra la hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gar ma'i dbang ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mdzes ma'i cha shas rdzogs: bde ba'i rol rtsed dga' ba'i dpal yon can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der thob shog: om̐ ḍāk+ki pad+ma mu ṭa hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ging thogs la: hūm̐: rgod pa'i nyams kyis dpa' ba'i mdangs chags g.yo: dga' ma'i bzhin 'dzin zil bus yid rab phyung : deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bcu drug khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dga' ston shog: om̐ dha sha ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: deng phyin chad snang ba'i chos thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i snang stong lha'i 'khor lor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsung gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: yang bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/

lha yab yum sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas brgyud de byang chub kyi sems lhan cig tu skyes pa'i ye shes/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod de dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing bum gsang shes rab ngo sprod pa ni/ sems chos nyid thig le nyag gcig tu mtshon par thod pa zlum po'i nang du/ bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa ste/ thod pa la brten pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bzhi thob pa yin no/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ dkar gsal mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: om̐ dha sha gṝ wa ging ka ra sarba tshin+dha tshin+dha ya hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭḥ phyin chad brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes:

bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ snang stong dbyer med chos dbyings yum gyi chu skyes mtshon pa'i me long sin+dhu ra'i thig le dang bcas gnas gsum du bzhag cing ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ me long dang sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu thogs la: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar me long*/ spyi mgrin snying khar bzhag cing thig le byas pas bum gsang shes rab/ tshig don ngo sprod pa ni/ chos dbyings skye med mtshon pa'i me long zlum po/ rang byung bde chen thig les brgyan pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bde stong zung 'jug dga' bzhi skyes par shes pa shes rab/ gnyis med zung 'jug rig stong gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa ni bzhi pa ste/ me long la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob bo/ thugs 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i spros pa thams cad rang rig skad cig ma'i rang rtsal du ngo shes par byas la/ sems kyi gshis stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs rig rtsal du lam me/ de gnyis dbyer med pa nyams su myong bzhin du brjod bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du 'dzin med la mnyam par zhog mdzod/

deng phyin chad khams gsum gyi rnam rtog gi 'jug ldang thams cad rig stong dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ gtor snod dbyings kyi bhan+dhar gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa ye shes lnga las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang shar ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ tshig don ngo sprod pa'i dbang thob par mos/ gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par bzhag cing gtor zan myong ba gsang dbang*/ thugs kar gtad la gtor ma zlum po spros pa dang bral ba gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med ro mnyam du shes pa sher dbang*/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pa bzhi pa yon tan gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su thob pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas:

gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p phrin las dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gi slad du/ sku gzugs de nyid chos dbyings skye ba med pa las rang snang du shar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i gang 'dul sprul pa'i sprin phung mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i ye shes kyi skur gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du bzhag cing gdung ba'i blos thugs dam bskul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku 'bag ye shes kyi skur gsal te/ spyi bor bzhag pa bum dbang*/ mgrin par gsang dbang*/ thugs kar bzhag ste bla ma rang sems su ngo sprod pa/ sems nyid stong gsal rig stong 'dus ma byas shing gdod nas sku bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mtshon byed sku 'bag gi dbang bskur bas/ rang rig gdod nas 'ching grol dang bral ba 'di/ mtshon bya don gyi bla mar ye nas 'pho 'gyur dang bral bar bzhugs mod kyi/ rnam 'gyur glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang phyir mtshon byed brda yi bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par shes pa sher dbang*/ ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni dbang bzhi pa 'gro 'dul phrin las rab 'byams su grub pa phrin las sku 'bag la brten pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin no/ /hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/

de ltar o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi smin byed kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung sdom gyi 'dun pa drag pos 'di'i rjes mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni tshogs la rol zhing*/ lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod spyi chings ltar shes par bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa o rgyan dpa' bo ging gi dbang bskur gyi le tshan no/ /de dag gi thugs sgrub bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i le tshan bcu gsum so so'i dbang bskur grub pa yin no// // spros pa bya bar mos na dbang chen ltar re re la dbang bzhi dang*/ yang na mtha' rten rgyas spros ltar sbyar bas chog ces rtsa tho ru gsungs pa bzhin sbyar rung*/ yang yongs rdzogs lhan du bskur ba'i mtha' rten gcig gis chog par gsungs pa bzhin bder 'dus dbang chen ltar rtags rdzas sogs spyi dang bye brag la sbyar bas kyang chog la 'dir cung zad 'bring po'i dbang du byas so// // ༈ bcu bzhi pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom chos skyong srog gtad kyi rim pa ni/ thog mar bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor mchod bsham dang*/ chos skyong sde lnga'i gsol mchod bskang gtor bcas bsham pa'i mdun du/

chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa dang gser skyems bcas 'du byas la/ dngos gzhi gong gnon yi dam gang rung sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed chos skyong gi gtor mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas mngon rtogs sgom pa ni/ om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam che mchog drag po he ru ka gsal ba'i mdun du khrag zhag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing phyur ba mi ro rta ro'i lbu ba lang ling du 'phyo ba: de'i dbus su srid pa'i ri rab gru bzhi pa: de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa: sku che zhing yan lag rags pa: thung zhing sbom la gsus pa rgyas pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gri gug dang bhan+dha: 'og mas ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa: zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs shing dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas dang ldan pa: de'i pang du 'khyud pa'i yum tsaṇ+ḍi ma dmar mos gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa: yab yum bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po gdong bzhi phyag drug pa: bram ze'i gzugs can sogs yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med par gsal bar bskyed do: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la kā li dz+nyā na dhe wa gha na gu h+ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su dgra bgegs pho mo gdan du bting ba'i steng du: yi ge he dang ru mtshon las skyes pa'i dpal bdud kyi mgon po ma hā kā la sku mdog mthing nag seṅge rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can: sku la dar nag gi phod kha dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa: g.yas ru mtshon nag po mkha' la 'phyar zhing : g.yon thod pa'i nang du dmar nag dbal gyi gtor ma dgra la 'phen pa: stag ral dang gzig shubs ral gris brgyan pa:
