swag lham gsol zhing bdud rta nag po rlung gshog la chibs pa: de'i g.yon du bh+yo las bdud mo seng gdong ma sku mdog dmar mo dar dmar gyi phod kha gsol zhing : g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa: btsan rta dmar zhur la chibs pa: yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i 'khor du sprul pa'i las mkhan spre'u gdong can gnyis: shar du lha: lho ru btsan rgod: nub tu ma mo: byang du dge bsnyen: mtshams bzhir bdud: gza': dgra lha: dam can la sogs pa myur mgyogs can dang : gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras par bskyed do: lho ru dug mtsho khol ma'i dbus su yi ge ra dang ral gri las skyes pa'i drang srong gza' bdud nag po sku mdog dud kha zhal dgu bya rog gi dbu dang bcu: phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spu gri dang chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan: 'og ma gnyis ra yi mda' gzhu 'gengs shing sbrul zhags 'dzin pa: sku smad dug sbrul nag po rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba: sku lus thams cad spyan stong gis gtams pa: de'i g.yon du yum klu mo khrag mig mas nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa: yab yum rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: shar du zla ba: lho ru spen pa: nub tu nyi ma: byang du phur bu: mtshams bzhir lhag pa: pa sangs: mig dmar: sgra gcan: gzhan yang gdong mo mched bzhi: las kyi klu mo rigs brgyad: nye 'khor sa bdag dang bcas pa bskyed do: nub tu byad ma mi ro rta ro bsnol mar brtsegs pa'i dbus su yi ge tsa dang beng chen las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po sku mdog dmar po: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa'i ya so yis ma mchu mnan pa: sku la dar dmar gyi za ber gsol zhing bswe khrab bswe rmog ru mtshon gyis brgyan te: phyag g.yas pas tsan dan gyi beng chen dang : g.yon pas ru mtshon dang zhags dmar 'dzin pa:

sku la stag ral gzig shubs ral gris mdzes pa: rta rag pa rting dkar la zhon cing myur mgyogs shan pa chen po'i las su chas pa'o: shar du lha: lho ru klu: nub tu sman mo: byang du yak+ṣa: mtshams bzhir sprul pa: za byed: gsod byed: sgrol byed: las byed kyi bshan pa bzhi yang sprul dang bcas pa gsal ba'o: byang du snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'chi thams cad kyis 'byung ba 'khrugs pa dang ma 'khrug pa'i rlung dbang du phyam pa: na bun 'tshub mar gtibs pa'i dbus su yi ge ru dang 'khar bsil ri rab kyi bkod pas brgyan pa las: sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po ging ha ra dpe dkar dkor bdag bstan pa'i bya ra ba chen po: sku mdog dkar smug rgyas pa'i zhal can: dbu la bswe chen gyi theb gsol zhing dar dkar po dang za 'og gi go zu gsol ba: phyag na 'khar bsil dang lcags kyi lhung phor byad ma sdang zhing gdug pa can rnams kyi snying khrag dang tsit+tas bkang ba: chibs su seṅge dkar mo la zhon cing dkor cha'i gnyer kha 'tsho bar gsal ba'o: shar du dpe har shel ging : lho ru tshangs pa shel ging : nub tu li byin shel ging : byang du dpe har shel ging : mtshams bzhir dpe nag shing bya dpe dmar gnam lha dang bzhi ste thams cad kyang mngon spyod dang ldan pa: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul dang bcas pa gsal snang sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba lta bur gsal zhing bskyed do: de'i phyi rol du rin chen gter gyi rgya rin po che bsrung ba la dbang ba'i sprul pa nyid sprul gzhan yang sha za khrag 'thung las byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mar gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swā: gsang bar hā: las byed du bh+yoḥ sprul pa ru phaṭḥ nyid sprul du dzaḥ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bstan pa'i bya ra ba gnyan po chos skyong ba'i srung ma drag rtsal dang ldan pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs:

om̐ badz+ra shrī ma hā kā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ki kang shu la tsa tri ging ka ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa du pra ma ma hā raṃ ata tsi ta a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rnga dang rkang gling drag por 'bod pa'i dbyangs sna tshogs bgyi la: hūm̐: dur khrod ming ni nges su gang zhig bca': 'dzam gling 'di ru stobs bcus mnga' bsgyur ba'i: sa mtshams 'gog pa'i dmigs su ma mchis pa: tshangs pa'i yul nas sdong po'i gling 'jug pa: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi gshegs su gsol: thabs shes mkha' la rol pa'i tshul 'chang ma: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang las su sprul pa'i lha: ye shes mgon po lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'dzam gling 'jig rten tsā ri'i gnas: g.ya' gangs lhun snyogs nags tshal sprin ltar gtibs: ma mo mngon rgyu sha za lang long rgyug: de 'dra'i pho brang dbang sgyur nag po cher: bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dug mtsho nag po'i rba rlabs phyur ma 'khyil: stong gsum 'di ru 'gyu ba'i drag rtsal can: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang gnam lcags 'od po che: thog ser rngam klong 'gyu ba'i las byed pa: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i gling : mchong dmar 'gyings pa'i pho brang khang bzang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun mthu bo che: mngon spyod mdzad tshe bshan pa'i tshul bzung ba: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i pho brang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas: dbang phyug lha yi gzhal med lta bu'i khyim: 'dzam gling dkor mdzod spungs pa'i pho brang nas: skye 'gro dbang sgyur las byed dkar smug zhal: sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can srung ma drag rtsal can: gter la dbang zhing sngags kyi bstan pa srung : bka' yi las byed mthu ldan ma lus dang :

sprul pa yang sprul las byed la sogs pa: chos skyong yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: om̐ e h+ya hi shrī nā tha ma hā kā la singha mu kha ki kang shu la ya ging ka ra sarba dharma pā la ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya dung dung thun thun phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes chos skyong 'khor bcas sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas rten dang pho brang la bzhugs par bsam: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla pad+ma ro yi gdan: bdud dgra bgegs srin tshar gcod gdan steng du: bstan pa'i bya ra myur mgyogs dam can rnams: chos 'khor gtsug lag gnyan po skyong ba'i phyir: phrin las thogs med bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs: om̐ sa ma ya dharma pā la ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gtor ma sman raka gis bran: mchod pa kha gso zhing gsur btang : dri zhim kyang bsreg: rol mo dang dbyangs shin tu snyan par bya: hūm̐: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gdug pa'i dam nyams byad ma bsgral ba yi: mig dang rna ba sna dang lce snying sogs: bsam gyis mi khyab ri ltar spungs pa 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: hūm̐: mi sha rta sha glang chen ba glang sha: khyi sha la sogs sha chen sna tshogs bsregs: gzhan yang rdzas rgod ngar ldan sbyar spos 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: hūm̐: rkang mar zhag dang til mar sbyar ba la: ro ras shi skra dkris pa'i sdong bus gtams: sbar ba'i sgron me 'tshubs pa'i 'od 'gengs 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod:

om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: hūm̐: dug khrag thang khrom gu gul sbyar ba yi: ngar ldan rba rlabs nag po gyen du phyur: rgyu khrag la sogs mkhris pa'i dri chab 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: 'bru nag ngar phye gri khrag sbags pa'i zan: dmar nag dpal ldan sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: zhag gi bcud g.yo 'khyil zhing phyur ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi phyag rgya lnga: rdza rnga rnga zlum drag po'i shing gi rnga: 'brug ltar ldir ba'i rnga chen rol mo 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra shab+da swā hā: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang yig 'bru lnga: 'od zhu sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i rdzas mchog 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: gtor snod drag po yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams kyi sha dang khrag: klad rus rkang dang nang rol khu ba bcas: ri ltar spungs pa'i dgra sha khrag mchod 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bum ril mtshan ldan snod mchog ka pā lar: ma rungs byad ma rnams kyi snying khrag gtams: rlabs chen 'phyur ba'i rak+ta 'bar ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul:
bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi:

de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che mchog lhag pa'i lhar gyur nag po che: 'jigs byed stobs ldan khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal byed phyag bzhi pa: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha bsnams shing dpa' ba'i chas: dur khrod bdag mo tsaṇ+ḍir zung 'jug 'khril: che ba'i 'khor bcas gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal: ma rungs 'joms mdzad ye shes mgon po'i tshogs: bka' sdod srung mar bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: pho brang chen po tsā ri'i gnas kyi bdag: legs ldan sras po bdud mgon seṅge'i gdong : mngon spyod las mdzad rta nag rting dkar zhon: mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen ma rungs dgra la 'phen: bdud mo'i yum bcas dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: za gsod las mdzad pho nya 'bum dang bcas: zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lho nub mun rum 'khrigs pa dug mtsho'i klong : me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa'i lha: srog bdag nag po srin lus sbrul mjug can: gnam lcags thog mda' dam nyams dgra la 'bebs: khrag mig yum chen glog gi zhags pa can: gza' brgyad 'khor bcas gdong mo las la 'gyed: ki kang nag po dbyings kyi las byed pa: drang srong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i mkhar: mchong dmar dgra la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun srin po'i gzugs: btsan rgod 'bar ba myur mgyogs 'dzam gling nyul: lus la go khrab mtshon cha dmag gter thogs: rta mchog rag pa chibs shing sprul pa 'gyed: dgra bo rtsad brlag bshan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: bstan pa srung ba'i las byed mthu bo che: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs las grub 'phrul lding khang : za 'og sna tshogs bkram pa'i pho brang dbus: skye 'gror mnga' dbang sgyur mdzad dkar smug zhal:

dar dkar lhub gsol 'khar bsil lhung bzed thogs: sder chags zil gnon seṅge dkar mo zhon: mthu ldan las byed phrin las sde bzhi 'gyed: sku gsung thugs sprul sa gzhi'i rdul ltar 'gengs: chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed gter gyi bdag: mthu rtsal rmad byung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: phrin las bzhi ldan bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: gsang sngags gnyan gyi chos 'khor skyong byed pa'i: gter srung yongs rdzogs tshogs la bdag bstod do: bsnyen dmigs ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba mthing nag g.yas bskor du 'khor bar/ bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer phog pas thugs rgyud rab tu bskul nas ci 'dod pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrubs par gyur/ gong gnon gyi sngags ci nus mthar/ om̐ shrī ma hā kā la kā li dz+nyā na dhe wa gha na gu h+ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra shrī ma hā kā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ki kang shu la tsa tri ging ka ra yak+sha rak+sha du pra ma ma hā raṃ ata tsi ta a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mchod bstod mdor bsdus ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ? sogs dang*/ sngon tshe o rgyan chen po? sogs kyis bstod/ khrus dang bgegs bskrad pa srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa rnams dkyus ltar bya/ lo rgyus 'khyogs mtshams ni/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ bka' phur gshin gsum sogs mang du mchis pa las/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' phur thugs gsum thun min gyi bstan srung chos skyong drag po sde lnga'i bka' gtad sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/

de'i lo rgyus cung zad snyan du gsol na/ nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi zhal snga nas/ rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong dgongs 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ 'dir gtso bo ye shes kyi mgon po zhes bya ba ma bcos gdod nas rang byung he ru ka'i rigs/ don la thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid yin yang rnam pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sprul pa gang la gang 'dul de la der ston gyi cho 'phrul/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung yongs kyi rgyal po/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa de'i bka' 'khor zhing skyong ghā ya dhā ra/ gza' mchog rā hu la/ gnod sbyin me 'od gdong can/ dkor bdag rgyal po dpe har sogs bstan srung dam can sde lnga zhes/ bka' srung 'dus pa phrin las myur mgyogs mngon spyod rtsol med du 'byin pa la ches cher bsngags shing*/ rig 'dzin grub pa yongs kyi phrin las kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i chos skyong sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ bka' gtad zhu ba'i yon du thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas bla ma dpal he ru ka dngos su gsal ba la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla med gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag nyid: deng nas mgon pos bka' gnang stsol: dam las mi 'da' sa ma ya: dam tshig 'bog phyir rdo rje mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni gsang ba'i dam tshig chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung rdo rje dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam tshig dran par gyis: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod:

oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: bla ma dpal chen po skyabs yul rgya mtsho mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar snying po'i bsags sbyang yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pas mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ de nas srog dbang gi ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam che mchog drag po he ru kar gsal ba'i mdun du/ khrag zhag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing phyur bar mi ro rta ro'i lbu ba lang ling du 'phyo ba: de'i dbus su srid pa'i ri rab gru bzhi pa: de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa: sku che zhing yan lag rags pa: thung zhing sbom la gsus pa rgyas pa: phyag g.yas g.yon gyis dang pos gri gug dang bhan+dha: 'og mas ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa: zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs shing dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas dang ldan pa: de'i pang du 'khyud pa'i yum tsaṇ+ḍi ma dmar mos gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa yab la 'khyud pa: yab yum bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir shar du zhing skyong mgon po/ lho ru gza' mchog rā hu la/

nub tu gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ byang du rgyal po pe ha ra/ de dag gis sprul 'khor yang sprul dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ de ltar du gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swā: gsang bar hā: las byed du bh+yoḥ sprul pa ru phaṭḥ nyid sprul du dzaḥ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bstan pa'i bya ra ba gnyan po chos skyong ba'i srung ma drag rtsal dang ldan pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra shrī ma hā kā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ki kang shu la tsa tri ging ka ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa du pra ma ma hā raṃ ata tsi ta a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rnga dang rkang gling drag por 'bod pa'i dbyangs sna tshogs bgyi la: hūm̐: dur khrod ming ni nges su gang zhig bca': 'dzam gling 'di ru? sogs nas 'khor skyong byed pa'i: gter srung yongs rdzogs tshogs la bdag bstod do: sogs spyan 'dren nas bzhugs gsol mchod pa bstod pa'i mthar/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam tshig ldan pa'i lha: deng 'dir sngags 'chang sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: bskyed rim ma gsal rdzogs rim ma rtogs dang : bzlas brjod grangs nyung mchod rdzas g.yel ba dang : phud lhag 'dres shing dus kyi mchod pa chag: dam bca' dor bas nus mthu nyams pa dang : mngon spyod rtsal chung dgra bgegs ma bsgral sogs: le lo btang snyoms g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur nas: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya shwa dha ya shwa dha bi shwa dha ni sa pā ri bi shwa dha na dharma pā la sarba shud+dhe ye swā hā: yig brgya sogs kyis bshags// // ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ byad ma'i yar rtse rang byung snod mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas bstan dgrskad cig nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ sogs nas gser skyems gshegs/ mdun bskyed 'od du zhu nas gtor ma dang gnyis su med par gyur/

gtor ma bdud rtsis bran zhing tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ kyai/ dgongs shig dam can srung ma rnams/ /dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /dam la gnas shing lha la 'khreng*/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang*/ /gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang*/ /dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /gza' brgyad gdong mo mched de bzhi/ /btsan rgod shan pa mi zan dang*/ /chos skyong ging gi rgyal po che/ /gzhan yang gnas gter srung ma rnams/ /ma thogs ma thogs myur du gshegs/ /sngon tshe pad 'byung spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam tshig mi dran nam/ /dam bca'i dus 'di da lags pas/ /'bod pa'i dus su snyan ma sra/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma zhan/ /dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ a mṛ ta sa ma ya ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ bdud rtsi gtor zhing rdo rjes bsdig: dam tshig rjes su dran zhing phrin las grub par bsam: de nas bka' srung sde lnga'i gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: bstan pa'i las mdzad phyag bzhi pa: mgon chen sde lnga bya rog gdong : zhing skyong legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : gza' mchog btsan rgod me 'od gdong : tshangs pa dge bsnyen ging ka ra: klu rgyal dge bsnyen chen po bcas: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : gter srung mchims phu'i brag btsan sogs: bka' yi tha tshig gnyer ba yis: dkyil 'khor 'di yi bya ra mdzod: dam chos 'di yi bstan pa skyongs: slob bu 'di yi rogs dan sgrubs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud skyongs: dam nyams log lta bdud kyi rigs: skal med lag tu ma shor bar: rgya 'di srung ba'i mel tshe ru: de ring slob bur bka' gtad pas: rtag tu dus mchod brtson pa yi: phrin las sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod:

oṃ dharma pā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: zhes gtso bo dang de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i bka'i sde brgyad kyi srog gtad bye brag tu bya na/ sde brgyad 'dus pa'i gtor ma lag tu gtad pa'am sde dpon so so'i gzugs gtad cing dam tshig sbrel la dam chu'ang sbyin/ 'di rnams phal cher dregs pa yin pas rang nyid rtogs dgongs dang mi ldan na khe nyen che bas kun la sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de nas shar phyogs lha'i sde dpon thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lha yi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: a sa ma ya na ra kan: gshin rje thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gshin rje dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: ya sa ma ya na ra kan: ma mo thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: ma mo'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: ma mo dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: ma sa ma ya na ra kan: bdud thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: bdud kyi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: du sa ma ya na ra kan: rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: shar lho'i sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rgyal po dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: ru sa ma ya na ra kan: btsan thogs la: hūm̐: lho nub sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: btsan gyi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog:

tsa sa ma ya na ra kan: gnod sbyin thogs la: hūm̐: nub byang sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gnod sbyin dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: sha sa ma ya na ra kan: klu thogs la: hūm̐: byang shar sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: klu yi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: na sa ma ya na ra kan: gza' thogs la: hūm̐: steng phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gza' yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: gza' yi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: rā hu la sa ma ya na ra kan: dam can thogs la: hūm̐: 'og phyogasasde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: dam can dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dam can dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: oṃ sā dhū rā dza sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ ho/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du nges don snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las kyi nyin byed ji srid kyi bar du mi nub pa'i gnyer kha blangs shing*/ bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dam pa'i chos skyong yongs kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po/ yum mchog 'dod khams dbang phyug /zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan/ gza' rgod dug gi spu gri/ btsan rgod me 'od gdong can/ dkor bdag dpe har chen po sogs chos skyong drag po sde lnga sprul pa yang sprul 'jig rten dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po brgyad/ bka' sdod mngag gzhug pho nya dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro/ sprul sku mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad/

o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje nas rtsa ba'i bla ma sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa rnams kyi bka' dang*/ dam la ma 'da' bar dam tshig gi rim par rjes su dgongs la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ mdzad phrin spel/ bstan pa rin po cher rim gro dang bkur sti bcas te bla nas bla ru spel cig /sems can gyi phan bde spel/ 'jigs rten gyi rgud pa sol/ snod bcud kyi legs tshogs skyed/ gdug can gyi gnya' nas non/ dam can gyi sdong grogs gyis/ dam med kyi dbang po snubs/ thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba sgrubs shig khyad par du rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid dam/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di khyed la gtad kyis lus dang grib ma bzhin srungs shig /ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phyi yi dgra/ nang gi bgegs/ gsang ba'i bar du gcod pa thams cad las srungs shig /mdun nas bsus shig /rgyab nas skyor cig /'gal rkyen dang g.yol cig /mthun rkyen dang sprod cig /gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul ma nus na gang dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las drag pos tshar chod cig /sdang ba'i dgra sod/ gnod pa'i bgegs chom/ bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog bsam pa sgrubs re ba skongs/ tshe srings dpal skyed/ rgyags mthud/ phyi yi tshe bsod/ nang gi nyams rtogs/ gsang ba'i ye shes dang yon tan ma lus pa gong nas gong du spel nas/ dam pa'i phrin las blar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol lo/ /bsam pa ngan pa rgyud la mi skye bar mdzad du gsol/ /byas tshad gzhan don/ bsam tshad bla ma/ gang brtsam chos dang mthun par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du'ang rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa skyes/

skyes pa mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyi sgo/ lus la gzi brjid/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la ting 'dzin khyad par can thob nas/ snang ba dbang du bsdus/ phas rgol zil gyis gnon/ dgra gdon thal bar brlag pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor/ chos bzhin yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor cig /chos skyong mthu ma chung*/ dam can rtsal ma zhan/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde blag tu stsol cig /de nas dam tshig la spyir mchod gtor bskang bshags ma chag par brtson pa byos shig de ltar khyed rang rnams kyis rgyun du mgon po'i dam tshig ma bral na: bu bzhin du skyong zhing lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor te: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyad chen gyi rdzong btsan zhing bya ra 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rim pa la spang blang tshul bzhin du bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ches: dam pa'i bka' ni legs stsal pa'i: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung :

lan gsum/ gsang ba'i bka' gtad zab mo legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bcu bzhi pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba chos skyong dregs pa'i srog gtad kyi le tshan no/ / de ltar lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yi slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub ched dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor kyang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor thugs dam bskul ba chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi chings ltar bya/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'di ni spros bcas dbang chen man ngag zhal gdams bcu gsum po so sor phral ba'i tshul lo/ /gong gsal 'di bzhin rtsa tho dang zin bris rnams su gsal yang*/ gting ma dpogs pa'i 'di ga'i gzhung pod dang*/ dbang chog yongs rdzogs thams cad mkhyen gzigs dil mkhyen rdo rje 'chang nyid la phul nas bka' 'dri zhib par zhus skabs/ zhib par gzigs nas 'di bzhin snga 'gyur gter phyogs 'dir mang*/

gter chen pad+ma gling pa'i chos sde la'ang dbang bzhi so so ru phyes pa dang sta gon la'ang rta mgrin gyi dbang bzhi yod pa sogs/ 'di bzhin mang po yod pa'i sgos chos yin pas so so ru bskur bas chog /'on kyang snga ma'i phyag srol phal che bar sgrub chen 'tshogs te sta gon nas bzung*/ rim bzhin dbang bzhi sogs bskur ba'i sgrub dbang bya srol yod pa ltar red mod/ da lta'i skabs de 'dra mi yong*/ ma 'ongs bar dbang khrigs zhib pa zhig dgos par 'dug gsungs pas de bzhin nyid nas mdzad rogs zhus pas yong yong gsung*/ 'on kyang da res 'di bzhin thon dang zhes zhib par bka' stsal ba dang*/ yar la ma zhus kyang khyod la bka' bab red pas/ dbang lung rgyun spel byed rgyu gal che ba'i phyag bris zhig kyang gnang ba rnams da skabs bsam na lung bstan zhig yin par go /de skabs rang brjed nges che ba'i go rim sogs bslab bya rnams bsnyel tho ru bkod pa dang*/ zhib phra rnams gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter mtha' skyong ba/ gter 'byin sprul sku pad rgyal gling pa rin po cher gter kha gong ma'i smin grol maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du 'bul ba'i skabs/ bka' 'dri zhib par zhus la dka' gnad rnams dran rten mchan du btab pa dang*/ phyis gter chen chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'i pad+ma khrag 'thung gi dbang chog chog bsgrigs lag tu son pas/ phal cher dgongs pa gcig tu bab 'dug pa bzhin/ snga 'gyur rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi smin grol spyi khog dang*/ rang gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa gnyis dpyad bsdur byas shing 'khor lo'i mgon po rnam gnyis kyi man ngag gzhir bzung*/ dbang gzhung gab 'khrugs dkyus pa rnams bsrang nas gsang ba spyi gzhung bzhin dbang chog yongs rdzogs chog bsgrigs 'di nyid/ sgo chen sprul ming 'dzin pa gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa shing mo bya'i lo dbyug gu'i bu mo srang gi khyim du zhugs pa'i dmar phyogs bzang po gsum pa/

rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i tshes bzang dge bar 'dzam gling sa yi go la'i nub gling mang sde gcig dril rgyal khab chen po'i nang gses/ mong kran na e wam̐ bsti gnas su grub par bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // (nya) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ dbang chog bsdus pa ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba srid zhi kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma rtsa gsum kun 'dus mtsho skyes rje/ /dbyer med rang rig bla mar gus btud de/ /bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yi/ /smin byed ye shes 'od drwa 'dir spros bya/ de'ang rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i spyi dril bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang bskur bsdus pa/ ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba khrigs su bsdeb pa srid zhi kun khyab spro ba la gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sbyor ba ni/ mdun stegs kheb ldan gyi steng du dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su rnam bum rgyan can/ bhan+dha/ me long*/ gtor ma/ bder 'dus kyi lha tsaka yongs rdzogs phyogs bsdus sam/ ma 'byor na gu ru'i sku 'bag gcig pus kyang rung*/ sngags byang*/ shel rdo/ zhi drag gi chas/ las bzhi'i phyag mtshan bcas dbang rdzas dang*/ bdag bskyed rtsa gsum spyi gtor sman raka gtor gsum/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos srung gtor ma/ sngon gtor rnams 'du bya la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ru chu gnyis nyer spyod bskor bsham dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum ḍā dril nas yungs nang mchod sogs bkod pas nyer mkho tshang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ rnam thar gsol 'debs/ gsol 'debs 'bral med ma rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bder 'dus sam rtsa ba gcig dril gang rung gi sgo nas skyabs sems nas bstod pa'i dkyus ltar btang la dzap khang dbye zhing*/

dzap bskul nas bsnyen sgrub ci nus kyi rjes su bum pa gnyis spyi chings ltar sgrub la mchod bstod 'od zhu bya/ rig me dor ba gnang zhus chos skyong gtor 'bul dang*/ skong bshags tshogs 'khor drangs pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams sgo drung du bos pa la las bum gyi chus/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chu: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: bkru bar bgyi'o byang zhing dag gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyang ni/ h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di rnams la/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa dang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/

rol mo 'tsham rngam dang bcas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom mo/ /de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ de nas slob dpon gyis zhwa chos dang bcas sgra dag la gsal ba'i sgo nas/ da 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo gsan te lam rim gnyis la bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa zab mo gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa'i bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang mthun par/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa/ thams cad bsdu na dman mchog gnyis su 'du/ theg chen la'ang mdo sngags gnyis las phyi ma/ de la'ang gsar rnying gnyis las snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ bka' gter dag snang gi bab so chen po gsum las/ zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing*/ sprul pa'i gter ston rim byung las 'di ni gnubs lo'i rnam 'phrul rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gter gnas sum cu rtsa dgu las zab gter bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rim par bzhes pa'i nang tshan/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum las thugs sgrub kyi khongs su gtogs pa ma zad/ spyir snga 'gyur du grags che ba'i bka' dgongs phur gsum las/ 'di ni rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus sam bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i chos sde su gtogs pa yin te/

de'i tshul yang*/ 'od gsal snying po'i gsang lam nas tshe gcig 'od skur grub pa'i nyag bla 'ja' lus pa pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i gsol bsdus las/ rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i/ /zhes dang*/ rang gzhung las/ de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rim gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs su bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams bstsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams bcas mang du bstsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' bstsal/ phyis su gu rus gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/

ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' bstsal bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ nye ba'i char sngar gu rus rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus rnam gsum chos kyi smin grol mdzad pa'i gnas mchog /bod yul sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po/ bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang de nyid du mi snang bar re zhig rgya yis gdams pa mdzad pa las/ dus la bab pa'i sa rtags lung bstan sogs mngon du gyur tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes shing zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa nas 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos par ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs thul le ba 'di nyid kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin la/ de la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'di ni bsdus pa ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa la/ bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas sa phyogs 'di dag dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur ba'i nang du/ slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol:

de ltar gsol ba btab nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pas/ mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes nas bka'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad pa la/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang ma gyur 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ smon 'jug byang chub tu thugs bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: tshogs bsags par bya ba'i slad du yan lag bdun pa 'di'i don yid la bzung zhing tshig gis rjes zlos kyang gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/
/rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/

/lan gsum/ de nas dam chu gtong ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni bde gshegs bla med chu: bsrungs pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: nyams pas ltung ba'i las su 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: dam tshig bsrungs na chu 'di ye shes sems dpar 'gyur te dngos grub mtha' dag stsol la/ nyams na yak+sha srin por gyur nas 'di phyi kun tu duḥkha mi zad par nyams su myong ba yin pas de don shes par gyis shig /de nas snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i ye shes btsan thabs su 'bebs pa la/ rang gnas kyi ye shes snying las bslangs te rim pas dbang gi rten gyi rten gzhi so thub tu sgrub pa la/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung srog rtsol kha sbyor du 'ching*/ yid tshogs drug gi yul las ma g.yeng bar dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma: ā las zla ba'i steng du: slob ma rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdamar gsal las rje btsun gu ru dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas nyid sku mdog dmar smug dbang gi phrin las thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs rje'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa: dbu la pad+ma mthong grol rgyan ldan gsol zhing : phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bcas bsnams shing : sku la phod kha chos gos ber chen bklubs te gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa:

zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol zhing rgyal po rol pa'i cha lugs can du bskyed pa'o: spyi bo'i mkha' ru thog ma'i sangs rgyas dang 'od mi 'gyur ba la bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams lhar bcas gsal ba'i: g.yas su zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor: rgyab tu nor lha'i dkyil 'khor: g.yon du drag po'i dkyil 'khor: mdun du rten 'brel rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor: phyi rol tu rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs sprin ltar du gtibs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gsal ba'i gnas gsum la/ rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal btab pa la rgyud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag dngos su gsal bar mos gus drag po dung nge ba zhig byas pa la brten nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i ye shes 'gugs pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par du rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ 'khor rig 'dzin grub thob dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ rtsa gsum dam can chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ de thams cad dpal o rgyan chen po'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par sad pa/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs rjes/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing : pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur zhing : sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnal 'byor la:

byin rlabs dbang bzhi deng 'dir stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de ltar dbab pas sku phebs na 'phar zhing g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rang byung ye shes rtsol med du skye ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs so/ /brtan par bya ba'i slad du rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: don dam par rtsa ba gsum dang sku gsum mchog gsum rnams gzhan nas gshegs bzhugs byar med de ye shes pa'i rdo rje gsum dang*/ rang gi gnyug ma'i sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang nas/ snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi gtong zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: dang po sku'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: bum pa thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la deng 'dir bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi sku yi dbang bskur ba yin te: bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang : bum chu rigs 'dus rgyal ba lha tshogs kyi ngo bor dbang bskur ba'i tshe snang stong sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang :

bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des bum dbang bde ba chen po thob pas deng phyin chad lus lha'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: bhan+dha thogs la: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi gsung gi dbang bskur ba yin te: dam tshig ye shes lnga'i byang chub 'di nyid phyi ltar na ma rgyud mkha' 'gro tshogs pa'i pho brang chen po dung khang 'byin 'jug sngags kyi dkyil 'khor: nang ltar na rang byung skye med grags stong rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor: rdo rje'i rlung la brten pa'i brda mtshon par rnam pa rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi dbang bskur bas: longs sku rig pa'i rtsal snang gi dbang thob pa'i mos 'dun mdzod: hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa'i ched du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥdamar po'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru? thod phreng rtsal/ hri ma ha ri ni s rjes zlos byar gzhug /des gsang dbang grags stong chen po thob pas lam gyi snying po'i sngags bzlas shing zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu thob: bzlas brjod sgrub pa byed du rung ba'i skal ldan du byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas thugs ky-i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu bcas thogs la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi thugs kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshom gsal stong don rdzogs kyi ngo bor gzhi ma bcos ka dag gdod ma'i gshis lugs ji ltar ston pa la brten nas chos kyi sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bor lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: 'bras bu chos kyi skur grub: rdzogs chen a ti bla med bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs shing : skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes:

bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma thogs la: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rtsa gsum bka' 'dus yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: gtor ma 'di nyid rmad byung rgyan rdzogs yon tan kun 'byung gi rdzas mchog chen po ste: dbang bskur bas dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus mchod sogs bsod nams mchod pa'i las byed kun dang : phrin las bzhi'i rten 'brel mthar dbyung zhing : dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang gsum rgyan rdzogs kyi dbang thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: des yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyis phyug pa'i rten 'brel la mthar phyin pa'i rdzas dbang ngam chas dbang thob: deng phyin chad bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod tshogs brtsam zhing dkyil 'khor lnga'i byed las rung ba dang : 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs shing : skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing*/ de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrin las dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: sku 'bag lha'i tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha dbang dang : chas dbang rdzas dbang bcas pa phrin las gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brdar mtshon pa ste: de ltar yongs rdzogs su bskur ba la: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings: drag po dbang drag rol pa ste: phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' sdud par bya ba'i rim pa rgyab chos smon lam bsam pa lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob pas rang bzhin thugs rje'i skur grol ba'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: spros pa bsdus pa gong ltar gtso lha kho nas bskur bas chog la/ de las cung spro na lha tsaka yongs rdzogs gcig tu dril nas bskur ba'am/ da dung spro bar mos na le'u bcu gsum gyi gtso lha kho na lha dbang nas khol bton byas te bskur ba yin pas spro bsdu skabs phyed par bya'o/ /gsham du chas dbang bskur ba ni/ des na khyed rang rnams gdan gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa la/ che rtags su zhi drag gi chas dang phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgya rtags kyi mnga' gsol bas chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' dbang brnyes/ 'gro don thogs med la spyod pa'i dbang dam thob par mos shig /zhi chas yongs rdzogs thogs la/ hūm̐: sku la bkod pa zhi ba'i rgyan mdzes pa:

rin chen prog zhu snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dang : dar dpyangs stod g.yogs dpung rgyan ga shal spras: smad dkris phyag gdub zhabs gdub bcas pa gtad: thugs rje'i rang rtsal rgyan gyi dbang thob shog: om̐ sarba rat+na bhi shwo pañca li ka ku mu ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas drag po'i chas thogs te/ hūm̐: thod skam dbu rgyan glang ko zhing lpags dang : rdo rje'i go khrab rus rgyan stag lpags dang : mgo phreng sbrul chun khrag zhag thal chen tshom: me dpung dang ni srung 'khor bcas pa gtad: bdud 'dul dpal gyi cha lugs yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ kro ta kro ta kro ti tsaṇ+ḍa sha ma sha na kan thi ka sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas las bzhi'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhi: dkyil 'khor rang rang sa bon phyag mtshan bcas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rgyan dang sa bon phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ sarba hri hri hūm̐ kin+tha ka badz+ra tig+na bhan+dha ye sarba hoḥ des phrin las 'gro 'dul ye shes kyi lha tshogs gsal byed rang bzhin thugs rjer 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dbang thob pas: deng phyin chad dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mtha' ru nyams su myong zhing : rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yi phrin las sna tshogs la dbang bar byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ bkra shis rab tu gnas/ de nas dam tshig bsgo ba ni/ de dag gis bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang bskur legs pa grub pas deng phyin chad rigs 'dus rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p de nas lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yi slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: de nas dbang bskur zhus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ sems can thams cad byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor kyang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ / sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor/ thugs dam bskul ba/ chad brtan/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya/ de dag gis bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi/ dbang chog rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi phyag len dam pa'i bzhed gzhung bzhin las/ bsdus pa bum dbang ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba ji bzhin chog khrigs su spel ba po ni gu h+ya'o// // (ta) thugs sgrub bder 'dus las/ gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo'i zab dbang khrigs su bsdebs pa gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam bzhugs so/ de'ang las dang skal ba ldan pa'i gang zag dbang rab rnams rim 'jug la mi ltos par/ thabs kyi lam nas dpe'i ye shes la brten te don gyi ye shes btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa'i thabs/

gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i zab lam bde ba chen po'i rnal 'byor lam du byed pa la/ thog mar sngon 'gro'i rgyud dul zhing dbang gi smin par byas la/ rim gnyis spyi dang khyad par steng sgo rnam grol gyi lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi gnad la bslab cing*/ 'og sgo bde ba chen po gzhan lus thabs ldan gyi man ngag la bsten pa'i gsang khrid dang 'brel ba'i/ gsang dbang bde stong drug 'dren gyi man ngag dngos rig la bsten pa'i phyag srol ltar/ gter gzhung las/ dbang rten gsang ba'i rig ma mtshan dang ldan pa: dung can ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rigs: glang chen ma rin chen mkha' 'gro'i rigs: dbyangs can ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i rigs: ri dwags ma las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rigs: pad+ma can sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i rigs: mdor bsdu ba bya rigs rta rigs bram ze ma bcas kyi nang nas rigs gang rnyed: brtags 'gugs dbang du bya ba sogs man ngag ltar byas nas/ thog mar rig ma de la khrus bstsal: gos dkar po bkon: dag gtsang legs par bgyis: lus spos chus byug: de nas rigs lnga'i dar dpyang gis brgyan: gos gtsang la mdzes pa ḍāk+ki'i cha lugs rus rgyan sogs kyis legs par spras: gdan gyi steng du 'khod: byin 'bebs bya: mkha' 'gro'i cho ga dang tshogs gtong : ha ri ni sas dbang sgrub bya: rig ma rdo rje phag mor dngos su bskyed bstim bya: zhag gsum mam gcig la sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bya: dkyil 'khor la tshom bu phul: de nas slob ma la gtad pa sogs dngos rig tu bshad kyang deng sang mos slob kyi dbang du byas te brda dang rten 'brel gyi bskur ba'i thabs mdo tsam brjod na/ thog mar dbang gi dkyil 'khor mdun du mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba bsham pa'i mdun/ dmigs rten mtshan ldan rigs lnga'i tsakli'am bsdu na gcig gis chog ste mtha' bskor du mchod pa sna tshogs sogs 'du bya/

dngos gzhi sgrub pa ni/ mkha' 'gro'i cho ga dang tshogs btang ha ri ni sas dbang sgrub bya/ rig ma rdo rje phag mor dngos su bskyed bstim bya bar gsung yang*/ rtsa ba thugs sgrub dbang chen sngar sgrub zin pa des chog la/ bum dbang grub pa dang*/ skad cig gis bdag mdun ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gar stabs ling nger/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub par sku lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam ye gnyis su med par gyur/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa baṃ mūm̐ḥ ci nus kyis byin dbab/ yid kyis mchod bstod bya/ de nas gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ lo rgyus 'khyogs mtsham ni/ de'ang gsang dbang bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ zab lam ye shes kyi drwa ba zhes tshe gcig la sangs rgyas bgrod pa'i gsang lam khyad du 'phags pa/ rig 'dzin grub thob yongs kyi gshegs shul myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos rmad du byung ba yin te/ 'di'i lo rgyus mdo tsam smra na/ gter gzhung las/ sngar rig 'dzin chen po shrī singhas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la lung bstan pa ni/ 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na: za hor 'bum phrag grong khyer 'gram: lho phyogs bstan pa'i sgo 'gram du: rdo rje phag mo mdze mo'i gzugs: de la 'brel thogs mkha' spyod gnas: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam la gshegs: khyod nyid gsang dbang ye shes kyi: gdams pa de la yod kyis longs: the tshom yid gnyis bral bar gyis: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ phebs pas za hor 'bum khang 'gram du rdo rje phag mo lus ngan pa'i cha lugs mdze mo shin tu skyi g.ya' ba/ 'khor bu mo smad 'tshong ma dang chang tshong ma sogs rnam 'gyur mu stegs 'dra ba'i cha lugs gnas pa mthong ma thag

/lung bstan pa de yin par mkhyen nas phyag btsal te maṇ+ḍal phul nas chos 'brel gnang bar gsol ba btab pas/ bu mo tshos a ma'i mdze 'brel 'bags yong bas rnal 'byor pa rang bzhud na 'thad/ ces pas/ slar nan gyis zhus pa la chang lhag zhig gnang ba bzhes pa'i tshe skye med ngang la rang sgra las om̐ ha ri ni sa baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sgra thos shing bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi la phag mo rigs lnga gsal por gzigs/ mchod pas bde ba myangs/ de nas rgyal ba'i lung bstan tshul dang gdams pa zhus pas/ de 'dra nga min khyod rang gis grong khyer de nor ba yin yong zer bas/ slar yang the tshom med par thag bcad nas phyag 'tshal bas/ khyod blo brtan po zhig yin 'dra bas/ da khyod rang grong khyer la bskor ba bdun gyis la mun rub tsam la 'dir yong mkhan mang po yod pa de la bsdebs nas shog cig gsungs bzhin byas pas/ sngar gyi gnas khang de gnas gyur nas dur khrod chen po zhig gi dbus su thod mkhar smug nag ldems se ba zhig gi nang du/ sngar gyi mdze mo de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma shin tu gzi brjid che ba/ nyi zla'i khri brtsegs shing pad+ma'i gdan bting ba'i steng du phyag g.yas pas thod pa'i cang te'u dang*/ g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa la/ 'khor gyi bu mo de rnams rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros mda' dar dang bhan+dha thogs pa/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo de yis mdun gyi nam mkha' la gzigs shing ḍā ma ru 'khrol nas mkha' 'gro'i brda skad sgrogs pa'i tshe/ he ru ka dga' rab dgyes pa rdo rje dngos su byon nas dkyil 'khor gyi mkha' ru bzhugs/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mos dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes pa'i sgras bskul nas gtso mo las gnyis pa mched de/ yab yum dga' bzhi'i mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba'i rgyun byang sems kyi rnam pa bum pa'i bcud du smin te zag med ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso mo'i thugs ka nas rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro spros te bum gsang shes rab dbang bskur/

de nas gtso bo yab yum kyang las kyi rig mar thim/ de'i tshe 'khor rnams kyis rus pa'i rgyan drug gis g.yogs nas yab yum yas bab mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi lhan skyes kyi ngo sprod gnang*/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis las bzhi'i phrin las so so'i rjes su gnang*/ da khyod rus pa'i rgyan drug 'di rin chen sgrom bu'i nang du bcug nas dur khrod brgyad kyi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga la dbang bskur ba'i mthar ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad par gyis zhes sgrom bu dang bcas gnang bas/ grong khyer de'i lcags ri phyi ma nas bskor ba lan gsum bgyis pas zhabs sa la mi reg par khru gang btegs par snang ba'i spro ba skyes nas da dung yang gdams ngag gcig lus song ba zhu bsams nas phyin pas/ sngar bzhin sprul pa bshigs nas yid mi ches pa zhig byas par snang tsa na/ sngar gyi sgrom bu de gar yod snyam pas sgal par sing sing zhes dngos su yod par 'dug pas des the tshom chod/ slar 'di ltar snyan brgyud a mo gha yi las tshogs dgos zhus pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su med gsungs/ slar de don shrī singha la zhus pas mkha' 'gro de rdo rje phag mo'ang zer/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'ang zer/ gsang ba ye shes kyang zer/ las kyi dbang mo'ang zer ba sogs lung gis dbugs dbyung zhing*/ slad grub pa'i rgyal mo/ man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dang bcas thams cad ngo bo gcig la rnam pa so sor snang ba yin no/ /de ltar mdze mo'i cha lugs smad 'tshong 'khor dang bcas pa ni gsang sngags la log par lta ba skal med rnams la rdo rje theg chen gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ lam 'dir mi mos pa rnams kyis rngo ma thogs shing the tshom dang log lta'i dbang gis dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa'i don gyis de ltar brdzu ba'o/ de ltar gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo rgya gar nas brgyud de/ gu ru nyid bod du phebs pa'i tshe 'bri gung ti sgro ru ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/

mchims phu ru rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs la dkyil 'khor gyi dbang mang po bskur ba'i snyan brgyud du bstsal ba dang*/ khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ gsang dbang gi byin 'bebs skabs su gu ru'i phyag rgyas rgya mdzad pas bu mo ras sngon gyi ang rag gyon pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' nas gar 'cham pa khrom pa rnams kyis dngos su mthong bar gyur/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i dag snang man+da ra ba dngos su byon nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang yab yum skur bzhengs te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs nas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ bal 'bangs ka la sid+dhi/ bal mo shākya dhe wa/ mon mo bkra shis khye'u 'dren bcas pa rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i skur bzhengs nas dkyil 'khor gsang dbang dngos su thob/ de'i tshe snyan brgyud kyi man ngag zhal shes pra khrid bcas pa ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shog ser logs su bkod nas/ bla ma bka' 'dus/ bder 'dus/ mkha' 'gro chos bzhi/ thugs sgrub rnam lnga/ bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cha lag tu bzhag nas bka' rgya dam por mdzad do/ /phyis su mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang nas o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas zab gter du bzhes pa'i bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong gi cha lag /gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo ye shes drwa ba'i gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ: bde gshegs gsang ba'i dbyings phyug yum: dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i ma: yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor mas: grol lam pho nya'i dngos grub stsol: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐ baṃḥ dri med pad+ma rak+ta'i bcud: 'di bzung zag med dga' bzhi 'char: dam med rnams kyi snying khrag skem:

de bas dam srungs sa ma ya: de ltar dbang gi bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyis bka' bsgo ba rnams cha tsam yang ma nyams par bsrung bar khas blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: las dang ldan pa la dbang sbyin pa ni/ bum chus bsang sbyangs bgyis la/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad+ma nyi zla spel ba'i khri steng du: bh+yo dang baṃ las byung ba'i ma cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru nam mkhar 'khrol zhing : g.yon pas bhan+dha'i nang du 'chi med bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi bcud kyis gtams pa thugs kar bsnams pa: sku la nyi zla'i rgyan du mas spras shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa: dbu la prog zhu dang rigs lnga'i dar dpyang gis brgyan pa: zhabs gar stabs ling tsam du bzhugs pa: mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan mda' dar bhan+dha bdud rtsis btams pa bsnams shing : gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang ldan pa bcas gsal ba'o: bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'phro 'dus mkha' spyod u rgyan dag pa'i zhing khams nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki la mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor ma sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba spyan drangs te rig mar thim pas: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar mngon sum du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: spyan drangs shing bstim pa ni/ hūm̐: ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: nub pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: mtshams 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma gnas 'dir byon la byin gyis rlobs:

thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: byin rlabs char rgyun na ra ra: mos gus 'bras bu chi li li: thabs kyi rgyan cha khro lo lo: shes rab nyams dbyangs kyu ru ru: brda 'gros gar stabs khyugs se khyug: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: gsang ba bde chen rig ma 'dir: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur cig: grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'di: gzhal yas khang du byin gyis rlobs: dkyil 'khor rdzas la mdangs phyung nas: mos pa'i bu la 'ja' lus stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ a be sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ de nas bum pa thogs te: de nas 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang bskur ba la/ sngar bum dbang gi skabs su bstan pa'i phyi'i dkyil 'khor ni/ mtshon dpe tsam las don la rang lus ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor ye gnas su shes pa ni don gyi dkyil 'khor du ngo shes par gyis shig hūm̐: 'ja' lus rdo rje bum pa'i dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro bskyed pa'i dam tshig srungs: dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra mu tra dha ra hoḥ de ltar dbang thob pas ma bskyed yongs grub snang srid mkha' 'gro'i dal du rdzogs/ dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/

bhan+dha thogs te: de nas rang lus kyi 'khor lo lnga'i gnas dang 'byin 'jug thams cad gdod nas dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin bde chen mkha' 'gro ru ngo shes par gyis shig hūm̐: ye shes rlung ni bhan+dha'i dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig srungs: mchog dga' nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ an+ḍi ye hoḥ de ltar dbang thob pas 'byin 'jug rlung gsum ye shes su dag /mchog dga'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ha ri ni sa bkod pa gnas su bstim: de nas sems gzung 'dzin 'gyu ldang thams cad gdod nas 'khrul med bde ba chen po'i thig le nyag gcig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ru ngo shes par gyis shig hūm̐: bde chen thig le'i dkyil 'khor dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs rim dam tshig srungs: lhan skyes nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ dz+nyā na su kha khaṃ ye swā hā: de ltar dbang thob pas sems kyi rtogs tshogs bde chen du dag /lhan skyes ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs ma'i phyag g.yon gyi srin mdzub la ye shes lnga'i dar thag btags la/ slob ma'i lag tu gtad par mos la/ de nas khyed rang slob ma rnams/ gtso mo'i rang 'od kyi yab las rnam par 'phrul pa'i thabs mchog dpa' bo rta mgrin nam/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo nas rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las rnam par 'phrul pa'i shes rab rig ma/ gzugs dang lang tsho ldan zhing rigs kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa zhig byung*/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon nam g.yas pas pho mo'i khyad par/ khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas sam g.yon du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dpang du bkod de gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: zag med 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i grogs: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: dga' bral chen po nyams su myong :

om̐ badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥpad+ma ak+ṣo bh+ya swā hā: zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar yab yum lhar 'du shes pa dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar 'du shes pa/ yid chos su 'du shes pa gsum gyis snyom par zhugs pas/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i 'phro 'du bde chen gyi dbyings su nub te/ de ltar 'khor lo bzhir yas babs kyi thig le lugs 'byung gi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar dmar cha dang bcas pa'i rlung 'pho med gyen du drangs pas mas brtan gyi thig le lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bas/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lhan skyes bde stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des dbang bzhi thob nas grol lam bzhi mngon du gyur: dga' bzhi'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba myong nas: mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngo bo nyid yin par ngos bzung : dbab ldog 'dren bkram bzhi yis chos sku 'ja' lus kyi go 'phang 'grub: steng sgo'i ye shes mngon du gyur nas: 'og sgo bde ba chen po lam du 'gro: steng nas ye shes char rgyun drag tu phab pas bde ba'i lus khengs: 'og gi chu rgyun gyi 'grim 'grul bkag nas rdzing gi bcud 'khyil ba'i yon tan dpag bsam ljon shing bskyed: rtsa ba ye shes kyi gzhi tshugs: sdong po chos sku'i dpung tshan hrag: yon tan kun ldan gyi yal ga phyogs bcur gyes: snying rje'i lo 'dab phun tshogs su phyug: rig pa shes rab kyi rnam par kha phye: 'bras bu 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / thams cad kyis rig ma'i zhabs pus spyi bor blangs te: phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du me tog re re thogs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ gsang ba bla med lam gyi mchog: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la: mi 'da' mi rtog srog ltar bzung : rtag tu 'ja' lus bsgrub pa yi: bskyed rdzogs snying po 'dzin la gnas:

rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan rnams kyis legs par nyon: zab lam bde ba chen po ni: u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar: yon tan kun ldan rnyed par dka': rgya mtsho'i gling gi nor bu bzhin: ka dag ye shes rang gsal 'di: tsam pa ka yi me tog ltar: dus drug rkyen gyis ya mi nga : 'phags pa'i byin rlabs gter du sbas: 'og sgo dga' bzhi'i grol lam 'di: sgra gcan 'khor lo'i zom dang 'dra: snang srid dkar dmar dwangs snyigs phye: pho nya'i gnad kyis ngo sprod 'di: rigs lnga'i bde ba skad cig ston: bcu drug dpal mo'i rol rtsed yin: smra brjod kha yi tshig las 'das: rdzogs pa chen po'i sa lam yin: de bas dam tshig 'chang bar bya: mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la smad mi bya: skyon du lta dang log bcol spang : mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la sdang mi bya: khong khro gdug sems spang bar bya: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la 'tshe ba spang : dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dag snang sbyang : mkha' 'gro'i yon tan dam tshig tu: rdo rje slob dpon gzungs ma dang : rigs rus sras bcas 'dun pas bstod: mkha' 'gro'i phrin las dam tshig tu: rtag tu gsang ba ḍāk+kir brten: bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mchod par bya: mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i dam tshig tu: nya stong dus mchod mi bcag cing : tshogs brgya bskang brgyas sgrib sbyong 'bungs: rten 'brel dge ba'i gnas chen du: rigs ldan mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: tshogs 'khor bsham pa'i grogs bgyis nas: rigs 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor du: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul bar bgyis: maṇ+ḍal yig brgya ci nus bzla: ma 'ongs rnga yab zhing khams su: yang yang 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bya: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la: rab gnas zhabs brtan legs par phul: 'dzam gling dge ba'i rlung rta dang : sa bcud bsod nams bum gter sba:

rjes shes bsngo smon rgyas 'debs bya: zhes de dag gi bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi/ gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo'i zab lam ye shes drwa ba'i dbang bskur legs par grub pas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi gnas de rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p de ltar dam tshig khas len cing gtang rag 'bul bar bya'o/ /'di nyid dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i gsang dbang gyi skabs la sbyar ba ni lag len yin no/ /de dag ni gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo'i zab lam ye shes drwa ba khrigs su bsdebs pa'i le tshan no// // (tha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ smin byed dbang gi bca' bsham gyi rim pa gsal byed bzhugs so/ de la'ang dang po bca' bsham ji ltar bgyis pa'i tshul ni/ dbang gzhung rtsa tshig las/ spros bcas ltar na rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni blos bslang 'bring ni rdul tshon dang : tha ma ras bris sam ni 'bru tshom dkod: ces gsungs pa ltar/ rab la blos bslang dang*/ 'bring rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ tha ma ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ yang tha 'bru tshom sogs spros pa gang 'grigs skabs dang bstun/ 'dir ras bris kyi dbang du byas na/ mdun stegs dar dmar gyi khebs ldan steng ras bris dkyil 'khor bkram/ de'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal che ba zhig gi steng du 'bras dkar dri bzang gis sbags pa'i tshom bu bder 'dus rtsa ba'i lha grangs dang mtshungs par bkod pa'i thog /rkang gsum steng du bum pa rgyan ldan chus sum gnyis bkang ba'i khar bhan+dha'i snod du bdud rtsi chos sman chang dang sbyar ba la/ dar dmar brgyad ltebs kyi khebs ldan thog me long la sin+dhū ra byug par/ chos 'byung bsnol ma bris pa'i dbus su mūm̐ḥ zur bzhir dga' 'khyil bris pa dgod/ de'i steng du man shel zur drug pa bzhag pa ste/

dbang bzhi brtsigs thabs su bsham zhes bshad/ gzhung las/ bum pa rgyan rdzogs lha yi dkyil 'khor yin: phreng ba rang gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor yin: gsal stong shel rdo ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor yin: bha ling rgyan rdzogs mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor yin: phyag mtshan rnon po las mtha'i dkyil 'khor yin: lnga po 'di la dkyil 'khor cha gcig tshang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin dbang bzhi la g.yas phyogs su lha dbang yongs rdzogs kyi tsakli/ g.yon phyogs su bgrang phreng dang sngags byang*/ rgyab phyogs su stegs sam bang rim can gyi thog khar bla gtor dpal ri ma dang pad sdong ma/ sgrub thabs bcu gsum so sor kha phral nas dbang rgyas pa'i skabs yin na/ rtsa gsum bye brag gi gtor ma sogs dang*/ chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos skyong sde lnga/ 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs chos skyong gi gtor ma dang*/ mdun du rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi gtor ma bcas bkram pa'i g.yas g.yon sman raka dgod/ de bzhin du sgrub thabs man ngag bcu gsum po re re bzhin phyogs ma 'chol bar so so'i dkyil 'khor ram 'bru tshom bkod pa'i thog /bum pa/ ka pā la/ bgrang phreng*/ sngags byang*/ me long*/ gtor ma/ so so'i lha tsaka /shel rdo bcas bshams la re re bzhin mchod pa rnam lnga skor bsham bya/ chas dbang dang rdzas dbang ni gcig gis byas kyang chog /yang dbang 'bring po'i skabs yin na/ gtso bum gyi g.yas phyogs sam gang bder ka to ra 'bru yis bkang ba'i nang*/ rnam 'phrul bcu gsum gyi lha tshom so so'i phyogs ma 'chol bar rim pa gsum du bkod gsungs pas/ dang po dbus su snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po rigs lnga'i o rgyan bde gshegs sgrub pa dbus phyogs chos sku'i lha tshom/ shar du 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa'i rig 'dzin o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i lha tshom/ lho ru cir snang lam khyer tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lha tshom/

nub tu 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi lha tshom/ byang du nam zhig tshe'i 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa chos dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshom ste/ de ltar zhi ba ye shes dbyings lnga'i lha tshom zhes/ dug lnga rang grol gyi zhal gdams chos nyid sku lnga'i lha tshom dbus phyogs dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams dang 'brel bar/ sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i mu ge sogs/ dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung ba kun sel o rgyan nor lha pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshom tsakli dbus phyogs snang mtha'i sku rgyab tu dgod/ de bzhin snga ma'i shar gyi phyi rim du gti mug las gyur pa'i dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i lha tshom/ lho ru zhe sdang las gyur pa'i dmag 'khrug sogs/ pha rol bdud bzhi'i rgol ba gzhom pa'i o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi lha tshom/ nub tu nga rgyal las gyur pa'i chom po sogs/ bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshom/ byang du phrag dog las gyur pa'i mtha' bzhi ral ba la sogs/ phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi lha tshom bcas/ de ltar smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ bdud kyi rgol ba gzhoms pa dang*/ dbang sdud zil gnon gyi don tshan phrin las lnga'i le tshan rnams rim pa gnyis par bkod pas phyi rim du/ rim pa gsum pa phrin las so sor sgrub pa'i rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba/ gnas dang ri sol 'grims pa'i cha lag /thog mar lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyis/ bar chad bsal zhing phrin las sgrub par bskul ba gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyi lha tshom/ snga ma'i rim pa gnyis pa sman lha'i rgyab phyogs te shar gyi phyi rim dang*/ de bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel dus las mi g.yel ba o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi lha tshom lho dang*/

gnas yul 'grims pa'i bar chad mngon spyod kyis bsgral ba/ o rgyan rdo rje gro lod kyi lha tshom nub kyi phyogs te rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gsum lha tsaka dang*/ bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom sprul sku sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'gyed pa'i le tshan byang du dgod par bya'o/ /g.yon du ka pā la bdud rtsis gtams pa/ bgrang phreng sngags byang gi mdun du me long dang dkyil 'khor/ rgyab tu sgrub pa'i gtor ma sogs snga ma dang mtshungs/ gzhan yang chas dbang la longs sku zhi ba'i chas/ drag po la dur khrod chas brgyad/ rdzas dbang mchod pa/ sman raka /gtor ma/ bsgral mchod/ tshogs gtor/ dza gad/ skong rdzas/ chad brtan/ bka' srung gi gtor ma rnams phyogs gang bder dod pa 'bring po'i lugs so/ /bsdus pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzhan 'bring po ji lta bar lha tsaka rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms la/ chas dbang la zhi drag gi chas tsam las rdzas dbang rnams mi dgos/ gzhan yang dngos sta so so'i skabs sta gon ched 'khyor chu srung ba'i dpung skud/ ku sha/ sor shing sogs sta gon la 'os pa'i rdzas dang*/ me tog /dor ra/ mig dar/ gser thur/ phyag shing*/ rdo dril bsnol ma/ me thun/ chu thun/ gul yungs sogs 'du byas la/ phyi rol nas zhi mchod/ drag mchod/ mnga' gsol/ rdzas rtags sna bdun sogs ma tshang ba med par bya/ rang mdun du bum pa/ ḍā ma ru/ nas gzeb/ dar mtshon/ g.yab dar dmar nag /rdor dril/ nang mchod/ las phur sogs 'du bya/ dmigs bsal tshe dbang gi ched du/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ tshe mda' bcas mdor na dgos mkho rnams nye bar tshogs par bya'o// //
